import Init

/-! Conditional interfaces for the original closure obligations.
No concrete Yulang judgment is defined by execution safety here. -/
namespace YulangClosure

structure Machine (Config Saved World Response Output : Type) where
  internal : Config → Config → Prop
  suspended : Config → Saved → Prop
  /-- Current world supplied by a lawful host/context, not saved in `Saved`. -/
  current : Config → World → Prop
  admissible : Saved → World → Response → Prop
  /-- The same immutable saved object can be used with different current worlds. -/
  resume : Saved → World → Response → Config → Prop
  returned : Config → Prop
  requested : Config → Prop
  failed : Config → Prop
  bad : Config → Prop
  exposed : Config → Output → Prop

inductive Step {C K W R O : Type} (m : Machine C K W R O) : C → C → Prop
  | internal {c d} : m.internal c d → Step m c d
  | resume {c d k w r} :
      m.suspended c k → m.current c w → m.admissible k w r →
      m.resume k w r d → Step m c d

/-- Length-indexed prefixes include every legal external resumption. -/
inductive Prefix {C : Type} (step : C → C → Prop) : Nat → C → C → Prop
  | refl (c) : Prefix step 0 c c
  | snoc {n a b c} : Prefix step n a b → step b c →
      Prefix step (n + 1) a c

structure Analysis (Config Cell Output : Type) where
  represents : Config → Cell → Prop
  seed : Config → Cell → Prop
  edge : Cell → Cell → Prop
  observes : Cell → Output → Prop
  /-- Finiteness is supplied independently; the composition proof needs no bound on time. -/
  cardinality : Nat
  index : Cell → Fin cardinality
  index_injective : ∀ a b, index a = index b → a = b

structure Certificate {C B O : Type} (a : Analysis C B O) where
  contains : B → Prop
  allowed : O → Prop
  seeds : ∀ c b, a.seed c b → contains b
  closed : ∀ b d, contains b → a.edge b d → contains d
  outputs : ∀ b o, contains b → a.observes b o → allowed o

/-- Local obligations, independent of the finite-prefix conclusion.
`typed` must be instantiated by the original syntax-directed judgment.
In particular it must not be defined as reachability or absence of Bad. -/
structure LocalLaws {C K W R O B : Type}
    (m : Machine C K W R O) (a : Analysis C B O) where
  Result : Type
  result : Result
  typing : Result → C → Prop
  initial : C → Prop
  initial_typing : ∀ c, initial c → typing result c
  initial_seed : ∀ c, initial c → ∃ b, a.seed c b ∧ a.represents c b
  internal_preservation : ∀ c d, typing result c → m.internal c d → typing result d
  resume_formation : ∀ c d k w r, typing result c → m.suspended c k →
    m.current c w → m.admissible k w r → m.resume k w r d → typing result d
  internal_simulation : ∀ c d b, typing result c → a.represents c b →
    m.internal c d → ∃ b', a.edge b b' ∧ a.represents d b'
  resume_simulation : ∀ c d b k w r, typing result c → a.represents c b →
    m.suspended c k → m.current c w → m.admissible k w r →
    m.resume k w r d → ∃ b', a.edge b b' ∧ a.represents d b'
  observation : ∀ c b o, typing result c → a.represents c b →
    m.exposed c o → a.observes b o
  no_bad : ∀ c, typing result c → ¬ m.bad c
  progress : ∀ c, typing result c → m.returned c ∨ m.requested c ∨ m.failed c ∨
    ∃ d, m.internal c d

/-- The result index is fixed throughout this instance, including resume. -/
def LocalLaws.typed {C K W R O B : Type}
    {m : Machine C K W R O} {a : Analysis C B O}
    (laws : LocalLaws m a) : C → Prop := laws.typing laws.result

/-- Reachability entirely inside one immutable birth-level induced graph. -/
inductive LevelPath {V : Type} (ref : V → V → Prop) (birth : V → Nat)
    (level : Nat) : V → V → Prop
  | refl {v} : birth v = level → LevelPath ref birth level v v
  | cons {u v w} : birth u = level → birth v = level → ref u v →
      LevelPath ref birth level v w → LevelPath ref birth level u w

structure ExtrusionOccurrence (Value TypeVar OccurrenceId : Type) where
  id : OccurrenceId
  origin : Value
  receiver : Value
  /-- Actual retained parent/copy pairs; polarity remains part of each entry. -/
  pairs : List (TypeVar × TypeVar × Bool)

def Qualifies {V T I : Type} (ref : V → V → Prop) (birth : V → Nat)
    (e : ExtrusionOccurrence V T I) : Prop :=
  ∃ level, LevelPath ref birth level e.origin e.receiver ∧
    LevelPath ref birth level e.receiver e.origin

/-! Uninstantiated ORIGINAL roots. These are proposition definitions, not axioms
or proved instances. Witness objects carry the entire shared lexical package.
`sameScoped` must retain rigid imports, one hidden witness, all uses and futures;
its concrete definition cannot be replaced by endpoint equality. -/
structure SourceProblem (Source Core Scope Witness Constraint Solution Native : Type) where
  /-- Supported syntax/domain; this does not assert that the program is typable. -/
  supported : Source → Prop
  sourceJudgment : Source → Scope → Witness → Prop
  coreJudgment : Core → Scope → Witness → Prop
  elaborates : Source → Core → Prop
  sameObservations : Source → Core → Scope → Witness → Prop
  generates : Source → Scope → Constraint → Prop
  solves : Constraint → Solution → Prop
  sameScoped : Source → Scope → Witness → Solution → Prop
  nativeStep : Native → Native → Prop
  nativeRealizes : Native → Constraint → Solution → Prop
  nativeSuccess : Source → Scope → Native → Prop
  inferInitial : Source → Scope → Native → Prop
  inferStep : Native → Native → Prop

namespace SourceProblem
variable {S C X E D A N : Type} (p : SourceProblem S C X E D A N)

/-- Forward elaboration preserves the SAME source scope and shared witness. -/
def Elaboration : Prop :=
  ∀ s x e, p.supported s → p.sourceJudgment s x e →
    ∃ c, p.elaborates s c ∧ p.coreJudgment c x e ∧ p.sameObservations s c x e

/-- Successful generated solutions must produce an original source derivation. -/
def InferenceSoundness : Prop :=
  ∀ s x d a, p.supported s → p.generates s x d → p.solves d a →
    ∃ e, p.sourceJudgment s x e ∧ p.sameScoped s x e a

/-- Source-scoped coverage, not preservation of every arbitrary native model. -/
def SourceScopedCoverage : Prop :=
  ∀ s x e d, p.supported s → p.sourceJudgment s x e → p.generates s x d →
    ∃ a, p.solves d a ∧ p.sameScoped s x e a

/-- Principality additionally needs the original instance/ordering relation. -/
def PrincipalCoverage (principal : S → X → D → A → Prop)
    (instanceOf : X → A → A → Prop) : Prop :=
  ∀ s x d, p.supported s → p.generates s x d →
    (∃ e, p.sourceJudgment s x e) →
    ∃ a, principal s x d a ∧ p.solves d a ∧
      ∀ e, p.sourceJudgment s x e →
        ∃ b, p.solves d b ∧ p.sameScoped s x e b ∧ instanceOf x a b

/-- Native success is a separate bridge, not a consequence of a scalar model. -/
def NativeCorrespondence : Prop :=
  ∀ s x n, p.nativeSuccess s x n →
    ∃ d a, p.generates s x d ∧ p.nativeRealizes n d a ∧ p.solves d a

/-- Algorithmic termination only; it does not assert program evaluation terminates. -/
def InferenceTermination : Prop :=
  ∀ s x n, p.supported s → p.inferInitial s x n →
    Acc (fun next prev => p.inferStep prev next) n

end SourceProblem
end YulangClosure

import YulangClosure.Contracts

namespace YulangClosure
variable {C K W R O B : Type}
variable (m : Machine C K W R O) (a : Analysis C B O)
variable (laws : LocalLaws m a) (cert : Certificate a)

/-- Independent typing and ONE joint concrete/abstract witness at this point. -/
def Invariant (c : C) : Prop :=
  laws.typed c ∧ ∃ b, a.represents c b ∧ cert.contains b

theorem initial_invariant {c : C} (hc : laws.initial c) :
    Invariant m a laws cert c := by
  obtain ⟨b, hs, hr⟩ := laws.initial_seed c hc
  exact ⟨laws.initial_typing c hc, b, hr, cert.seeds c b hs⟩

theorem step_invariant {c d : C}
    (hc : Invariant m a laws cert c) (h : Step m c d) :
    Invariant m a laws cert d := by
  obtain ⟨ht, b, hr, hu⟩ := hc
  cases h with
  | internal hi =>
    obtain ⟨b', he, hr'⟩ := laws.internal_simulation c d b ht hr hi
    exact ⟨laws.internal_preservation c d ht hi,
      b', hr', cert.closed b b' hu he⟩
  | resume hs hw ha hx =>
    obtain ⟨b', he, hr'⟩ := laws.resume_simulation _ _ _ _ _ _ ht hr hs hw ha hx
    exact ⟨laws.resume_formation _ _ _ _ _ ht hs hw ha hx,
      b', hr', cert.closed b b' hu he⟩

/-- No upper bound on prefix length or on the number of external resumptions. -/
theorem prefix_invariant {n : Nat} {c d : C}
    (hc : Invariant m a laws cert c) (h : Prefix (Step m) n c d) :
    Invariant m a laws cert d := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact hc
  | snoc hp hs ih => exact step_invariant m a laws cert (ih hc) hs

structure Conclusion (c : C) : Prop where
  typed : laws.typed c
  cell : ∃ b, a.represents c b ∧ cert.contains b
  noBad : ¬ m.bad c
  progress : m.returned c ∨ m.requested c ∨ m.failed c ∨ ∃ d, m.internal c d
  outputs : ∀ o, m.exposed c o → cert.allowed o

theorem invariant_conclusion {c : C} (hc : Invariant m a laws cert c) :
    Conclusion m a laws cert c := by
  obtain ⟨ht, b, hr, hu⟩ := hc
  refine ⟨ht, ⟨b, hr, hu⟩, laws.no_bad c ht, laws.progress c ht, ?_⟩
  intro o ho
  exact cert.outputs b o hu (laws.observation c b o ht hr ho)

/-- Conditional theorem C: the local interfaces imply every finite-prefix claim. -/
theorem finite_prefix_composition {n : Nat} {c d : C}
    (hc : laws.initial c) (h : Prefix (Step m) n c d) :
    Conclusion m a laws cert d := by
  apply invariant_conclusion m a laws cert
  exact prefix_invariant m a laws cert (initial_invariant m a laws cert hc) h

/-- Every position of an arbitrary run, including runs with infinitely many resumes. -/
theorem run_at_every_time (run : Nat → C)
    (h0 : laws.initial (run 0)) (hs : ∀ n, Step m (run n) (run (n + 1))) :
    ∀ n, Conclusion m a laws cert (run n) := by
  have inv : ∀ n, Invariant m a laws cert (run n) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => exact initial_invariant m a laws cert h0
    | succ n ih => exact step_invariant m a laws cert ih (hs n)
  intro n
  exact invariant_conclusion m a laws cert (inv n)

/-- Reuse is not consumption: k is the SAME parameter in both judgments.
The two configurations/current worlds and responses need not be equal. -/
theorem saved_reusable {c₁ c₂ d₁ d₂ : C} {k : K} {w₁ w₂ : W} {r₁ r₂ : R}
    (h₁ : Invariant m a laws cert c₁) (h₂ : Invariant m a laws cert c₂)
    (s₁ : m.suspended c₁ k) (s₂ : m.suspended c₂ k)
    (cw₁ : m.current c₁ w₁) (cw₂ : m.current c₂ w₂)
    (ar₁ : m.admissible k w₁ r₁) (ar₂ : m.admissible k w₂ r₂)
    (re₁ : m.resume k w₁ r₁ d₁) (re₂ : m.resume k w₂ r₂ d₂) :
    Invariant m a laws cert d₁ ∧ Invariant m a laws cert d₂ := by
  exact ⟨step_invariant m a laws cert h₁ (.resume s₁ cw₁ ar₁ re₁),
    step_invariant m a laws cert h₂ (.resume s₂ cw₂ ar₂ re₂)⟩

end YulangClosure

namespace YulangClosure.SourceProblem

/-- The native, inference and elaboration obligations compose with ONE source
scope and witness. None of the three obligations is discharged by this theorem.
Connecting the resulting core judgment to LocalLaws.initial is a further,
concrete initialization obligation. -/
theorem native_success_elaborates {S C X E D A N : Type}
    (p : SourceProblem S C X E D A N)
    (hnative : p.NativeCorrespondence)
    (hinfer : p.InferenceSoundness) (helab : p.Elaboration)
    {s : S} {x : X} {n : N}
    (hs : p.supported s) (hn : p.nativeSuccess s x n) :
    ∃ d a e c,
      p.generates s x d ∧ p.nativeRealizes n d a ∧ p.solves d a ∧
      p.sourceJudgment s x e ∧ p.sameScoped s x e a ∧
      p.elaborates s c ∧ p.coreJudgment c x e ∧
      p.sameObservations s c x e := by
  obtain ⟨d, a, hg, hr, hsolve⟩ := hnative s x n hn
  obtain ⟨e, hsource, hscope⟩ := hinfer s x d a hs hg hsolve
  obtain ⟨c, he, hc, ho⟩ := helab s x e hs hsource
  exact ⟨d, a, e, c, hg, hr, hsolve, hsource, hscope, he, hc, ho⟩

end YulangClosure.SourceProblem

import Init

namespace YulangClosure.Original

inductive Space where
  | value | type | evidence | control
  deriving DecidableEq

inductive Base where
  | unit | bool | int | float | string | bytes | path | char
  deriving DecidableEq

inductive Literal where
  | unit
  | bool (value : Bool)
  | int (value : Int)
  | floatBits (bits : UInt64)
  | string (value : String)
  | bytes (value : List UInt8)
  | path (value : List UInt8)
  | char (value : String)

inductive Mode where | value | computation
  deriving DecidableEq
inductive EvidenceMode where | general | administrative
inductive Failure where | matchFailure | divideByZero | boundsError | unimplemented
inductive IdentityKind where
  | nominal | constructor | operation | family | resource | stateScope
  | owner | handler | graphRoot | template | primitive | label | receipt | view | target

/-- Identity atoms are NOT variables and are never rewritten by substitution. -/
inductive Atom where
  | literal (value : Literal)
  | identity (kind : IdentityKind) (key : Nat)
  | mode (entryMode : Mode)
  | evidenceMode (value : EvidenceMode)
  | failure (value : Failure)
  | presence (required : Bool)
  | base (value : Base)
  | index (value : Nat)

/-- Named original constructors, not a body-opcode interpreter. Their arities
and sort constraints are extrinsic. All arguments, including metadata and type
instances, remain children of the raw tree. -/
inductive Tag where
  | typeTop | typeBottom | typeUnion | typeIntersection | typeTuple | typeRecord
  | typeVariant | typeNominal | typeMu | typeThunk | typeCallable | typeAll
  | typeContinuation | typeEvidence
  | tuple | sequence | record | variant | nominal | lambda | delay | wrap
  | typeAbstract | typeApply | inject | both | roll | top | valueView | continuation
  | evidenceAbstract | graphReference
  | ret | bind | force | call | resume | split | field | lookup | switch | unroll
  | choose | unionCase | absurd | primitive | perform | handle | mapop | recBlock
  | template | fail | bad | evidenceApply | release
  | scope | expose | enter | tryArm | waitArm | request | operationInstance
  | handlerDeclaration | valueArm | operationArm | mapper | directEvidence
  | adminEffect | adminResult | fieldDeclaration | variantDeclaration

mutual
  inductive Raw where
    | var (space : Space) (index : Nat)
    | atom (atom : Atom)
    | node (tag : Tag) (children : Forest)
    | bind (space : Space) (body : Raw)
  inductive Forest where
    | nil
    | cons (head : Raw) (tail : Forest)
end

def Forest.one (x : Raw) : Forest := .cons x .nil
def Forest.two (x y : Raw) : Forest := .cons x (.cons y .nil)

def rawLet (m n : Raw) : Raw := .node .bind (.two m (.bind .value n))
def rawDelay (m : Raw) : Raw := .node .delay (.one m)
def rawRet (v : Raw) : Raw := .node .ret (.one v)
def rawForce (v : Raw) : Raw := .node .force (.one v)

/-- One stored underlying value. The two evidence children are derivations/views
of THIS child, not two independent values. The typing rule must enforce this. -/
def rawBoth (v leftEvidence rightEvidence : Raw) : Raw :=
  .node .both (.cons v (.two leftEvidence rightEvidence))

/-- Payload and response reference one shared operation-instance child. -/
def rawOperationInstance (operation : Nat) (typeArguments : Forest) : Raw :=
  .node .operationInstance (.cons (.atom (.identity .operation operation)) typeArguments)

/-! Explicit binder convention:
let/lambda/continuation: one value binder; eabs: one evidence binder.
The source eabs formal is a term-level dictionary value. A future lexical
encoding must map occurrences resolved to that formal to evidence index0,
shift only for nested evidence binders, and preserve separately resolved value
locals. Eapp must substitute its argument in that evidence namespace. This
encoding/typing is not yet defined or used by the proved fragment.

All/typeAbstract/mu: one type binder; split and recBlock: nested value binders
in declaration order, with ALL recursive RHSs beneath the same binder block.
Polymorphic arms put their rigid type binders outside the paired instance,
payload and continuation formal binders. Control binders are separate; existing
immutable identity atoms are not in that substitution namespace.
Malformed arity, mismatched namespace and invalid evidence are representable.
Full constructor well-formedness/typing is not claimed by this raw grammar. -/

/-- Explicit original fragment for the first extrinsic substitution proof.
It embeds below into Raw. Other raw constructors remain present and OPEN. -/
inductive Ty where
  | base (kind : Base)
  | thunk (result : Ty)
  | union (left right : Ty)
  | intersection (left right : Ty)
  | top | bottom

mutual
  inductive Val where
    | var (index : Nat)
    | unit
    | bool (value : Bool)
    | int (value : Int)
    | floatBits (value : UInt64)
    | string (value : String)
    | bytes (value : List UInt8)
    | path (value : List UInt8)
    | char (value : String)
    | delay (body : Comp)
    | inLeft (value : Val)
    | inRight (value : Val)
    | both (value : Val)
    | top (value : Val)
  inductive Comp where
    | ret (value : Val)
    | force (value : Val)
    | bind (first body : Comp)
    | unionCase (value : Val) (left right : Comp)
    | chooseLeft (value : Val)
    | chooseRight (value : Val)
    | absurd (value : Val)
end

/-- The base and value representation preserve the existing literal domains. -/
def Literal.base : Literal → Base
  | .unit => .unit
  | .bool _ => .bool
  | .int _ => .int
  | .floatBits _ => .float
  | .string _ => .string
  | .bytes _ => .bytes
  | .path _ => .path
  | .char _ => .char

def Literal.toVal : Literal → Val
  | .unit => .unit
  | .bool v => .bool v
  | .int v => .int v
  | .floatBits v => .floatBits v
  | .string v => .string v
  | .bytes v => .bytes v
  | .path v => .path v
  | .char v => .char v

/-- This computational image erases ONLY the two Prop typing derivations.
The single underlying child is retained; no runtime View/receipt is erased.
Full rawBoth with explicit evidence remains available outside this fragment. -/
def rawProofBoth (v : Raw) : Raw := .node .both (.one v)
def rawTop (v : Raw) : Raw := .node .top (.one v)
def rawIn (right : Bool) (v : Raw) : Raw :=
  .node .inject (.two (.atom (.presence right)) v)
def rawChoose (right : Bool) (v : Raw) : Raw :=
  .node .choose (.two (.atom (.presence right)) v)
def rawUnionCase (v l r : Raw) : Raw :=
  .node .unionCase (.cons v (.two (.bind .value l) (.bind .value r)))
def rawAbsurd (v : Raw) : Raw := .node .absurd (.one v)

mutual
  def Val.raw : Val → Raw
    | .var i => .var .value i
    | .unit => .atom (.literal .unit)
    | .bool v => .atom (.literal (.bool v))
    | .int v => .atom (.literal (.int v))
    | .floatBits v => .atom (.literal (.floatBits v))
    | .string v => .atom (.literal (.string v))
    | .bytes v => .atom (.literal (.bytes v))
    | .path v => .atom (.literal (.path v))
    | .char v => .atom (.literal (.char v))
    | .delay m => rawDelay m.raw
    | .inLeft v => rawIn false v.raw
    | .inRight v => rawIn true v.raw
    | .both v => rawProofBoth v.raw
    | .top v => rawTop v.raw
  def Comp.raw : Comp → Raw
    | .ret v => rawRet v.raw
    | .force v => rawForce v.raw
    | .bind m n => rawLet m.raw n.raw
    | .unionCase v l r => rawUnionCase v.raw l.raw r.raw
    | .chooseLeft v => rawChoose false v.raw
    | .chooseRight v => rawChoose true v.raw
    | .absurd v => rawAbsurd v.raw
end

abbrev Context := Nat → Option Ty

def emptyContext : Context := fun _ => none

def extend (env : Context) (a : Ty) : Context
  | 0 => some a
  | n+1 => env n

mutual
  inductive ValTyped : Context → Val → Ty → Prop
    | var : env i = some a → ValTyped env (.var i) a
    | unit : ValTyped env .unit (.base .unit)
    | bool : ValTyped env (.bool v) (.base .bool)
    | int : ValTyped env (.int v) (.base .int)
    | floatBits : ValTyped env (.floatBits v) (.base .float)
    | string : ValTyped env (.string v) (.base .string)
    | bytes : ValTyped env (.bytes v) (.base .bytes)
    | path : ValTyped env (.path v) (.base .path)
    | char : ValTyped env (.char v) (.base .char)
    | delay : CompTyped env m a → ValTyped env (.delay m) (.thunk a)
    | inLeft : ValTyped env v a → ValTyped env (.inLeft v) (.union a b)
    | inRight : ValTyped env v b → ValTyped env (.inRight v) (.union a b)
    | both : ValTyped env v a → ValTyped env v b →
        ValTyped env (.both v) (.intersection a b)
    | top : ValTyped env v a → ValTyped env (.top v) .top
  inductive CompTyped : Context → Comp → Ty → Prop
    | ret : ValTyped env v a → CompTyped env (.ret v) a
    | force : ValTyped env v (.thunk a) → CompTyped env (.force v) a
    | bind : CompTyped env m a → CompTyped (extend env a) n b →
        CompTyped env (.bind m n) b
    | unionCase : ValTyped env v (.union a b) →
        CompTyped (extend env a) l c → CompTyped (extend env b) r c →
        CompTyped env (.unionCase v l r) c
    | chooseLeft : ValTyped env v (.intersection a b) → CompTyped env (.chooseLeft v) a
    | chooseRight : ValTyped env v (.intersection a b) → CompTyped env (.chooseRight v) b
    | absurd : ValTyped env v .bottom → CompTyped env (.absurd v) a
end

end YulangClosure.Original

/-! A source-derived typed Call fragment.  This is deliberately separate from
`Original.Comp`: the older public fragment has no callable, wrap, request or
failure constructors.  Bodies and adapters below retain their real
`Original.CompTyped` derivations instead of being opaque code labels. -/
namespace YulangClosure.TypedCall

open YulangClosure.Original

inductive CallType where
  | callable (argument result : Original.Ty)
  | thunk (result : Original.Ty)

inductive PortKind where
  | carrier | callEffect | result
  deriving DecidableEq

/-- A source path is a sequence of structural component labels followed by a
typed semantic port. -/
structure PortPath where
  components : List Nat
  port : PortKind
  type : Original.Ty

structure ViewOccurrence where
  identity : Nat
  path : PortPath

inductive PathRule : PortPath → PortPath → Prop where
  | identity (p : PortPath) : PathRule p p
  | prefix (label : Nat) (p q : PortPath) :
      PathRule p q → PathRule ⟨label :: p.components, p.port, p.type⟩
        ⟨label :: q.components, q.port, q.type⟩
  | adapterMap (mappingIdentity : Nat) (p q : PortPath) : PathRule p q

/-- Correspondence is explicit source-plan data.  Equal endpoint types alone
do not create a correspondence edge. -/
structure PathCorrespondence where
  source : PortPath
  target : PortPath
  rule : PathRule source target

structure OperationInstance where
  operation : Nat
  typeArguments : List Original.Ty
  payloadType : Original.Ty
  responseType : Original.Ty

/-! Call values/computations use a separate finite syntax so delayed adapters
remain values even when their code can request or fail. Closed Original values
are embedded explicitly; lexical Call binders use this fragment's variables. -/
mutual
  inductive Value where
    | var (index : Nat)
    | original (value : Original.Val)
    | delay (body : Comp)
    | view (value : Value) (occurrence : ViewOccurrence)
  inductive Comp where
    | original (body : Original.Comp)
    | ret (value : Value)
    | bind (first body : Comp)
    | force (value : Value)
    | scope (owner : Nat) (body : Comp)
    | expose (effectView resultView : ViewOccurrence) (body : Comp)
    | request (opInstance : OperationInstance) (payload : Value)
        (savedContinuation : Comp)
    | fail (reason : Original.Failure)
end

mutual
  inductive ValueTyped : Original.Context → Value → Original.Ty → Prop where
    | var : env index = some type → ValueTyped env (.var index) type
    | original : Original.ValTyped Original.emptyContext value type →
        ValueTyped env (.original value) type
    | delay : CompTyped env body result →
        ValueTyped env (.delay body) (.thunk result)
    | view : ValueTyped env value type →
        ValueTyped env (.view value occurrence) type

  inductive CompTyped : Original.Context → Comp → Original.Ty → Prop where
    | original : Original.CompTyped Original.emptyContext body result →
        CompTyped env (.original body) result
    | ret : ValueTyped env value result → CompTyped env (.ret value) result
    | bind : CompTyped env first a → CompTyped (Original.extend env a) body result →
        CompTyped env (.bind first body) result
    | force : ValueTyped env value (.thunk result) →
        CompTyped env (.force value) result
    | scope : CompTyped env body result → CompTyped env (.scope owner body) result
    | expose (effectView resultView : ViewOccurrence) : CompTyped env body result →
        CompTyped env (.expose effectView resultView body) result
    | request : ValueTyped env payload opInstance.payloadType →
        CompTyped (Original.extend env opInstance.responseType) savedContinuation result →
        CompTyped env (.request opInstance payload savedContinuation) result
    | fail : CompTyped env (.fail reason) result
end

inductive ContextFrame where
  | bind (body : Comp)
  | scope (owner : Nat)
  | expose (effectView resultView : ViewOccurrence)
  | adapter (input output : Original.Ty) (body : Comp)

inductive ContextTyping : Original.Context → List ContextFrame →
    Original.Ty → Original.Ty → Prop where
  | nil : ContextTyping env [] a a
  | bind : CompTyped (Original.extend env a) body b →
      ContextTyping env frames b result →
      ContextTyping env (.bind body :: frames) a result
  | scope : ContextTyping env frames a result →
      ContextTyping env (.scope owner :: frames) a result
  | expose (effectView resultView : ViewOccurrence) :
      ContextTyping env frames a result →
      ContextTyping env (.expose effectView resultView :: frames) a result
  | adapter (hbody : CompTyped (Original.extend env a) body b) :
      ContextTyping env frames b result →
      ContextTyping env (.adapter a b body :: frames) a result

structure ReceiptSlot where
  slot : Nat
  path : PortPath

structure ReceiptTemplate where
  profile : List PortPath
  designatedSlots : List ReceiptSlot

structure InterfacePorts where
  interface : Nat
  callEffect : PortPath
  result : PortPath
  callEffectView : ViewOccurrence
  resultView : ViewOccurrence

/-- The metadata plan for one concrete wrap node.  Keeping the adapters beside
their interface prevents a parallel interface list from drifting away from
the source wrap spine. -/
structure Adapter where
  input : Original.Ty
  output : Original.Ty
  body : Comp
  typed : CompTyped (Original.extend Original.emptyContext input) body output
  pathCorrespondences : List PathCorrespondence
  capturedViews : List ViewOccurrence

structure InterfacePlan where
  ports : InterfacePorts
  argumentAdapter : Adapter
  resultAdapter : Adapter

/-- One source lambda leaf or a finite outer-to-inner wrap spine. -/
inductive Function where
  | lambda (mode : Original.Mode) (receipt : ReceiptTemplate)
      (argument bodyResult result : Original.Ty) (body : Comp)
      (resultConsumer : Adapter) : Function
  | wrap (inner : Function) (argumentAdapter resultAdapter : Adapter) : Function

inductive FunctionTyped : Function → Original.Ty → Original.Ty → Prop where
  | lambdaValue (receipt : ReceiptTemplate) (a bodyResult result : Original.Ty)
      (body : Comp) (resultConsumer : Adapter)
      (h : CompTyped
        (Original.extend Original.emptyContext a) body bodyResult)
      (hc : resultConsumer.input = bodyResult) (hr : resultConsumer.output = result) :
      FunctionTyped (.lambda .value receipt a bodyResult result body resultConsumer) a result
  | lambdaComputation (receipt : ReceiptTemplate) (a bodyResult result : Original.Ty)
      (body : Comp) (resultConsumer : Adapter)
      (h : CompTyped
        (Original.extend Original.emptyContext (.thunk a)) body bodyResult)
      (hc : resultConsumer.input = bodyResult) (hr : resultConsumer.output = result) :
      FunctionTyped (.lambda .computation receipt a bodyResult result body resultConsumer) a result
  | wrap {f : Function} {argumentAdapter resultAdapter : Adapter}
      {a b c d : Original.Ty}
      (hf : FunctionTyped f a b)
      (ha : argumentAdapter.input = c) (haOut : argumentAdapter.output = a)
      (hr : resultAdapter.input = b) (hrOut : resultAdapter.output = d) :
      FunctionTyped (.wrap f argumentAdapter resultAdapter) c d

/-- Immutable source projections used to tie Call metadata to the actual
function syntax. -/
def Function.sourceReceipt : Function → ReceiptTemplate
  | .lambda _ receipt _ _ _ _ _ => receipt
  | .wrap inner _ _ => sourceReceipt inner

def Function.wrapAdapters : Function → List (Adapter × Adapter)
  | .lambda _ _ _ _ _ _ _ => []
  | .wrap inner argumentAdapter resultAdapter =>
      (argumentAdapter, resultAdapter) :: wrapAdapters inner

/-- The receipt, owner, carrier paths, interface ports, adapter path maps and
captured views are frozen inputs to a Call execution. -/
structure CallView where
  receiverOwner : Nat
  sourceReceipt : ReceiptTemplate
  carrierOccurrences : List ViewOccurrence
  interfaces : List InterfacePlan
  adapterPaths : List PathCorrespondence
  capturedViews : List ViewOccurrence

structure Carrier where
  underlying : Value
  carrierType : Original.Ty
  typed : ValueTyped Original.emptyContext underlying carrierType
  occurrences : List ViewOccurrence
  receipts : List ReceiptSlot

/-- A represented source Call has one already selected receiver owner.  The
freshness premise is explicit input data and is not inferred from type equality. -/
structure CallTerm where
  function : Function
  argument : Carrier
  inputType : Original.Ty
  resultType : Original.Ty
  functionTyped : FunctionTyped function inputType resultType
  argumentIsThunk : argument.carrierType = .thunk inputType
  callView : CallView
  sourceReceiptMatches : function.sourceReceipt = callView.sourceReceipt
  wrapPlanMatches : function.wrapAdapters =
    callView.interfaces.map fun plan => (plan.argumentAdapter, plan.resultAdapter)
  activeOwners : List Nat
  receiverFresh : callView.receiverOwner ∉ activeOwners

inductive AdaptersTyped : List Adapter → Original.Ty → Original.Ty → Prop where
  | nil (a : Original.Ty) : AdaptersTyped [] a a
  | cons (adapter : Adapter) (rest : List Adapter)
      (first last middle : Original.Ty)
      (hAdapter : adapter.input = first) (hOutput : adapter.output = middle)
      (hRest : AdaptersTyped rest middle last) :
      AdaptersTyped (adapter :: rest) first last

/-- Typed Call zipper data.  `literalSuffix` is opaque here so the same source
context composes with the actual independently typed Control suffix without
rewriting or inspecting its constructors. -/
structure EvaluationContext (Suffix : Type) where
  activeHole : Comp
  holeType : Original.Ty
  holeTyped : CompTyped Original.emptyContext activeHole holeType
  frames : List ContextFrame
  contextResultType : Original.Ty
  contextTyped : ContextTyping Original.emptyContext frames holeType contextResultType
  pendingDelayedArguments : List Adapter
  pendingArgumentInput : Original.Ty
  pendingArgumentOutput : Original.Ty
  delayedArgumentsTyped : AdaptersTyped pendingDelayedArguments
    pendingArgumentInput pendingArgumentOutput
  bodyResultConsumer : Adapter
  bodyResultType : Original.Ty
  resultAdapterInput : Original.Ty
  resultType : Original.Ty
  bodyResultTyped : contextResultType = bodyResultType
  bodyConsumerInputTyped : bodyResultConsumer.input = bodyResultType
  bodyResultOutputTyped : bodyResultConsumer.output = resultAdapterInput
  pendingResultAdapters : List Adapter
  pendingResultOutput : Original.Ty
  pendingResultsTyped : AdaptersTyped pendingResultAdapters
    resultAdapterInput pendingResultOutput
  finalResultTyped : pendingResultOutput = resultType
  scopeOwner : Nat
  callView : CallView
  literalSuffix : Suffix

structure Request (Suffix World : Type) where
  opInstance : OperationInstance
  payload : Value
  payloadTyped : ValueTyped Original.emptyContext payload opInstance.payloadType
  resultType : Original.Ty
  savedContinuation : Comp
  continuationTyped : CompTyped
    (Original.extend Original.emptyContext opInstance.responseType)
    savedContinuation resultType
  callView : CallView
  scopeContext : List Nat
  viewContext : List ViewOccurrence
  currentWorld : World
  literalSuffix : Suffix

structure Failure where
  reason : Original.Failure

inductive Outcome (Suffix World : Type) where
  | returned (value : Value) (type : Original.Ty)
      (typed : ValueTyped Original.emptyContext value type)
      (currentWorld : World) (literalSuffix : Suffix)
  | requested (request : Request Suffix World)
  | failed (failure : Failure) (resultType : Original.Ty)
      (currentWorld : World) (literalSuffix : Suffix)

end YulangClosure.TypedCall

import YulangClosure.CoreSyntax

namespace YulangClosure.Original

abbrev Renaming := Space → Nat → Nat

def liftRenaming (bound : Space) (r : Renaming) : Renaming := fun s i =>
  if s = bound then match i with | 0 => 0 | n+1 => r s n + 1 else r s i

mutual
  def renameRaw (r : Renaming) : Raw → Raw
    | .var s i => .var s (r s i)
    | .atom a => .atom a
    | .node k xs => .node k (renameForest r xs)
    | .bind s t => .bind s (renameRaw (liftRenaming s r) t)
  def renameForest (r : Renaming) : Forest → Forest
    | .nil => .nil
    | .cons t ts => .cons (renameRaw r t) (renameForest r ts)
end

abbrev Substitution := Space → Nat → Raw

def liftSubstitution (bound : Space) (s : Substitution) : Substitution := fun k i =>
  if k = bound then
    match i with
    | 0 => .var k 0
    | n+1 => renameRaw (fun j x => if j = bound then x+1 else x) (s k n)
  else renameRaw (fun j x => if j = bound then x+1 else x) (s k i)

mutual
  def substituteRaw (s : Substitution) : Raw → Raw
    | .var k i => s k i
    | .atom a => .atom a
    | .node k xs => .node k (substituteForest s xs)
    | .bind k t => .bind k (substituteRaw (liftSubstitution k s) t)
  def substituteForest (s : Substitution) : Forest → Forest
    | .nil => .nil
    | .cons t ts => .cons (substituteRaw s t) (substituteForest s ts)
end

/-- Even a value inserted under a TYPE binder must shift its free type variables. -/
theorem binder_substitution (s : Substitution) (k : Space) (body : Raw) :
    substituteRaw s (.bind k body) =
      .bind k (substituteRaw (liftSubstitution k s) body) := rfl

theorem immutable_identity (s : Substitution) (k : IdentityKind) (n : Nat) :
    substituteRaw s (.atom (.identity k n)) = .atom (.identity k n) := rfl

theorem liftRenaming_identity (b : Space) :
    liftRenaming b (fun _ i => i) = (fun _ i => i) := by
  funext s i
  unfold liftRenaming
  split
  · cases i <;> rfl
  · rfl

theorem liftRenaming_composition (b : Space) (r t : Renaming) :
    liftRenaming b (fun s i => r s (t s i)) =
      (fun s i => liftRenaming b r s (liftRenaming b t s i)) := by
  funext s i
  by_cases h : s = b
  · subst s
    cases i <;> simp only [liftRenaming, ↓reduceIte]
  · simp only [liftRenaming, h, ↓reduceIte]

mutual
  theorem renameRaw_identity (t : Raw) : renameRaw (fun _ i => i) t = t := by
    cases t with
    | var => rfl
    | atom => rfl
    | node k xs => exact congrArg (Raw.node k) (renameForest_identity xs)
    | bind b t =>
      simp only [renameRaw, liftRenaming_identity, renameRaw_identity t]
  theorem renameForest_identity (ts : Forest) :
      renameForest (fun _ i => i) ts = ts := by
    cases ts with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons t ts =>
      simp only [renameForest, renameRaw_identity t, renameForest_identity ts]
end

mutual
  theorem renameRaw_composition (t : Raw) (r q : Renaming) :
      renameRaw r (renameRaw q t) = renameRaw (fun s i => r s (q s i)) t := by
    cases t with
    | var => rfl
    | atom => rfl
    | node k xs => exact congrArg (Raw.node k) (renameForest_composition xs r q)
    | bind b t =>
      simp only [renameRaw, renameRaw_composition t, liftRenaming_composition]
  theorem renameForest_composition (ts : Forest) (r q : Renaming) :
      renameForest r (renameForest q ts) = renameForest (fun s i => r s (q s i)) ts := by
    cases ts with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons t ts =>
      simp only [renameForest, renameRaw_composition t, renameForest_composition ts]
end

theorem liftSubstitution_identity (b : Space) :
    liftSubstitution b Raw.var = Raw.var := by
  funext s i
  by_cases h : s = b
  · subst s
    cases i <;> simp only [liftSubstitution, renameRaw, ↓reduceIte]
  · simp only [liftSubstitution, renameRaw, h, ↓reduceIte]

def shift (b : Space) : Renaming := fun s i => if s = b then i+1 else i

theorem lifted_shift (b : Space) (r : Renaming) :
    (fun s i => liftRenaming b r s (shift b s i)) =
      (fun s i => shift b s (r s i)) := by
  funext s i
  by_cases h : s = b <;> simp only [shift, liftRenaming, h, ↓reduceIte]

theorem lift_rename_substitution (b : Space) (r : Renaming) (s : Substitution) :
    (fun k i => renameRaw (liftRenaming b r) (liftSubstitution b s k i)) =
      liftSubstitution b (fun k i => renameRaw r (s k i)) := by
  funext k i
  by_cases h : k = b
  · subst k
    cases i with
    | zero => simp only [liftSubstitution, renameRaw, liftRenaming, ↓reduceIte]
    | succ i =>
      simp only [liftSubstitution, ↓reduceIte]
      change renameRaw (liftRenaming b r) (renameRaw (shift b) (s b i)) =
        renameRaw (shift b) (renameRaw r (s b i))
      rw [renameRaw_composition, renameRaw_composition, lifted_shift]
  · simp only [liftSubstitution, h, ↓reduceIte]
    change renameRaw (liftRenaming b r) (renameRaw (shift b) (s k i)) =
      renameRaw (shift b) (renameRaw r (s k i))
    rw [renameRaw_composition, renameRaw_composition, lifted_shift]

theorem lift_substitution_rename (b : Space) (s : Substitution) (r : Renaming) :
    (fun k i => liftSubstitution b s k (liftRenaming b r k i)) =
      liftSubstitution b (fun k i => s k (r k i)) := by
  funext k i
  by_cases h : k = b
  · subst k
    cases i <;> simp only [liftSubstitution, liftRenaming, ↓reduceIte]
  · simp only [liftSubstitution, liftRenaming, h, ↓reduceIte]

mutual
  theorem rename_substitute (t : Raw) (r : Renaming) (s : Substitution) :
      renameRaw r (substituteRaw s t) =
        substituteRaw (fun k i => renameRaw r (s k i)) t := by
    cases t with
    | var => rfl
    | atom => rfl
    | node k xs => exact congrArg (Raw.node k) (rename_substitute_forest xs r s)
    | bind b t =>
      simp only [substituteRaw, renameRaw, rename_substitute t, lift_rename_substitution]
  theorem rename_substitute_forest (ts : Forest) (r : Renaming) (s : Substitution) :
      renameForest r (substituteForest s ts) =
        substituteForest (fun k i => renameRaw r (s k i)) ts := by
    cases ts with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons t ts =>
      simp only [substituteForest, renameForest, rename_substitute t, rename_substitute_forest ts]
end

mutual
  theorem substitute_rename (t : Raw) (s : Substitution) (r : Renaming) :
      substituteRaw s (renameRaw r t) =
        substituteRaw (fun k i => s k (r k i)) t := by
    cases t with
    | var => rfl
    | atom => rfl
    | node k xs => exact congrArg (Raw.node k) (substitute_rename_forest xs s r)
    | bind b t =>
      simp only [substituteRaw, renameRaw, substitute_rename t, lift_substitution_rename]
  theorem substitute_rename_forest (ts : Forest) (s : Substitution) (r : Renaming) :
      substituteForest s (renameForest r ts) =
        substituteForest (fun k i => s k (r k i)) ts := by
    cases ts with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons t ts =>
      simp only [substituteForest, renameForest, substitute_rename t, substitute_rename_forest ts]
end

theorem substitute_shift (t : Raw) (b : Space) (s : Substitution) :
    substituteRaw (liftSubstitution b s) (renameRaw (shift b) t) =
      renameRaw (shift b) (substituteRaw s t) := by
  rw [substitute_rename, rename_substitute]
  apply congrArg (fun σ => substituteRaw σ t)
  funext k i
  by_cases h : k = b <;> simp only [shift, liftSubstitution, h, ↓reduceIte] <;> rfl

theorem lift_substitution_composition (b : Space) (s q : Substitution) :
    (fun k i => substituteRaw (liftSubstitution b s) (liftSubstitution b q k i)) =
      liftSubstitution b (fun k i => substituteRaw s (q k i)) := by
  funext k i
  by_cases h : k = b
  · subst k
    cases i with
    | zero => simp only [liftSubstitution, substituteRaw, ↓reduceIte]
    | succ i =>
      simp only [liftSubstitution, ↓reduceIte]
      exact substitute_shift (q b i) b s
  · simp only [liftSubstitution, h, ↓reduceIte]
    exact substitute_shift (q k i) b s

mutual
  /-- Simultaneous substitution composes over the entire raw vocabulary,
  including nested value/type/evidence/control binders and unchanged atoms. -/
  theorem substituteRaw_composition (t : Raw) (s q : Substitution) :
      substituteRaw s (substituteRaw q t) =
        substituteRaw (fun k i => substituteRaw s (q k i)) t := by
    cases t with
    | var => rfl
    | atom => rfl
    | node k xs => exact congrArg (Raw.node k) (substituteForest_composition xs s q)
    | bind b t =>
      simp only [substituteRaw, substituteRaw_composition t, lift_substitution_composition]
  theorem substituteForest_composition (ts : Forest) (s q : Substitution) :
      substituteForest s (substituteForest q ts) =
        substituteForest (fun k i => substituteRaw s (q k i)) ts := by
    cases ts with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons t ts =>
      simp only [substituteForest, substituteRaw_composition t, substituteForest_composition ts]
end

mutual
  /-- Applies to every raw constructor, including all four binder namespaces.
  This is a syntax algebra theorem, not the missing full typing theorem. -/
  theorem substituteRaw_identity (t : Raw) : substituteRaw Raw.var t = t := by
    cases t with
    | var => rfl
    | atom => rfl
    | node k xs => exact congrArg (Raw.node k) (substituteForest_identity xs)
    | bind b t =>
      simp only [substituteRaw, liftSubstitution_identity, substituteRaw_identity t]
  theorem substituteForest_identity (ts : Forest) : substituteForest Raw.var ts = ts := by
    cases ts with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons t ts =>
      simp only [substituteForest, substituteRaw_identity t, substituteForest_identity ts]
end

/-- The executable full traversal above is not yet a full typed substitution theorem. -/
def up (r : Nat → Nat) : Nat → Nat | 0 => 0 | n+1 => r n + 1

mutual
  def renameVal (r : Nat → Nat) : Val → Val
    | .var i => .var (r i)
    | .unit => .unit
    | .bool v => .bool v
    | .int v => .int v
    | .floatBits v => .floatBits v
    | .string v => .string v
    | .bytes v => .bytes v
    | .path v => .path v
    | .char v => .char v
    | .delay m => .delay (renameComp r m)
    | .inLeft v => .inLeft (renameVal r v)
    | .inRight v => .inRight (renameVal r v)
    | .both v => .both (renameVal r v)
    | .top v => .top (renameVal r v)
  def renameComp (r : Nat → Nat) : Comp → Comp
    | .ret v => .ret (renameVal r v)
    | .force v => .force (renameVal r v)
    | .bind m n => .bind (renameComp r m) (renameComp (up r) n)
    | .unionCase v l body => .unionCase (renameVal r v) (renameComp (up r) l) (renameComp (up r) body)
    | .chooseLeft v => .chooseLeft (renameVal r v)
    | .chooseRight v => .chooseRight (renameVal r v)
    | .absurd v => .absurd (renameVal r v)
end

def lift (s : Nat → Val) : Nat → Val
  | 0 => .var 0
  | n+1 => renameVal Nat.succ (s n)

mutual
  def substVal (s : Nat → Val) : Val → Val
    | .var i => s i
    | .unit => .unit
    | .bool v => .bool v
    | .int v => .int v
    | .floatBits v => .floatBits v
    | .string v => .string v
    | .bytes v => .bytes v
    | .path v => .path v
    | .char v => .char v
    | .delay m => .delay (substComp s m)
    | .inLeft v => .inLeft (substVal s v)
    | .inRight v => .inRight (substVal s v)
    | .both v => .both (substVal s v)
    | .top v => .top (substVal s v)
  def substComp (s : Nat → Val) : Comp → Comp
    | .ret v => .ret (substVal s v)
    | .force v => .force (substVal s v)
    | .bind m n => .bind (substComp s m) (substComp (lift s) n)
    | .unionCase v l r => .unionCase (substVal s v) (substComp (lift s) l) (substComp (lift s) r)
    | .chooseLeft v => .chooseLeft (substVal s v)
    | .chooseRight v => .chooseRight (substVal s v)
    | .absurd v => .absurd (substVal s v)
end

mutual
  theorem renameVal_typed (h : ValTyped env v a)
      (hr : ∀ i, target (r i) = env i) : ValTyped target (renameVal r v) a := by
    cases h with
    | var he => exact .var ((hr _).trans he)
    | unit => exact .unit
    | bool => exact .bool
    | int => exact .int
    | floatBits => exact .floatBits
    | string => exact .string
    | bytes => exact .bytes
    | path => exact .path
    | char => exact .char
    | delay hm => exact .delay (renameComp_typed hm hr)
    | inLeft hv => exact .inLeft (renameVal_typed hv hr)
    | inRight hv => exact .inRight (renameVal_typed hv hr)
    | top hv => exact .top (renameVal_typed hv hr)
    | both ha hb => exact .both (renameVal_typed ha hr) (renameVal_typed hb hr)
  theorem renameComp_typed (h : CompTyped env m a)
      (hr : ∀ i, target (r i) = env i) : CompTyped target (renameComp r m) a := by
    cases h with
    | ret hv => exact .ret (renameVal_typed hv hr)
    | force hv => exact .force (renameVal_typed hv hr)
    | chooseLeft hv => exact .chooseLeft (renameVal_typed hv hr)
    | chooseRight hv => exact .chooseRight (renameVal_typed hv hr)
    | absurd hv => exact .absurd (renameVal_typed hv hr)
    | unionCase hv hl hrbody =>
      apply CompTyped.unionCase (renameVal_typed hv hr)
      · apply renameComp_typed hl
        intro i
        cases i <;> simp [up, extend, hr]
      · apply renameComp_typed hrbody
        intro i
        cases i <;> simp [up, extend, hr]
    | bind hm hn =>
      apply CompTyped.bind (renameComp_typed hm hr)
      apply renameComp_typed hn
      intro i
      cases i <;> simp [up, extend, hr]
end

mutual
  theorem substVal_typed (h : ValTyped env v a)
      (hs : ∀ i a, env i = some a → ValTyped target (s i) a) :
      ValTyped target (substVal s v) a := by
    cases h with
    | var he => exact hs _ _ he
    | unit => exact .unit
    | bool => exact .bool
    | int => exact .int
    | floatBits => exact .floatBits
    | string => exact .string
    | bytes => exact .bytes
    | path => exact .path
    | char => exact .char
    | delay hm => exact .delay (substComp_typed hm hs)
    | inLeft hv => exact .inLeft (substVal_typed hv hs)
    | inRight hv => exact .inRight (substVal_typed hv hs)
    | top hv => exact .top (substVal_typed hv hs)
    | both ha hb => exact .both (substVal_typed ha hs) (substVal_typed hb hs)
  theorem substComp_typed (h : CompTyped env m a)
      (hs : ∀ i a, env i = some a → ValTyped target (s i) a) :
      CompTyped target (substComp s m) a := by
    cases h with
    | ret hv => exact .ret (substVal_typed hv hs)
    | force hv => exact .force (substVal_typed hv hs)
    | chooseLeft hv => exact .chooseLeft (substVal_typed hv hs)
    | chooseRight hv => exact .chooseRight (substVal_typed hv hs)
    | absurd hv => exact .absurd (substVal_typed hv hs)
    | unionCase hv hl hrbody =>
      apply CompTyped.unionCase (substVal_typed hv hs)
      · apply substComp_typed hl
        intro i a he
        cases i with
        | zero =>
          simp only [extend, Option.some.injEq] at he
          subst a
          exact .var rfl
        | succ i => exact renameVal_typed (hs i a he) (fun _ => rfl)
      · apply substComp_typed hrbody
        intro i a he
        cases i with
        | zero =>
          simp only [extend, Option.some.injEq] at he
          subst a
          exact .var rfl
        | succ i => exact renameVal_typed (hs i a he) (fun _ => rfl)
    | bind hm hn =>
      apply CompTyped.bind (substComp_typed hm hs)
      apply substComp_typed hn
      intro i a he
      cases i with
      | zero =>
        simp only [extend, Option.some.injEq] at he
        subst a
        exact .var rfl
      | succ i => exact renameVal_typed (hs i a he) (fun _ => rfl)
end

def single (v : Val) : Nat → Val | 0 => v | n+1 => .var n

theorem substitute_top (hn : CompTyped (extend env a) n b) (hv : ValTyped env v a) :
    CompTyped env (substComp (single v) n) b := by
  apply substComp_typed hn
  intro i a he
  cases i with
  | zero =>
    simp only [extend, Option.some.injEq] at he
    subst a
    exact hv
  | succ i => exact .var he

mutual
  theorem renameVal_raw (v : Val) (r : Nat → Nat) (q : Renaming)
      (hq : ∀ i, q .value i = r i) :
      renameRaw q v.raw = (renameVal r v).raw := by
    cases v with
    | var i => simp only [Val.raw, renameVal, renameRaw, hq]
    | unit => rfl
    | bool v => rfl
    | int v => rfl
    | floatBits v => rfl
    | string v => rfl
    | bytes v => rfl
    | path v => rfl
    | char v => rfl
    | inLeft v =>
      simp only [Val.raw, renameVal, rawIn, Forest.two, renameRaw, renameForest,
        renameVal_raw v r q hq]
    | inRight v =>
      simp only [Val.raw, renameVal, rawIn, Forest.two, renameRaw, renameForest,
        renameVal_raw v r q hq]
    | both v =>
      simp only [Val.raw, renameVal, rawProofBoth, Forest.one, renameRaw, renameForest,
        renameVal_raw v r q hq]
    | top v =>
      simp only [Val.raw, renameVal, rawTop, Forest.one, renameRaw, renameForest,
        renameVal_raw v r q hq]
    | delay m =>
      simpa only [Val.raw, rawDelay, Forest.one, renameRaw, renameForest, renameVal]
        using congrArg (fun x => rawDelay x) (renameComp_raw m r q hq)
  theorem renameComp_raw (m : Comp) (r : Nat → Nat) (q : Renaming)
      (hq : ∀ i, q .value i = r i) :
      renameRaw q m.raw = (renameComp r m).raw := by
    cases m with
    | ret v =>
      simpa only [Comp.raw, rawRet, Forest.one, renameRaw, renameForest, renameComp]
        using congrArg rawRet (renameVal_raw v r q hq)
    | force v =>
      simpa only [Comp.raw, rawForce, Forest.one, renameRaw, renameForest, renameComp]
        using congrArg rawForce (renameVal_raw v r q hq)
    | chooseLeft v =>
      simp only [Comp.raw, renameComp, rawChoose, Forest.two, renameRaw, renameForest,
        renameVal_raw v r q hq]
    | chooseRight v =>
      simp only [Comp.raw, renameComp, rawChoose, Forest.two, renameRaw, renameForest,
        renameVal_raw v r q hq]
    | absurd v =>
      simp only [Comp.raw, renameComp, rawAbsurd, Forest.one, renameRaw, renameForest,
        renameVal_raw v r q hq]
    | unionCase v l rbody =>
      have hu : ∀ i, liftRenaming .value q .value i = up r i := by
        intro i
        cases i <;> simp only [liftRenaming, up, ↓reduceIte, hq]
      simp only [Comp.raw, renameComp, rawUnionCase, Forest.two, renameRaw, renameForest,
        renameVal_raw v r q hq, renameComp_raw l (up r) (liftRenaming .value q) hu,
        renameComp_raw rbody (up r) (liftRenaming .value q) hu]
    | bind m n =>
      have hu : ∀ i, liftRenaming .value q .value i = up r i := by
        intro i
        cases i <;> simp only [liftRenaming, up, ↓reduceIte, hq]
      simp only [Comp.raw, rawLet, Forest.two, renameRaw, renameForest, renameComp,
        renameComp_raw m r q hq, renameComp_raw n (up r) (liftRenaming .value q) hu]
end

mutual
  /-- The typed-fragment substitution really is the full raw traversal on its
  embedding. This supplies the executable substitution used by raw beta rules. -/
  theorem substVal_raw (v : Val) (s : Nat → Val) (q : Substitution)
      (hq : ∀ i, q .value i = (s i).raw) :
      substituteRaw q v.raw = (substVal s v).raw := by
    cases v with
    | var i => exact hq i
    | unit => rfl
    | bool v => rfl
    | int v => rfl
    | floatBits v => rfl
    | string v => rfl
    | bytes v => rfl
    | path v => rfl
    | char v => rfl
    | inLeft v =>
      simp only [Val.raw, substVal, rawIn, Forest.two, substituteRaw, substituteForest,
        substVal_raw v s q hq]
    | inRight v =>
      simp only [Val.raw, substVal, rawIn, Forest.two, substituteRaw, substituteForest,
        substVal_raw v s q hq]
    | both v =>
      simp only [Val.raw, substVal, rawProofBoth, Forest.one, substituteRaw, substituteForest,
        substVal_raw v s q hq]
    | top v =>
      simp only [Val.raw, substVal, rawTop, Forest.one, substituteRaw, substituteForest,
        substVal_raw v s q hq]
    | delay m =>
      simpa only [Val.raw, rawDelay, Forest.one, substituteRaw, substituteForest, substVal]
        using congrArg rawDelay (substComp_raw m s q hq)
  theorem substComp_raw (m : Comp) (s : Nat → Val) (q : Substitution)
      (hq : ∀ i, q .value i = (s i).raw) :
      substituteRaw q m.raw = (substComp s m).raw := by
    cases m with
    | ret v =>
      simpa only [Comp.raw, rawRet, Forest.one, substituteRaw, substituteForest, substComp]
        using congrArg rawRet (substVal_raw v s q hq)
    | force v =>
      simpa only [Comp.raw, rawForce, Forest.one, substituteRaw, substituteForest, substComp]
        using congrArg rawForce (substVal_raw v s q hq)
    | chooseLeft v =>
      simp only [Comp.raw, substComp, rawChoose, Forest.two, substituteRaw, substituteForest,
        substVal_raw v s q hq]
    | chooseRight v =>
      simp only [Comp.raw, substComp, rawChoose, Forest.two, substituteRaw, substituteForest,
        substVal_raw v s q hq]
    | absurd v =>
      simp only [Comp.raw, substComp, rawAbsurd, Forest.one, substituteRaw, substituteForest,
        substVal_raw v s q hq]
    | unionCase v l rbody =>
      have hu : ∀ i, liftSubstitution .value q .value i = (lift s i).raw := by
        intro i
        cases i with
        | zero => rfl
        | succ i =>
          simp only [liftSubstitution, ↓reduceIte, hq, lift]
          exact renameVal_raw (s i) Nat.succ _ (fun _ => rfl)
      simp only [Comp.raw, substComp, rawUnionCase, Forest.two, substituteRaw, substituteForest,
        substVal_raw v s q hq, substComp_raw l (lift s) (liftSubstitution .value q) hu,
        substComp_raw rbody (lift s) (liftSubstitution .value q) hu]
    | bind m n =>
      have hu : ∀ i, liftSubstitution .value q .value i = (lift s i).raw := by
        intro i
        cases i with
        | zero => rfl
        | succ i =>
          simp only [liftSubstitution, ↓reduceIte, hq, lift]
          exact renameVal_raw (s i) Nat.succ _ (fun _ => rfl)
      simp only [Comp.raw, rawLet, Forest.two, substituteRaw, substituteForest, substComp,
        substComp_raw m s q hq, substComp_raw n (lift s) (liftSubstitution .value q) hu]
end

def rawSingle (v : Raw) : Substitution := fun space i =>
  if space = .value then match i with | 0 => v | n+1 => .var .value n
  else .var space i

theorem single_raw (m : Comp) (v : Val) :
    substituteRaw (rawSingle v.raw) m.raw = (substComp (single v) m).raw := by
  apply substComp_raw
  intro i
  cases i <;> rfl

end YulangClosure.Original

namespace YulangClosure.TypedCall

open YulangClosure.Original

/-- Standard de Bruijn lifting for the finite Call fragment. -/
def upCall (r : Nat → Nat) : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => 0
  | n + 1 => r n + 1

mutual
  def renameCallValue (r : Nat → Nat) : Value → Value
    | .var i => .var (r i)
    | .original value => .original value
    | .delay body => .delay (renameCallComp r body)
    | .view value occurrence => .view (renameCallValue r value) occurrence
  def renameCallComp (r : Nat → Nat) : Comp → Comp
    | .original body => .original body
    | .ret value => .ret (renameCallValue r value)
    | .bind first body => .bind (renameCallComp r first)
        (renameCallComp (upCall r) body)
    | .force value => .force (renameCallValue r value)
    | .scope owner body => .scope owner (renameCallComp r body)
    | .expose effectView resultView body =>
        .expose effectView resultView (renameCallComp r body)
    | .request opInstance payload continuation =>
        .request opInstance (renameCallValue r payload)
          (renameCallComp (upCall r) continuation)
    | .fail reason => .fail reason
end

mutual
  theorem renameCallValue_typed {env target : Original.Context} {r : Nat → Nat}
      {value : Value} {a : Original.Ty} (h : ValueTyped env value a)
      (hr : ∀ i, target (r i) = env i) :
      ValueTyped target (renameCallValue r value) a := by
    cases h with
    | var he => exact .var ((hr _).trans he)
    | original hv => exact .original hv
    | delay hc => exact .delay (renameCallComp_typed hc hr)
    | view hv => exact .view (renameCallValue_typed hv hr)
  theorem renameCallComp_typed {env target : Original.Context} {r : Nat → Nat}
      {body : Comp} {a : Original.Ty} (h : CompTyped env body a)
      (hr : ∀ i, target (r i) = env i) :
      CompTyped target (renameCallComp r body) a := by
    cases h with
    | original hc => exact .original hc
    | ret hv => exact .ret (renameCallValue_typed hv hr)
    | bind hm hn =>
        exact .bind (renameCallComp_typed hm hr) (renameCallComp_typed hn (by
          intro i
          cases i <;> simp [upCall, Original.extend, hr]))
    | force hv => exact .force (renameCallValue_typed hv hr)
    | scope hc => exact .scope (renameCallComp_typed hc hr)
    | expose effectView resultView hc =>
        exact .expose effectView resultView (renameCallComp_typed hc hr)
    | request hp hk =>
        exact .request (renameCallValue_typed hp hr)
          (renameCallComp_typed hk (by
            intro i
            cases i <;> simp [upCall, Original.extend, hr]))
    | fail => exact .fail
end

/-- Lift a value substitution through a Call-local value binder. -/
def liftCallSubstitution (s : Nat → Value) : Nat → Value
  | 0 => .var 0
  | n + 1 => renameCallValue Nat.succ (s n)

mutual
  def substituteCallValue (s : Nat → Value) : Value → Value
    | .var i => s i
    | .original value => .original value
    | .delay body => .delay (substituteCallComp s body)
    | .view value occurrence => .view (substituteCallValue s value) occurrence
  def substituteCallComp (s : Nat → Value) : Comp → Comp
    | .original body => .original body
    | .ret value => .ret (substituteCallValue s value)
    | .bind first body => .bind (substituteCallComp s first)
        (substituteCallComp (liftCallSubstitution s) body)
    | .force value => .force (substituteCallValue s value)
    | .scope owner body => .scope owner (substituteCallComp s body)
    | .expose effectView resultView body =>
        .expose effectView resultView (substituteCallComp s body)
    | .request opInstance payload continuation =>
        .request opInstance (substituteCallValue s payload)
          (substituteCallComp (liftCallSubstitution s) continuation)
    | .fail reason => .fail reason
end

private theorem liftedCallSubstitution_typed
    {env target : Original.Context} {s : Nat → Value} {a : Original.Ty}
    (hs : ∀ i ty, env i = some ty → ValueTyped target (s i) ty) :
    ∀ i ty, (Original.extend env a) i = some ty →
      ValueTyped (Original.extend target a) (liftCallSubstitution s i) ty := by
  intro i ty hi
  cases i with
  | zero =>
      simp only [Original.extend, Option.some.injEq] at hi
      subst ty
      exact .var rfl
  | succ i =>
      have he : env i = some ty := hi
      exact renameCallValue_typed (hs i ty he) (by intro j; rfl)

mutual
  theorem substituteCallValue_typed {env target : Original.Context} {s : Nat → Value}
      {value : Value} {a : Original.Ty} (h : ValueTyped env value a)
      (hs : ∀ i ty, env i = some ty → ValueTyped target (s i) ty) :
      ValueTyped target (substituteCallValue s value) a := by
    cases h with
    | var he => exact hs _ _ he
    | original hv => exact .original hv
    | delay hc => exact .delay (substituteCallComp_typed hc hs)
    | view hv => exact .view (substituteCallValue_typed hv hs)
  theorem substituteCallComp_typed {env target : Original.Context} {s : Nat → Value}
      {body : Comp} {a : Original.Ty} (h : CompTyped env body a)
      (hs : ∀ i ty, env i = some ty → ValueTyped target (s i) ty) :
      CompTyped target (substituteCallComp s body) a := by
    cases h with
    | original hc => exact .original hc
    | ret hv => exact .ret (substituteCallValue_typed hv hs)
    | bind hm hn =>
        exact .bind (substituteCallComp_typed hm hs)
          (substituteCallComp_typed (s := liftCallSubstitution s) hn
            (liftedCallSubstitution_typed hs))
    | force hv => exact .force (substituteCallValue_typed hv hs)
    | scope hc => exact .scope (substituteCallComp_typed hc hs)
    | expose effectView resultView hc =>
        exact .expose effectView resultView (substituteCallComp_typed hc hs)
    | request hp hk =>
        exact .request (substituteCallValue_typed hp hs)
          (substituteCallComp_typed (s := liftCallSubstitution s) hk
            (liftedCallSubstitution_typed hs))
    | fail => exact .fail
end

/-- Adapter and Computation-entry substitutions share the actual Call syntax
traversal above, whose closed Original subterms are retained verbatim. -/
def executeAdapterBody (adapter : Adapter) (value : Value) : Comp :=
  substituteCallComp (fun i => if i = 0 then value else .var (i - 1)) adapter.body

theorem executeAdapterBody_typed (adapter : Adapter) (value : Value)
    (hv : ValueTyped Original.emptyContext value adapter.input) :
    CompTyped Original.emptyContext (executeAdapterBody adapter value) adapter.output := by
  apply substituteCallComp_typed adapter.typed
  intro i ty hi
  cases i with
  | zero => simp only [Original.extend, Option.some.injEq] at hi; subst ty; exact hv
  | succ i => exact .var hi

/-- Computation entry substitutes the received thunk carrier itself. -/
def computationEntryBody (body : Comp) (carrier : Value) : Comp :=
  substituteCallComp (fun i => if i = 0 then carrier else .var (i - 1)) body

theorem computationEntryBody_typed {a b : Original.Ty} {body : Comp}
    (bodyTyped : CompTyped
      (Original.extend Original.emptyContext (.thunk a)) body b)
    {carrier : Value}
    (carrierTyped : ValueTyped Original.emptyContext carrier (.thunk a)) :
    CompTyped Original.emptyContext (computationEntryBody body carrier) b := by
  apply substituteCallComp_typed bodyTyped
  intro i ty hi
  cases i with
  | zero => simp only [Original.extend, Option.some.injEq] at hi; subst ty; exact carrierTyped
  | succ i => exact .var hi

end YulangClosure.TypedCall

import YulangClosure.CoreSubstitution
import YulangClosure.Contracts

namespace YulangClosure.Original

/-- Actual original principal reductions, restricted to the explicitly typed fragment.
No premise here asserts preservation. -/
inductive Principal : Comp → Comp → Prop
  | letReturn : Principal (.bind (.ret v) n) (substComp (single v) n)
  | forceDelay : Principal (.force (.delay m)) m
  | unionLeft : Principal (.unionCase (.inLeft v) l r) (substComp (single v) l)
  | unionRight : Principal (.unionCase (.inRight v) l r) (substComp (single v) r)
  | chooseLeft : Principal (.chooseLeft (.both v)) (.ret v)
  | chooseRight : Principal (.chooseRight (.both v)) (.ret v)

theorem principal_preservation (step : Principal m n) (ht : CompTyped env m a) :
    CompTyped env n a := by
  cases step with
  | letReturn =>
    cases ht with
    | bind hm hn =>
      cases hm with
      | ret hv => exact substitute_top hn hv
  | forceDelay =>
    cases ht with
    | force hv =>
      cases hv with
      | delay hm => exact hm
  | unionLeft =>
    cases ht with
    | unionCase hv hl hr =>
      cases hv with
      | inLeft hv => exact substitute_top hl hv
  | unionRight =>
    cases ht with
    | unionCase hv hl hr =>
      cases hv with
      | inRight hv => exact substitute_top hr hv
  | chooseLeft =>
    cases ht with
    | chooseLeft hv =>
      cases hv with
      | both ha hb => exact .ret ha
  | chooseRight =>
    cases ht with
    | chooseRight hv =>
      cases hv with
      | both ha hb => exact .ret hb

/-- These are syntax-bearing frames, not opaque registered body opcodes. -/
inductive Frame where
  | bind : Comp → Frame

inductive FramesTyped (env : Context) : List Frame → Ty → Ty → Prop
  | nil : FramesTyped env [] a a
  | cons : CompTyped (extend env a) n b → FramesTyped env fs b result →
      FramesTyped env (.bind n :: fs) a result

structure State where
  current : Comp
  stack : List Frame

def StateTyped (env : Context) (result : Ty) (s : State) : Prop :=
  ∃ a, CompTyped env s.current a ∧ FramesTyped env s.stack a result

/-- Entry really changes the stack. The saved suffix is literally retained. -/
inductive Step : State → State → Prop
  | enter : Step ⟨.bind m n, fs⟩ ⟨m, .bind n :: fs⟩
  | returnBind : Step ⟨.ret v, .bind n :: fs⟩ ⟨substComp (single v) n, fs⟩
  | principal : Principal m n → Step ⟨m, fs⟩ ⟨n, fs⟩

theorem step_preservation (h : Step s t) (ht : StateTyped env result s) :
    StateTyped env result t := by
  rcases ht with ⟨a, hm, hfs⟩
  cases h with
  | enter =>
    cases hm with
    | bind first body => exact ⟨_, first, .cons body hfs⟩
  | returnBind =>
    cases hm with
    | ret hv =>
      cases hfs with
      | cons body tail => exact ⟨_, substitute_top body hv, tail⟩
  | principal hp => exact ⟨_, principal_preservation hp hm, hfs⟩

inductive Steps : Nat → State → State → Prop
  | refl : Steps 0 s s
  | snoc : Steps n s t → Step t u → Steps (n+1) s u

theorem finite_preservation (h : Steps n s t) (ht : StateTyped env result s) :
    StateTyped env result t := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact ht
  | snoc hp hx ih => exact step_preservation hx (ih ht)

theorem closed_thunk (hv : ValTyped emptyContext v (.thunk a)) :
    ∃ m, v = .delay m ∧ CompTyped emptyContext m a := by
  cases hv with
  | var he => cases he
  | delay hm => exact ⟨_, rfl, hm⟩

theorem closed_union (hv : ValTyped emptyContext v (.union a b)) :
    (∃ w, v = .inLeft w ∧ ValTyped emptyContext w a) ∨
    (∃ w, v = .inRight w ∧ ValTyped emptyContext w b) := by
  cases hv with
  | var he => cases he
  | inLeft h => exact .inl ⟨_, rfl, h⟩
  | inRight h => exact .inr ⟨_, rfl, h⟩

theorem closed_intersection (hv : ValTyped emptyContext v (.intersection a b)) :
    ∃ w, v = .both w ∧ ValTyped emptyContext w a ∧ ValTyped emptyContext w b := by
  cases hv with
  | var he => cases he
  | both ha hb => exact ⟨_, rfl, ha, hb⟩

theorem closed_bottom (hv : ValTyped emptyContext v .bottom) : False := by
  cases hv with
  | var he => cases he

/-- A closed typed fragment state either returns a typed value at the empty
stack or has a concrete next transition. No body-progress premise is used. -/
theorem progress (ht : StateTyped emptyContext result s) :
    (∃ v, s = ⟨.ret v, []⟩ ∧ ValTyped emptyContext v result) ∨ ∃ t, Step s t := by
  cases s with | mk m fs =>
    obtain ⟨a, hm, hs⟩ := ht
    cases hm with
    | ret hv =>
      cases hs with
      | nil => exact .inl ⟨_, rfl, hv⟩
      | cons hn tail => exact .inr ⟨_, .returnBind⟩
    | force hv =>
      obtain ⟨m, rfl, hm⟩ := closed_thunk hv
      exact .inr ⟨_, .principal .forceDelay⟩
    | bind hm hn => exact .inr ⟨_, .enter⟩
    | unionCase hv hl hr =>
      cases closed_union hv with
      | inl h =>
        obtain ⟨v, rfl, hv⟩ := h
        exact .inr ⟨_, .principal .unionLeft⟩
      | inr h =>
        obtain ⟨v, rfl, hv⟩ := h
        exact .inr ⟨_, .principal .unionRight⟩
    | chooseLeft hv =>
      obtain ⟨v, rfl, ha, hb⟩ := closed_intersection hv
      exact .inr ⟨_, .principal .chooseLeft⟩
    | chooseRight hv =>
      obtain ⟨v, rfl, ha, hb⟩ := closed_intersection hv
      exact .inr ⟨_, .principal .chooseRight⟩
    | absurd hv => exact (closed_bottom hv).elim

theorem finite_safety (trace : YulangClosure.Prefix Step n s t)
    (ht : StateTyped emptyContext result s) :
    StateTyped emptyContext result t ∧
      ((∃ v, t = ⟨.ret v, []⟩ ∧ ValTyped emptyContext v result) ∨ ∃ u, Step t u) := by
  have htyped : StateTyped emptyContext result t := by
    induction trace with
    | refl => exact ht
    | snoc hp hx ih => exact step_preservation hx (ih ht)
  exact ⟨htyped, progress htyped⟩

/-- Raw syntax counterpart of the actual let entry, with an arbitrary existing
raw frame suffix. It does not manufacture a Core-to-control Nat cast. -/
inductive RawFrame where
  | bind : Raw → RawFrame

inductive RawEntry : Raw × List RawFrame → Raw × List RawFrame → Prop
  | bind : RawEntry (rawLet m n, fs) (m, .bind n :: fs)

def Frame.raw : Frame → RawFrame
  | .bind n => .bind n.raw

theorem entry_correspondence (m n : Comp) (fs : List Frame) :
    RawEntry ((Comp.bind m n).raw, fs.map Frame.raw)
      (m.raw, RawFrame.bind n.raw :: fs.map Frame.raw) := .bind

abbrev RawState := Raw × List RawFrame

def State.raw (s : State) : RawState := (s.current.raw, s.stack.map Frame.raw)

def rawBad : Raw := .node .bad .nil

/-- Raw principal/entry rules for this source fragment. Malformed Force really
reaches Bad; it is not removed by an intrinsic typing index. Other original
constructors require their own raw rules before a whole-language claim. -/
inductive RawStep : RawState → RawState → Prop
  | enter : RawStep (rawLet m n, fs) (m, .bind n :: fs)
  | returnBind : RawStep (rawRet v, .bind n :: fs)
      (substituteRaw (rawSingle v) n, fs)
  | letReturn : RawStep (rawLet (rawRet v) n, fs)
      (substituteRaw (rawSingle v) n, fs)
  | forceDelay : RawStep (rawForce (rawDelay m), fs) (m, fs)
  | unionLeft : RawStep (rawUnionCase (rawIn false v) l r, fs)
      (substituteRaw (rawSingle v) l, fs)
  | unionRight : RawStep (rawUnionCase (rawIn true v) l r, fs)
      (substituteRaw (rawSingle v) r, fs)
  | chooseLeft : RawStep (rawChoose false (rawProofBoth v), fs) (rawRet v, fs)
  | chooseRight : RawStep (rawChoose true (rawProofBoth v), fs) (rawRet v, fs)
  | unionUnitBad : RawStep (rawUnionCase (.atom (.literal .unit)) l r, fs) (rawBad, fs)
  | chooseUnitBad : RawStep (rawChoose side (.atom (.literal .unit)), fs) (rawBad, fs)
  | absurdUnitBad : RawStep (rawAbsurd (.atom (.literal .unit)), fs) (rawBad, fs)
  /-- This known wrong constructor is rejected. No rule declares View/graph/
  type-application operands bad merely because their surface is not Delay. -/
  | forceUnitBad : RawStep (rawForce (.atom (.literal .unit)), fs) (rawBad, fs)
  | badFrame : RawStep (rawBad, f :: fs) (rawBad, fs)

theorem step_raw (h : Step s t) : RawStep s.raw t.raw := by
  cases h with
  | enter => exact .enter
  | returnBind =>
    simp only [State.raw, Comp.raw, List.map_cons, Frame.raw]
    rw [← single_raw]
    exact .returnBind
  | principal hp =>
    cases hp with
    | letReturn =>
      simp only [State.raw, Comp.raw]
      rw [← single_raw]
      exact .letReturn
    | forceDelay => exact .forceDelay
    | unionLeft =>
      simp only [State.raw, Comp.raw, Val.raw]
      rw [← single_raw]
      exact .unionLeft
    | unionRight =>
      simp only [State.raw, Comp.raw, Val.raw]
      rw [← single_raw]
      exact .unionRight
    | chooseLeft => exact .chooseLeft
    | chooseRight => exact .chooseRight

/-- Backwards step correspondence, crucial for safety of RAW execution rather
than just its chosen typed reduction. Every possible raw step from a closed
typed image is an actual typed-fragment step. -/
theorem raw_step_lifts (ht : StateTyped emptyContext result s)
    (hx : RawStep s.raw r) : ∃ t, r = t.raw ∧ Step s t := by
  cases s with | mk m fs =>
    obtain ⟨a, hm, hs⟩ := ht
    cases hm with
    | ret hv =>
      cases fs with
      | nil => cases hx
      | cons f fs =>
        cases f with | bind n =>
          cases hx
          exact ⟨_, by simp only [State.raw, single_raw], .returnBind⟩
    | force hv =>
      obtain ⟨m, rfl, hm⟩ := closed_thunk hv
      cases hx with
      | forceDelay => exact ⟨_, rfl, .principal .forceDelay⟩
    | bind hm hn =>
      cases hm with
      | ret hv =>
        cases hx with
        | enter => exact ⟨_, rfl, .enter⟩
        | letReturn =>
          exact ⟨_, by simp only [State.raw, single_raw], .principal .letReturn⟩
      | force hv =>
        cases hx
        exact ⟨_, rfl, .enter⟩
      | bind hm hn =>
        cases hx
        exact ⟨_, rfl, .enter⟩
      | unionCase hv hl hr =>
        cases hx
        exact ⟨_, rfl, .enter⟩
      | chooseLeft hv =>
        cases hx
        exact ⟨_, rfl, .enter⟩
      | chooseRight hv =>
        cases hx
        exact ⟨_, rfl, .enter⟩
      | absurd hv =>
        cases hx
        exact ⟨_, rfl, .enter⟩
    | unionCase hv hl hr =>
      cases closed_union hv with
      | inl h =>
        obtain ⟨v, rfl, hv⟩ := h
        cases hx with
        | unionLeft =>
          exact ⟨_, by simp only [State.raw, single_raw], .principal .unionLeft⟩
      | inr h =>
        obtain ⟨v, rfl, hv⟩ := h
        cases hx with
        | unionRight =>
          exact ⟨_, by simp only [State.raw, single_raw], .principal .unionRight⟩
    | chooseLeft hv =>
      obtain ⟨v, rfl, ha, hb⟩ := closed_intersection hv
      cases hx with
      | chooseLeft => exact ⟨_, rfl, .principal .chooseLeft⟩
    | chooseRight hv =>
      obtain ⟨v, rfl, ha, hb⟩ := closed_intersection hv
      cases hx with
      | chooseRight => exact ⟨_, rfl, .principal .chooseRight⟩
    | absurd hv => exact (closed_bottom hv).elim

def RawStateTyped (result : Ty) (r : RawState) : Prop :=
  ∃ s, r = s.raw ∧ StateTyped emptyContext result s

theorem raw_preservation (ht : RawStateTyped result r) (hx : RawStep r u) :
    RawStateTyped result u := by
  obtain ⟨s, rfl, hs⟩ := ht
  obtain ⟨t, he, hstep⟩ := raw_step_lifts hs hx
  exact ⟨t, he, step_preservation hstep hs⟩

theorem raw_not_bad (ht : RawStateTyped result r) : r.1 ≠ rawBad := by
  obtain ⟨s, rfl, hs⟩ := ht
  cases s with | mk m fs =>
    cases m <;> intro he <;> cases he

theorem raw_progress (ht : RawStateTyped result r) :
    (∃ v, r = (rawRet v.raw, []) ∧ ValTyped emptyContext v result) ∨
      ∃ u, RawStep r u := by
  obtain ⟨s, rfl, hs⟩ := ht
  cases progress hs with
  | inl hr =>
    obtain ⟨v, rfl, hv⟩ := hr
    exact .inl ⟨v, rfl, hv⟩
  | inr hs =>
    obtain ⟨t, hx⟩ := hs
    exact .inr ⟨t.raw, step_raw hx⟩

/-- A theorem about ALL raw traces, including the raw Bad rules. Its initial
typing is an independent syntax image, not reachability or absence of Bad. -/
theorem raw_finite_safety (ht : RawStateTyped result r)
    (trace : YulangClosure.Prefix RawStep n r u) :
    RawStateTyped result u ∧ u.1 ≠ rawBad ∧
      ((∃ v, u = (rawRet v.raw, []) ∧ ValTyped emptyContext v result) ∨
        ∃ z, RawStep u z) := by
  have typed : RawStateTyped result u := by
    induction trace with
    | refl => exact ht
    | snoc hp hx ih => exact raw_preservation (ih ht) hx
  exact ⟨typed, raw_not_bad typed, raw_progress typed⟩
