namespace YulangClosure.TypedCall

open YulangClosure.Original

/-- Peeling a wrap constructs the source-specified inert thunk.  The adapter
body remains syntax under its value binder; it is not run while peeling. -/
def delayArgument (carrier : Value) (adapter : Adapter) : Value :=
  .delay (.bind (.force carrier) adapter.body)

/-- Value entry forces the received carrier only after receipt attachment. -/
def valueEntryBody (carrier : Value) (body : Comp) : Comp :=
  .bind (.force carrier) body

/-- The source lambda's immutable receipt slots are attached before entry. The
underlying carrier remains the same value; the explicit slots are retained as
observation-path metadata on the Carrier. -/
def attachReceipt (carrier : Carrier) (receipt : ReceiptTemplate) : Carrier :=
  { carrier with receipts := carrier.receipts ++ receipt.designatedSlots }

def plugFrame : ContextFrame → Comp → Comp
  | .bind body, hole => .bind hole body
  | .scope owner, hole => .scope owner hole
  | .expose effectView resultView, hole => .expose effectView resultView hole
  | .adapter _ _ body, hole => .bind hole body

/-- The list is ordered from the active hole outwards. -/
def plugFrames : List ContextFrame → Comp → Comp
  | [], hole => hole
  | frame :: frames, hole => plugFrames frames (plugFrame frame hole)

/-- Pending result adapters execute in their stored inner-to-outer order. -/
def plugResultAdapters : List Adapter → Comp → Comp
  | [], body => body
  | adapter :: adapters, body =>
      plugResultAdapters adapters (.bind body adapter.body)

/-- Compose the declared-result consumer followed by adapters already stored
inner-to-outer by wrap peeling. -/
def consumeCallResult (body : Comp) (consumer : Adapter)
    (pending : List Adapter) : Comp :=
  plugResultAdapters pending (.bind body consumer.body)

/-- Build the actual source entry computation. Value entry forces only after
receipt attachment; Computation entry substitutes the received thunk. -/
def callEntryBody (mode : Original.Mode) (carrier : Value) (body : Comp)
    (consumer : Adapter) (pending : List Adapter) : Comp :=
  let entered := match mode with
    | .value => valueEntryBody carrier body
    | .computation => computationEntryBody body carrier
  consumeCallResult entered consumer pending

/-- Plugging follows the actual typed hole through the active evaluation
context, then the declared-result consumer and pending result adapters. -/
def plugEvaluationContext {Suffix : Type} (context : EvaluationContext Suffix)
    (hole : Comp) : Comp :=
  plugResultAdapters context.pendingResultAdapters
    (.bind (plugFrames context.frames hole)
      context.bodyResultConsumer.body)

end YulangClosure.TypedCall

import YulangClosure.Contracts
import YulangClosure.CoreExecution

namespace YulangClosure.Control

inductive Value where
  | atom (tag data : Nat)
  | no
  | yes (value : Value)
  /-- A value in the explicitly proved Original fragment, retained as syntax. -/
  | originalValue (value : Original.Val)

structure Operation where
  family : Nat
  instanceId : Nat
  payload : Nat
  response : Nat
  deriving DecidableEq

structure Arm where
  operation : Operation
  code : Nat

structure Handler where
  identity : Nat
  input : Nat
  output : Nat
  valueArms : List Nat
  arms : List Arm

structure Mapper where
  source : Operation
  target : Operation
  payloadCode : Nat
  responseCode : Nat

mutual
  inductive Kont where
    | mk (input : Nat) (frames : List Frame)
  inductive Packet where
    | mk (event : Nat) (operation : Operation) (payload : Value) (saved : Kont)
  inductive Pending where
    | value (value : Value) (remaining : List Nat)
    | request (packet : Packet)
  inductive Action where
    | code (label : Nat)
    | mapped (mapper : Mapper) (original : Packet)
    | response (mapper : Mapper) (original : Kont)
    | enterSaved (mapper : Mapper) (original : Kont)
  inductive Frame where
    | bind (action : Action)
    | scope (owner : Nat)
    | view (identity : Nat)
    | handle (handler : Handler)
    | mapop (mapper : Mapper)
    | wait (handler : Handler) (original : Pending) (remaining : List Arm)
    | release (target : Nat)
    /-- A source bind frame in the delimited Original fragment. -/
    | originalBind (body : Original.Comp)
    /-- Typed Call frames remain executable syntax while using the existing
        metadata world operations for failure propagation. -/
    | typedCallBind (body : TypedCall.Comp)
    | typedCallAdapter (input output : Original.Ty) (body : TypedCall.Comp)
    /-- Metatheoretic delimiter between source frames and a foreign suffix. -/
    | originalBoundary
end

def Kont.input : Kont → Nat | .mk q _ => q
def Kont.frames : Kont → List Frame | .mk _ fs => fs
def Kont.append (k : Kont) (f : Frame) : Kont := .mk k.input (k.frames ++ [f])
def Packet.operation : Packet → Operation | .mk _ q _ _ => q
def Packet.saved : Packet → Kont | .mk _ _ _ k => k

def Packet.capture : Packet → Frame → Packet
  | .mk e q p k, f => .mk e q p (k.append f)

inductive Head where
  | ret (value : Value)
  /-- Original computations remain their actual syntax during source execution. -/
  | original (computation : Original.Comp)
  | req (packet : Packet)
  | fail (reason : Nat)
  | bad (reason : Nat)
  /-- Registered code may have ordinary Ret/Req/Fail/Bad exits. -/
  | run (label : Nat) (arguments : List Value) (saved : Option Kont)
  | search (handler : Handler) (original : Pending) (remaining : List Arm)

structure State (World : Type) where
  world : World
  head : Head
  stack : List Frame

/-- Only current-world metadata operations, not control transfer or typing laws. -/
structure Metadata (World : Type) where
  scopeReturn : World → Nat → World
  viewReturn : World → Nat → World
  suspendScope : World → Nat → World
  suspendView : World → Nat → World
  releaseCross : World → Nat → Packet → World
  eligible : World → Handler → Arm → Packet → Bool
  /-- Fail cleanup is observationally unspecified in the frozen core. -/
  failWorld : World → Frame → World → Prop
  failWorld_total : ∀ w f, ∃ w', failWorld w f w'

/-- Actual source-derived Call phases.  The Call execution stack is separate
from the independently typed Control suffix carried by `CallState`. -/
inductive CallHead where
  | call (term : TypedCall.CallTerm)
  | enter (function : TypedCall.Function) (carrier : TypedCall.Value)
      (pendingResults : List TypedCall.Adapter)
  | received (function : TypedCall.Function) (carrier : TypedCall.Value)
      (pendingResults : List TypedCall.Adapter)
  | active (computation : TypedCall.Comp)
  | originalState (state : Original.State)
  | returned (value : TypedCall.Value)
  | requesting (opInstance : TypedCall.OperationInstance) (payload : TypedCall.Value)
      (continuation : TypedCall.Comp) (observedViews : List TypedCall.ViewOccurrence)
  | requested (opInstance : TypedCall.OperationInstance) (payload : TypedCall.Value)
      (continuation : TypedCall.Comp)
  | failed (reason : Original.Failure)

structure CallState (World : Type) where
  world : World
  head : CallHead
  frames : List TypedCall.ContextFrame
  callView : TypedCall.CallView
  resultType : Original.Ty
  scopeContext : List Nat
  viewContext : List TypedCall.ViewOccurrence
  receiptSlots : List TypedCall.ReceiptSlot
  literalSuffix : List Frame

def CallState.suffixViewIds : List Frame → List Nat
  | [] => []
  | .view identity :: frames => identity :: suffixViewIds frames
  | _ :: frames => suffixViewIds frames

def CallState.initial {World : Type} (term : TypedCall.CallTerm) (world : World)
    (suffix : List Frame) : CallState World :=
  ⟨world, .call term, [], term.callView, term.resultType, [],
    term.argument.occurrences ++ term.callView.capturedViews,
    term.argument.receipts, suffix⟩

def CallState.captureBind (continuation body : TypedCall.Comp) : TypedCall.Comp :=
  .bind continuation (TypedCall.renameCallComp (TypedCall.upCall Nat.succ) body)

def CallState.contextControlFrame : TypedCall.ContextFrame → Frame
  | .bind body => .typedCallBind body
  | .scope owner => .scope owner
  | .expose effectView _ => .view effectView.identity
  | .adapter input output body => .typedCallAdapter input output body

def CallState.activeViews (frames : List TypedCall.ContextFrame) :
    List TypedCall.ViewOccurrence :=
  frames.filterMap fun frame =>
    match frame with
    | .expose effectView _ => some effectView
    | _ => none

/-- The source Call and all its administrative/body transitions are reachable
with a literal independently typed Control suffix.  Metadata operations are
the already existing Control world operations; this relation introduces no
new failure cleanup or event policy. -/
inductive CallControlStep {World : Type} (md : Metadata World) :

  | start (term : TypedCall.CallTerm) (world : World) (suffix : List Frame) :
      CallControlStep md (CallState.initial term world suffix)
        ⟨world, .enter term.function term.argument.underlying [],
          (term.callView.interfaces.reverse.map fun interface =>
            TypedCall.ContextFrame.expose interface.ports.callEffectView
              interface.ports.resultView) ++
            [.scope term.callView.receiverOwner],
          term.callView, term.resultType, [],
          term.argument.occurrences ++ term.callView.capturedViews,
          term.argument.receipts, suffix⟩

      CallControlStep md

          frames, view, result, scopes, views, receipts, suffix⟩
        ⟨world, .enter inner (TypedCall.delayArgument carrier argumentAdapter)

      CallControlStep md

      (suffix : List Frame) :
      CallControlStep md
        ⟨world, .active (.ret value), .expose effectView resultView :: frames,
          view, result, scopes, views, receipts, suffix⟩
        ⟨md.viewReturn world resultView.identity, .active (.ret (.view value resultView)),
          frames, view, result, scopes, views, receipts, suffix⟩
  | requestBind (world : World) (opInstance : TypedCall.OperationInstance)
      (payload : TypedCall.Value) (continuation body : TypedCall.Comp)
      (observed : List TypedCall.ViewOccurrence)
      (frames : List TypedCall.ContextFrame) (view : TypedCall.CallView)
      (result : Original.Ty) (scopes : List Nat)
      (views : List TypedCall.ViewOccurrence) (receipts : List TypedCall.ReceiptSlot)
      (suffix : List Frame) :
      CallControlStep md
        ⟨world, .requesting opInstance payload continuation observed,
          .bind body :: frames, view, result, scopes, views, receipts, suffix⟩
        ⟨world, .requesting opInstance payload
          (CallState.captureBind continuation body) observed,
          frames, view, result, scopes, views, receipts, suffix⟩
  | requestAdapter (world : World) (opInstance : TypedCall.OperationInstance)
      (payload : TypedCall.Value) (continuation : TypedCall.Comp)
      (observed : List TypedCall.ViewOccurrence)
      (input output : Original.Ty) (body : TypedCall.Comp)
      (frames : List TypedCall.ContextFrame) (view : TypedCall.CallView)
      (result : Original.Ty) (scopes : List Nat)
      (views : List TypedCall.ViewOccurrence) (receipts : List TypedCall.ReceiptSlot)
      (suffix : List Frame) :
      CallControlStep md
        ⟨world, .requesting opInstance payload continuation observed,
          .adapter input output body :: frames, view, result, scopes, views, receipts,
          suffix⟩
        ⟨world, .requesting opInstance payload
          (CallState.captureBind continuation body) observed,
          frames, view, result, scopes, views, receipts, suffix⟩
  | requestScope (world : World) (owner : Nat)
      (opInstance : TypedCall.OperationInstance) (payload : TypedCall.Value)
      (continuation : TypedCall.Comp)
      (observed : List TypedCall.ViewOccurrence)
      (frames : List TypedCall.ContextFrame) (view : TypedCall.CallView)
      (result : Original.Ty) (scopes : List Nat)
      (views : List TypedCall.ViewOccurrence) (receipts : List TypedCall.ReceiptSlot)
      (suffix : List Frame) :
      CallControlStep md
        ⟨world, .requesting opInstance payload continuation observed,
          .scope owner :: frames, view, result, scopes, views, receipts, suffix⟩
        ⟨md.suspendScope world owner,
          .requesting opInstance payload (.scope owner continuation) observed, frames,
          view, result, owner :: scopes, views, receipts, suffix⟩
  | requestExpose (world : World) (effectView resultView : TypedCall.ViewOccurrence)
      (opInstance : TypedCall.OperationInstance) (payload : TypedCall.Value)
      (continuation : TypedCall.Comp)
      (observed : List TypedCall.ViewOccurrence)
      (frames : List TypedCall.ContextFrame) (view : TypedCall.CallView)
      (result : Original.Ty) (scopes : List Nat)
      (views : List TypedCall.ViewOccurrence) (receipts : List TypedCall.ReceiptSlot)
      (suffix : List Frame) :
      CallControlStep md
        ⟨world, .requesting opInstance payload continuation observed,
          .expose effectView resultView :: frames, view, result, scopes, views,
          receipts, suffix⟩
        ⟨md.suspendView world effectView.identity,
          .requesting opInstance payload
            (.expose effectView resultView continuation) observed,
          frames, view, result, scopes, views, receipts, suffix⟩
  | failBind (world : World) (reason : Original.Failure) (body : TypedCall.Comp)
      (nextWorld : World) (cleanup : md.failWorld world (.typedCallBind body) nextWorld)
      (frames : List TypedCall.ContextFrame) (view : TypedCall.CallView)
      (result : Original.Ty) (scopes : List Nat)
      (views : List TypedCall.ViewOccurrence) (receipts : List TypedCall.ReceiptSlot)
      (suffix : List Frame) :
      CallControlStep md
        ⟨world, .active (.fail reason), .bind body :: frames, view, result, scopes,
          views, receipts, suffix⟩
        ⟨nextWorld, .active (.fail reason), frames, view, result, scopes, views,
          receipts, suffix⟩
  | failAdapter (world : World) (reason : Original.Failure)
      (input output : Original.Ty) (body : TypedCall.Comp)
      (nextWorld : World)
      (cleanup : md.failWorld world (.typedCallAdapter input output body) nextWorld)
      (frames : List TypedCall.ContextFrame) (view : TypedCall.CallView)
      (result : Original.Ty) (scopes : List Nat)
      (views : List TypedCall.ViewOccurrence) (receipts : List TypedCall.ReceiptSlot)
      (suffix : List Frame) :
      CallControlStep md
        ⟨world, .active (.fail reason), .adapter input output body :: frames,
          view, result, scopes, views, receipts, suffix⟩
        ⟨nextWorld, .active (.fail reason), frames, view, result, scopes, views,
          receipts, suffix⟩
  | failScope (world : World) (reason : Original.Failure) (owner : Nat)
      (nextWorld : World) (cleanup : md.failWorld world (.scope owner) nextWorld)
      (frames : List TypedCall.ContextFrame) (view : TypedCall.CallView)
      (result : Original.Ty) (scopes : List Nat)
      (views : List TypedCall.ViewOccurrence) (receipts : List TypedCall.ReceiptSlot)
      (suffix : List Frame) :
      CallControlStep md
        ⟨world, .active (.fail reason), .scope owner :: frames, view, result, scopes,
          views, receipts, suffix⟩
        ⟨nextWorld, .active (.fail reason), frames, view, result, scopes, views,
          receipts, suffix⟩
  | failExpose (world : World) (reason : Original.Failure)
      (effectView resultView : TypedCall.ViewOccurrence)
      (nextWorld : World)
      (cleanup : md.failWorld world (.view effectView.identity) nextWorld)
      (frames : List TypedCall.ContextFrame) (view : TypedCall.CallView)
      (result : Original.Ty) (scopes : List Nat)
      (views : List TypedCall.ViewOccurrence) (receipts : List TypedCall.ReceiptSlot)
      (suffix : List Frame) :
      CallControlStep md
        ⟨world, .active (.fail reason), .expose effectView resultView :: frames,
          view, result, scopes, views, receipts, suffix⟩
        ⟨nextWorld, .active (.fail reason), frames, view, result, scopes, views,
          receipts, suffix⟩
  | finishReturn (world : World) (value : TypedCall.Value)
      (view : TypedCall.CallView) (result : Original.Ty) (scopes : List Nat)
      (views : List TypedCall.ViewOccurrence) (receipts : List TypedCall.ReceiptSlot)
      (suffix : List Frame) :
      CallControlStep md
        ⟨world, .active (.ret value), [], view, result, scopes, views, receipts, suffix⟩
        ⟨world, .returned value, [], view, result, scopes, views, receipts, suffix⟩
  | finishRequest (world : World) (opInstance : TypedCall.OperationInstance)
      (payload : TypedCall.Value) (continuation : TypedCall.Comp)
      (observed : List TypedCall.ViewOccurrence)
      (view : TypedCall.CallView)
      (result : Original.Ty) (scopes : List Nat)
      (views : List TypedCall.ViewOccurrence) (receipts : List TypedCall.ReceiptSlot)
      (suffix : List Frame) :
      CallControlStep md
        ⟨world, .requesting opInstance payload continuation observed, [], view, result,
          scopes, views, receipts, suffix⟩
        ⟨world, .requested opInstance payload continuation, [], view, result, scopes,
          observed, receipts, suffix⟩
  | finishFailure (world : World) (reason : Original.Failure)
      (view : TypedCall.CallView) (result : Original.Ty) (scopes : List Nat)
      (views : List TypedCall.ViewOccurrence) (receipts : List TypedCall.ReceiptSlot)
      (suffix : List Frame) :
      CallControlStep md
        ⟨world, .active (.fail reason), [], view, result, scopes, views, receipts, suffix⟩
        ⟨world, .failed reason, [], view, result, scopes, views, receipts, suffix⟩

/-- Raw response checking is executable and admits ill-typed responses as Bad. -/
def responseOK (q : Nat) : Value → Bool
  | .atom tag _ => tag == q
  | _ => false

def resume (k : Kont) (value : Value) (world : W) : State W :=
  ⟨world, if responseOK k.input value then .ret value else .bad 0, k.frames⟩

/-- Seven-frame control dispatch. No typing premise occurs in these rules. -/
inductive ControlStep {W : Type} (md : Metadata W) : State W → State W → Prop
  | bindCode : ControlStep md ⟨w,.ret v,.bind (.code c)::fs⟩
      ⟨w,.run c [v] none,fs⟩
  | scopeRet : ControlStep md ⟨w,.ret v,.scope u::fs⟩
      ⟨md.scopeReturn w u,.ret v,fs⟩
  | viewRet : ControlStep md ⟨w,.ret v,.view x::fs⟩
      ⟨md.viewReturn w x,.ret v,fs⟩
  | handleRet : ControlStep md ⟨w,.ret v,.handle h::fs⟩
      ⟨w,.search h (.value v h.valueArms) [],fs⟩
  | mapRet : ControlStep md ⟨w,.ret v,.mapop m::fs⟩ ⟨w,.ret v,fs⟩
  | releaseRet : ControlStep md ⟨w,.ret v,.release t::fs⟩ ⟨w,.ret v,fs⟩
  | waitYes : ControlStep md ⟨w,.ret (.yes v),.wait h pending arms::fs⟩
      ⟨w,.ret v,fs⟩
  | waitNo : ControlStep md ⟨w,.ret .no,.wait h pending arms::fs⟩
      ⟨w,.search h pending arms,fs⟩
  | waitBad : ControlStep md ⟨w,.ret (.atom tag v),.wait h pending arms::fs⟩
      ⟨w,.bad 1,fs⟩
  | bindReq : ControlStep md ⟨w,.req p,.bind a::fs⟩
      ⟨w,.req (p.capture (.bind a)),fs⟩
  | scopeReq : ControlStep md ⟨w,.req p,.scope u::fs⟩
      ⟨md.suspendScope w u,.req (p.capture (.scope u)),fs⟩
  | viewReq : ControlStep md ⟨w,.req p,.view v::fs⟩
      ⟨md.suspendView w v,.req (p.capture (.view v)),fs⟩
  | handleReq : ControlStep md ⟨w,.req p,.handle h::fs⟩
      ⟨w,.search h (.request p) h.arms,fs⟩
  | waitReq : ControlStep md ⟨w,.req p,.wait h original arms::fs⟩
      ⟨w,.req (p.capture (.wait h original arms)),fs⟩
  | releaseReq : ControlStep md ⟨w,.req p,.release t::fs⟩
      ⟨md.releaseCross w t p,.req (p.capture (.release t)),fs⟩
  | mapMiss (hne : q ≠ m.source) :
      ControlStep md ⟨w,.req (.mk e q p k),.mapop m::fs⟩
        ⟨w,.req ((Packet.mk e q p k).capture (.mapop m)),fs⟩
  | mapHit : ControlStep md ⟨w,.req (.mk e m.source p k),.mapop m::fs⟩
      ⟨w,.run m.payloadCode [p] none,.bind (.mapped m (.mk e m.source p k))::fs⟩
  | mappedRet : ControlStep md
      ⟨w,.ret v,.bind (.mapped m (.mk e q p k))::fs⟩
      ⟨w,.req (.mk e m.target v (.mk m.target.response [.bind (.response m k)])),fs⟩
  | responseRet : ControlStep md ⟨w,.ret v,.bind (.response m k)::fs⟩
      ⟨w,.run m.responseCode [v] none,.bind (.enterSaved m k)::fs⟩
  /-- Administrative plugging, NOT a second raw Resume/freshening. -/
  | enterSavedRet : ControlStep md ⟨w,.ret v,.bind (.enterSaved m k)::fs⟩
      ⟨w,.ret v,k.frames ++ .mapop m::fs⟩
  | searchValueTry : ControlStep md ⟨w,.search h (.value v (code::rest)) [],fs⟩
      ⟨w,.run code [v] none,.wait h (.value v rest) []::fs⟩
  | searchValueEnd : ControlStep md ⟨w,.search h (.value v []) [],fs⟩
      ⟨w,.fail 0,fs⟩
  | searchRequestEnd : ControlStep md ⟨w,.search h (.request p) [],fs⟩
      ⟨w,.req (p.capture (.handle h)),fs⟩
  | skip (test : a.operation ≠ p.operation ∨ md.eligible w h a p = false) :
      ControlStep md ⟨w,.search h (.request p) (a::arms),fs⟩
        ⟨w,.search h (.request p) arms,fs⟩
  /-- Selected shallow arm receives original K, with no handle frame appended. -/
  | select (eq : a.operation = q) (yes : md.eligible w h a (.mk e q p k) = true) :
      ControlStep md ⟨w,.search h (.request (.mk e q p k)) (a::arms),fs⟩
        ⟨w,.run a.code [p] (some k),.wait h (.request (.mk e q p k)) arms::fs⟩
  | failRelease : ControlStep md ⟨w,.fail r,.release t::fs⟩ ⟨w,.fail r,fs⟩
  | failFrame (notRelease : ∀ t, f ≠ .release t) (hw : md.failWorld w f w') :
      ControlStep md ⟨w,.fail r,f::fs⟩ ⟨w',.fail r,fs⟩
  | badFrame : ControlStep md ⟨w,.bad r,f::fs⟩ ⟨w,.bad r,fs⟩
  | originalEnter : ControlStep md ⟨w,.original (.bind first body),fs⟩
      ⟨w,.original first,.originalBind body::fs⟩
  | originalReturnBind : ControlStep md
      ⟨w,.original (.ret value),.originalBind body::fs⟩
      ⟨w,.original (Original.substComp (Original.single value) body),fs⟩
  | originalPrincipal : Original.Principal first next → ControlStep md
      ⟨w,.original first,fs⟩ ⟨w,.original next,fs⟩
  | originalExit : ControlStep md
      ⟨w,.original (.ret value),.originalBoundary::fs⟩
      ⟨w,.ret (.originalValue value),fs⟩

/-- Principal-redex relation is limited to registered-code execution.
It cannot dispatch any frame or search state. -/
inductive Step {W : Type} (md : Metadata W)
    (body : W → Nat → List Value → Option Kont → W → Head → Prop) :
    State W → State W → Prop
  | control : ControlStep md s t → Step md body s t
  | body : body w code args saved w' h →
      Step md body ⟨w,.run code args saved,fs⟩ ⟨w',h,fs⟩

end YulangClosure.Control

import YulangClosure.ControlSyntax

namespace YulangClosure.Control

inductive Ty where
  | base (identity : Nat)
  | attempt (result : Ty)
  | original (source : Original.Ty)

inductive ValueTyped : Value → Ty → Prop
  | atom : ValueTyped (.atom t v) (.base t)
  | no : ValueTyped .no (.attempt t)
  | yes : ValueTyped v t → ValueTyped (.yes v) (.attempt t)
  | original : Original.ValTyped Original.emptyContext v a →
      ValueTyped (.originalValue v) (.original a)

/-- Extrinsic registered-body signature, not a whole-machine safety premise. -/
structure Signature where
  code : Nat → List Ty → Option (Ty × Ty) → Ty → Prop

mutual
  inductive FrameTyped (sig : Signature) : Frame → Ty → Ty → Prop
    | bind : sig.code c [a] none b → FrameTyped sig (.bind (.code c)) a b
    | scope : FrameTyped sig (.scope u) a a
    | view : FrameTyped sig (.view u) a a
    | release : FrameTyped sig (.release u) a a
    | handle : HandlerTyped sig h → FrameTyped sig (.handle h) (.base h.input) (.base h.output)
    | mapper : MapperTyped sig m → FrameTyped sig (.mapop m) a a
    | wait : HandlerTyped sig h → SearchTyped sig h p arms → FrameTyped sig (.wait h p arms) (.attempt (.base h.output)) (.base h.output)
    | mapped : MapperTyped sig m → PacketTyped sig (.mk e m.source p k) a →
        FrameTyped sig (.bind (.mapped m (.mk e m.source p k))) (.base m.target.payload) a
    | response : MapperTyped sig m → KontTyped sig k (.base m.source.response) a →
        FrameTyped sig (.bind (.response m k)) (.base m.target.response) a
    | enterSaved : MapperTyped sig m → KontTyped sig k (.base m.source.response) a →
        FrameTyped sig (.bind (.enterSaved m k)) (.base m.source.response) a
  inductive FramesTyped (sig : Signature) : List Frame → Ty → Ty → Prop
    | nil : FramesTyped sig [] a a
    | cons : FrameTyped sig f a b → FramesTyped sig fs b c → FramesTyped sig (f::fs) a c
  inductive KontTyped (sig : Signature) : Kont → Ty → Ty → Prop
    | mk : FramesTyped sig fs (.base q) a → KontTyped sig (.mk q fs) (.base q) a
  inductive PacketTyped (sig : Signature) : Packet → Ty → Prop
    | mk : ValueTyped p (.base q.payload) → KontTyped sig k (.base q.response) a →
        PacketTyped sig (.mk e q p k) a
  inductive ArmsTyped (sig : Signature) : Handler → List Arm → Prop
    | nil : ArmsTyped sig h []
    | cons : sig.code a.code [.base a.operation.payload]
          (some (.base a.operation.response, .base h.input)) (.attempt (.base h.output)) →
        ArmsTyped sig h as → ArmsTyped sig h (a::as)
  inductive ValueArmsTyped (sig : Signature) : Handler → List Nat → Prop
    | nil : ValueArmsTyped sig h []
    | cons : sig.code c [.base h.input] none (.attempt (.base h.output)) →
        ValueArmsTyped sig h cs → ValueArmsTyped sig h (c::cs)
  /-- Value and operation candidates have different raw positions and
      signatures. This is a raw-shape invariant, not a safety premise. -/
  inductive SearchTyped (sig : Signature) : Handler → Pending → List Arm → Prop
    | value : ValueTyped v (.base h.input) → ValueArmsTyped sig h cs →
        SearchTyped sig h (.value v cs) []
    | request : PacketTyped sig p (.base h.input) → ArmsTyped sig h arms →
        SearchTyped sig h (.request p) arms
  inductive HandlerTyped (sig : Signature) : Handler → Prop
    | mk : ValueArmsTyped sig h h.valueArms →
        ArmsTyped sig h h.arms → HandlerTyped sig h
  inductive MapperTyped (sig : Signature) : Mapper → Prop
    | mk : m.source.family = m.target.family →
        sig.code m.payloadCode [.base m.source.payload] none (.base m.target.payload) →
        sig.code m.responseCode [.base m.target.response] none (.base m.source.response) →
        MapperTyped sig m
end

inductive ArgsTyped : List Value → List Ty → Prop
  | nil : ArgsTyped [] []
  | cons : ValueTyped v a → ArgsTyped vs as → ArgsTyped (v::vs) (a::as)

inductive SavedTyped (sig : Signature) : Option Kont → Option (Ty × Ty) → Prop
  | none : SavedTyped sig none none
  | some : KontTyped sig k a b → SavedTyped sig (some k) (some (a,b))

/-- Typed witnesses for the actual Call phases. The result passed to the
independent suffix is always the Original result type of this Call. -/
inductive CallHeadTyped : CallHead → Original.Ty → Prop where
  | call (term : TypedCall.CallTerm) :
      CallHeadTyped (.call term) term.resultType
  | enter {function : TypedCall.Function} {carrier : TypedCall.Value}
      {pending : List TypedCall.Adapter} {input output final : Original.Ty}
      (hf : TypedCall.FunctionTyped function input output)
      (hc : TypedCall.ValueTyped Original.emptyContext carrier (.thunk input))
      (hp : TypedCall.AdaptersTyped pending output final) :
      CallHeadTyped (.enter function carrier pending) final
  | received {function : TypedCall.Function} {carrier : TypedCall.Value}
      {pending : List TypedCall.Adapter} {input output final : Original.Ty}
      (hf : TypedCall.FunctionTyped function input output)
      (hc : TypedCall.ValueTyped Original.emptyContext carrier (.thunk input))
      (hp : TypedCall.AdaptersTyped pending output final) :
      CallHeadTyped (.received function carrier pending) final
  | active : TypedCall.CompTyped Original.emptyContext computation type →
      CallHeadTyped (.active computation) type
  | originalState : Original.StateTyped Original.emptyContext type state →
      CallHeadTyped (.originalState state) type
  | returned : TypedCall.ValueTyped Original.emptyContext value type →
      CallHeadTyped (.returned value) type
  | requesting {opInstance : TypedCall.OperationInstance} {payload : TypedCall.Value}
      {continuation : TypedCall.Comp} {observed : List TypedCall.ViewOccurrence}
      (hp : TypedCall.ValueTyped Original.emptyContext payload opInstance.payloadType)
      (hk : TypedCall.CompTyped
        (Original.extend Original.emptyContext opInstance.responseType)
        continuation result) :
      CallHeadTyped (.requesting opInstance payload continuation observed) result
  | requested {opInstance : TypedCall.OperationInstance} {payload : TypedCall.Value}
      {continuation : TypedCall.Comp}
      (hp : TypedCall.ValueTyped Original.emptyContext payload opInstance.payloadType)
      (hk : TypedCall.CompTyped
        (Original.extend Original.emptyContext opInstance.responseType)
        continuation result) :
      CallHeadTyped (.requested opInstance payload continuation) result
  | failed (reason : Original.Failure) (result : Original.Ty) :
      CallHeadTyped (.failed reason) result

/-- The Call execution is attached to an independently typed and literally
retained Control suffix. -/
def CallStateTyped (sig : Signature) (state : CallState W) (result : Ty) : Prop :=
  ∃ activeType, CallHeadTyped state.head activeType ∧
    TypedCall.ContextTyping Original.emptyContext state.frames activeType
      state.resultType ∧
    FramesTyped sig state.literalSuffix (.original state.resultType) result

inductive HeadTyped (sig : Signature) : Head → Ty → Prop
  | ret : ValueTyped v a → HeadTyped sig (.ret v) a
  | req : PacketTyped sig p a → HeadTyped sig (.req p) a
  | fail : HeadTyped sig (.fail r) a
  | run : ArgsTyped args ts → SavedTyped sig saved st → sig.code c ts st a →
      HeadTyped sig (.run c args saved) a
  | search : HandlerTyped sig h → SearchTyped sig h p arms →
      HeadTyped sig (.search h p arms) (.base h.output)

/-- A concrete Original segment is typed by the original judgment and ends at
an explicit boundary before an independently typed legacy Control suffix. -/
def StateTyped (sig : Signature) (s : State W) (result : Ty) : Prop :=
  ∃ hole, HeadTyped sig s.head hole ∧ FramesTyped sig s.stack hole result

theorem frames_append {sig : Signature} (h : FramesTyped sig fs a b)
    (k : FramesTyped sig gs b c) : FramesTyped sig (fs ++ gs) a c := by
  induction fs generalizing a b with
  | nil => cases h; exact k
  | cons f fs ih =>
    cases h with | cons hf ht => exact .cons hf (ih ht k)

/-- The source bind frames retain their computations when embedded in Control. -/
def sourceFrameControl : Original.Frame → Frame
  | .bind body => .originalBind body

def sourceFramesControl (frames : List Original.Frame) : List Frame :=
  frames.map sourceFrameControl

/-- The embedded source segment ends at an explicit boundary, after which the
foreign Control suffix remains an ordinary, independently typed stack. -/
def sourceStackEmbedding (frames : List Original.Frame) (suffix : List Frame) : List Frame :=
  sourceFramesControl frames ++ [.originalBoundary] ++ suffix

inductive SegmentTyped (sig : Signature) : State W → Ty → Prop
  | intro (sourceResult : Original.Ty) (source : Original.State)
      (suffix : List Frame) {s : State W} {result : Ty}
      (head_eq : s.head = .original source.current)
      (stack_eq : s.stack = sourceStackEmbedding source.stack suffix)
      (source_typed : Original.StateTyped Original.emptyContext sourceResult source)
      (suffix_typed : FramesTyped sig suffix (.original sourceResult) result) :
      SegmentTyped sig s result

theorem original_state_typed_with_suffix {sig : Signature} {s : Original.State}
    (hs : Original.StateTyped Original.emptyContext result s)
    (suffix : List Frame)
    (htail : FramesTyped sig suffix (.original result) final) (w : W) :
    SegmentTyped sig ⟨w, .original s.current, sourceStackEmbedding s.stack suffix⟩ final := by
  exact ⟨result, s, suffix, rfl, rfl, hs, htail⟩

theorem capture_typed {sig : Signature} (hk : KontTyped sig k q a)
    (hf : FrameTyped sig f a b) : KontTyped sig (k.append f) q b := by
  cases hk with
  | mk hs => exact .mk (frames_append hs (.cons hf .nil))

theorem packet_capture_typed {sig : Signature} (hp : PacketTyped sig p a)
    (hf : FrameTyped sig f a b) : PacketTyped sig (p.capture f) b := by
  cases hp with
  | mk hv hk => exact .mk hv (capture_typed hk hf)

theorem typed_not_bad {sig : Signature} {s : State W}
    (ht : StateTyped sig s a) : ∀ r, s.head ≠ .bad r := by
  obtain ⟨hole, hh, hs⟩ := ht
  intro r he
  rw [he] at hh
  cases hh

/-- Independent body-only obligations; no frame/search transfer is included. -/
structure BodyLaws {W : Type} (sig : Signature)
    (body : W → Nat → List Value → Option Kont → W → Head → Prop) where
  preservation : ∀ w c vs k w' h a,
    HeadTyped sig (.run c vs k) a → body w c vs k w' h → HeadTyped sig h a
  progress : ∀ w c vs k a, HeadTyped sig (.run c vs k) a →
    ∃ w' h, body w c vs k w' h

end YulangClosure.Control

import YulangClosure.ControlTyping
import YulangClosure.CoreComposition

namespace YulangClosure.Control

/-- Every raw control rule preserves the independent frame judgment. -/
theorem control_preservation {sig : Signature} {md : Metadata W}
    (ht : StateTyped sig s result) (step : ControlStep md s t) :
    StateTyped sig t result := by
  obtain ⟨hole, hh, hs⟩ := ht
  cases step with
  | bindCode =>
    cases hh with | ret hv =>
      cases hs with | cons hf tail =>
        cases hf with | bind hc =>
          exact ⟨_, .run (.cons hv .nil) .none hc, tail⟩
  | scopeRet =>
    cases hs with | cons hf tail =>
      cases hf
      exact ⟨_, hh, tail⟩
  | viewRet =>
    cases hs with | cons hf tail =>
      cases hf
      exact ⟨_, hh, tail⟩
  | releaseRet =>
    cases hs with | cons hf tail =>
      cases hf
      exact ⟨_, hh, tail⟩
  | mapRet =>
    cases hs with | cons hf tail =>
      cases hf
      exact ⟨_, hh, tail⟩
  | handleRet =>
    cases hs with | cons hf tail =>
      cases hf with | handle handler =>
        cases hh with | ret hv =>
          cases handler with | mk values arms =>
            exact ⟨_, .search (.mk values arms) (.value hv values), tail⟩
  | waitYes =>
    cases hs with | cons hf tail =>
      cases hf with | wait handler search =>
        cases hh with | ret hv =>
          cases hv with | yes hv => exact ⟨_, .ret hv, tail⟩
  | waitNo =>
    cases hs with | cons hf tail =>
      cases hf with | wait handler search =>
        exact ⟨_, .search handler search, tail⟩
  | waitBad =>
    cases hs with | cons hf tail =>
      cases hf with | wait handler search =>
        cases hh with | ret hv => cases hv
  | bindReq =>
    cases hh with | req hp =>
      cases hs with | cons hf tail =>
        exact ⟨_, .req (packet_capture_typed hp hf), tail⟩
  | scopeReq =>
    cases hh with | req hp =>
      cases hs with | cons hf tail =>
        exact ⟨_, .req (packet_capture_typed hp hf), tail⟩
  | viewReq =>
    cases hh with | req hp =>
      cases hs with | cons hf tail =>
        exact ⟨_, .req (packet_capture_typed hp hf), tail⟩
  | waitReq =>
    cases hh with | req hp =>
      cases hs with | cons hf tail =>
        exact ⟨_, .req (packet_capture_typed hp hf), tail⟩
  | releaseReq =>
    cases hh with | req hp =>
      cases hs with | cons hf tail =>
        exact ⟨_, .req (packet_capture_typed hp hf), tail⟩
  | handleReq =>
    cases hs with | cons hf tail =>
      cases hf with | handle handler =>
        cases hh with | req hp =>
          cases handler with | mk hc arms =>
            exact ⟨_, .search (.mk hc arms) (.request hp arms), tail⟩
  | mapMiss =>
    cases hh with | req hp =>
      cases hs with | cons hf tail =>
        exact ⟨_, .req (packet_capture_typed hp hf), tail⟩
  | mapHit =>
    cases hs with | cons hf tail =>
      cases hf with | mapper mapper =>
        cases hh with | req hp =>
          cases hp with | mk hv hk =>
            cases mapper with | mk family payload response =>
              exact ⟨_, .run (.cons hv .nil) .none payload,
                .cons (.mapped (.mk family payload response) (.mk hv hk)) tail⟩
  | mappedRet =>
    cases hs with | cons hf tail =>
      cases hf with | mapped mapper hp =>
        cases hh with | ret hv =>
          cases hp with | mk old hk =>
            exact ⟨_, .req (.mk hv (.mk (.cons (.response mapper hk) .nil))), tail⟩
  | responseRet =>
    cases hs with | cons hf tail =>
      cases hf with | response mapper hk =>
        cases hh with | ret hv =>
          cases mapper with | mk family payload response =>
            exact ⟨_, .run (.cons hv .nil) .none response,
              .cons (.enterSaved (.mk family payload response) hk) tail⟩
  | enterSavedRet =>
    cases hs with | cons hf tail =>
      cases hf with | enterSaved mapper hk =>
        cases hk with | mk saved =>
          exact ⟨_, hh, frames_append saved (.cons (.mapper mapper) tail)⟩
  | searchValueTry =>
    cases hh with | search handler search =>
      cases search with | value hv values =>
        cases values with | cons code rest =>
          exact ⟨_, .run (.cons hv .nil) .none code,
            .cons (.wait handler (.value hv rest)) hs⟩
  | searchValueEnd =>
    exact ⟨_, .fail, hs⟩
  | searchRequestEnd =>
    cases hh with | search handler search =>
      cases search with | request hp arms =>
        exact ⟨_, .req (packet_capture_typed hp (.handle handler)), hs⟩
  | skip test =>
    cases hh with | search handler search =>
      cases search with | request hp arms =>
        cases arms with | cons hc rest =>
          exact ⟨_, .search handler (.request hp rest), hs⟩
  | select eq yes =>
    cases hh with | search handler search =>
      cases search with | request hp arms =>
        cases arms with | cons hc rest =>
          cases hp with | mk hv hk =>
            rw [eq] at hc
            exact ⟨_, .run (.cons hv .nil) (.some hk) hc,
              .cons (.wait handler (.request (.mk hv hk) rest)) hs⟩
  | failRelease =>
    cases hs with | cons hf tail => exact ⟨_, .fail, tail⟩
  | failFrame =>
    cases hs with | cons hf tail => exact ⟨_, .fail, tail⟩
  | badFrame => cases hh
  | originalEnter => cases hh
  | originalReturnBind => cases hh
  | originalPrincipal => cases hh
  | originalExit => cases hh


/-- Raw states admit bad responses; typing of the saved stack excludes them
only when the supplied response has its paired declared base tag. -/
theorem resume_atom_typed {sig : Signature} {k : Kont} {q data : Nat}
    (hk : KontTyped sig k (.base q) a) (w : W) :
    StateTyped sig (resume k (.atom q data) w) a := by
  cases hk with
  | mk hs =>
    simpa [resume, responseOK, Kont.input, Kont.frames] using
      (show StateTyped sig ⟨w, .ret (.atom q data), _⟩ a from
        ⟨.base q, .ret .atom, hs⟩)

/-- No equality between the two CURRENT worlds is required. -/
theorem resume_reusable {sig : Signature} {k : Kont} {q n₁ n₂ : Nat}
    (hk : KontTyped sig k (.base q) a) (w₁ w₂ : W) :
    StateTyped sig (resume k (.atom q n₁) w₁) a ∧
    StateTyped sig (resume k (.atom q n₂) w₂) a := by
  exact ⟨resume_atom_typed hk w₁, resume_atom_typed hk w₂⟩

/-- Failure propagation never enters search or manufactures No/Ret. -/
theorem control_fail_absorbing {md : Metadata W} {s t : State W}
    (h : ControlStep md s t) (hf : s.head = .fail reason) :
    t.head = .fail reason := by
  cases h <;> simp_all

theorem step_fail_absorbing {md : Metadata W}
    {body : W → Nat → List Value → Option Kont → W → Head → Prop}
    {s t : State W} (h : Step md body s t) (hf : s.head = .fail reason) :
    t.head = .fail reason := by
  cases h with
  | control hc => exact control_fail_absorbing hc hf
  | body hb => cases hf

/-- All finite raw traces, with no typing assumption, preserve a failure tag. -/
theorem prefix_fail_absorbing {md : Metadata W}
    {body : W → Nat → List Value → Option Kont → W → Head → Prop}
    {s t : State W} (h : Prefix (Step md body) n s t)
    (hf : s.head = .fail reason) : t.head = .fail reason := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact hf
  | snoc hp hs ih => exact step_fail_absorbing hs (ih hf)

/-- Body execution preservation composes with an EXTRINSIC typed stack.
The body law covers only Head.run, never seven-frame dispatch. -/
theorem body_step_typed {sig : Signature}
    {body : W → Nat → List Value → Option Kont → W → Head → Prop}
    (bl : BodyLaws sig body)
    (ht : StateTyped sig ⟨w,.run code args saved,fs⟩ a)
    (hb : body w code args saved w' head) :
    StateTyped sig ⟨w',head,fs⟩ a := by
  obtain ⟨hole, hh, hs⟩ := ht
  exact ⟨hole, bl.preservation _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hh hb, hs⟩

theorem internal_preservation {sig : Signature} {md : Metadata W}
    {body : W → Nat → List Value → Option Kont → W → Head → Prop}
    (bl : BodyLaws sig body) (ht : StateTyped sig s a) (step : Step md body s t) :
    StateTyped sig t a := by
  cases step with
  | control hc => exact control_preservation ht hc
  | body hb => exact body_step_typed bl ht hb

theorem ret_progress {sig : Signature} {md : Metadata W}
    (hv : ValueTyped v a) (hf : FrameTyped sig f a b) (w : W) (fs : List Frame) :
    ∃ t, ControlStep md ⟨w,.ret v,f::fs⟩ t := by
  cases hf with
  | bind => exact ⟨_, .bindCode⟩
  | scope => exact ⟨_, .scopeRet⟩
  | view => exact ⟨_, .viewRet⟩
  | release => exact ⟨_, .releaseRet⟩
  | handle => exact ⟨_, .handleRet⟩
  | mapper => exact ⟨_, .mapRet⟩
  | wait =>
    cases hv with
    | no => exact ⟨_, .waitNo⟩
    | yes hv => exact ⟨_, .waitYes⟩
  | mapped => exact ⟨_, .mappedRet⟩
  | response => exact ⟨_, .responseRet⟩
  | enterSaved => exact ⟨_, .enterSavedRet⟩

theorem request_progress {sig : Signature} {md : Metadata W} {f : Frame}
    (hf : FrameTyped sig f a b) (p : Packet) (w : W) (fs : List Frame) :
    ∃ t, ControlStep md ⟨w,.req p,f::fs⟩ t := by
  cases f with
  | bind _ =>
    cases hf with
    | bind => exact ⟨_, .bindReq⟩
    | mapped => exact ⟨_, .bindReq⟩
    | response => exact ⟨_, .bindReq⟩
    | enterSaved => exact ⟨_, .bindReq⟩
  | scope _ => cases hf with | scope => exact ⟨_, .scopeReq⟩
  | view _ => cases hf with | view => exact ⟨_, .viewReq⟩
  | release _ => cases hf with | release => exact ⟨_, .releaseReq⟩
  | handle _ => cases hf with | handle => exact ⟨_, .handleReq⟩
  | wait _ _ _ => cases hf with | wait => exact ⟨_, .waitReq⟩
  | mapop mapper =>
    cases hf with
    | mapper _ =>
      cases p with | mk e q p k =>
        by_cases he : q = mapper.source
        · subst q; exact ⟨_, .mapHit⟩
        · exact ⟨_, .mapMiss he⟩
  | originalBind _ => cases hf
  | originalBoundary => cases hf

theorem fail_progress {sig : Signature} {md : Metadata W} {f : Frame}
    (hf : FrameTyped sig f a b) (r : Nat) (w : W) (fs : List Frame) :
    ∃ t, ControlStep md ⟨w,.fail r,f::fs⟩ t := by
  have other (g : Frame) (hne : ∀ target, g ≠ .release target) :
      ∃ t, ControlStep md ⟨w,.fail r,g::fs⟩ t := by
    obtain ⟨w', hw⟩ := md.failWorld_total w g
    exact ⟨_, .failFrame hne hw⟩
  cases hf with
  | release => exact ⟨_, .failRelease⟩
  | bind => exact other _ (by intro target he; cases he)
  | scope => exact other _ (by intro target he; cases he)
  | view => exact other _ (by intro target he; cases he)
  | handle => exact other _ (by intro target he; cases he)
  | mapper => exact other _ (by intro target he; cases he)
  | wait => exact other _ (by intro target he; cases he)
  | mapped => exact other _ (by intro target he; cases he)
  | response => exact other _ (by intro target he; cases he)
  | enterSaved => exact other _ (by intro target he; cases he)

theorem search_progress {sig : Signature} {md : Metadata W}
    (search : SearchTyped sig h p arms) (w : W) (fs : List Frame) :
    ∃ t, ControlStep md ⟨w,.search h p arms,fs⟩ t := by
  cases search with
  | value hv values =>
    cases values with
    | nil => exact ⟨_, .searchValueEnd⟩
    | cons => exact ⟨_, .searchValueTry⟩
  | request hp ha =>
    rename_i packet
    cases arms with
    | nil => exact ⟨_, .searchRequestEnd⟩
    | cons arm rest =>
      cases packet with | mk e q p k =>
        by_cases he : arm.operation = q
        · cases ht : md.eligible w h arm (.mk e q p k) with
          | false => exact ⟨_, .skip (.inr ht)⟩
          | true => exact ⟨_, .select he ht⟩
        · exact ⟨_, .skip (.inl he)⟩

/-- A delimited syntax-bearing segment progresses by the original fragment's
actual progress proof; only a source return at the boundary uses originalExit. -/
theorem segment_progress {sig : Signature} {md : Metadata W}
    (hs : SegmentTyped sig s result) : ∃ t, ControlStep md s t := by
  obtain ⟨sourceResult, source, suffix, hhead, hstack, hsource, hsuffix⟩ := hs
  cases s with | mk world head stack =>
    change head = .original source.current at hhead
    change stack = sourceStackEmbedding source.stack suffix at hstack
    cases hhead
    cases hstack
    cases Original.progress hsource with
    | inl terminal =>
      obtain ⟨value, hstate, hvalue⟩ := terminal
      cases source with
      | mk current frames =>
        cases hstate
        simp [sourceStackEmbedding, sourceFramesControl, sourceFrameControl]
        exact ⟨_, .originalExit⟩
    | inr sourceStep =>
      obtain ⟨next, hstep⟩ := sourceStep
      cases hstep with
      | enter =>
        simp [sourceStackEmbedding, sourceFramesControl, sourceFrameControl]
        exact ⟨_, .originalEnter⟩
      | returnBind =>
        simp [sourceStackEmbedding, sourceFramesControl, sourceFrameControl]
        exact ⟨_, .originalReturnBind⟩
      | principal hp =>
        simp [sourceStackEmbedding, sourceFramesControl, sourceFrameControl]
        exact ⟨_, .originalPrincipal hp⟩

/-- Concrete root adapter. No Analysis or permissive dummy certificate is supplied. -/
def machine (md : Metadata W)
    (body : W → Nat → List Value → Option Kont → W → Head → Prop) :
    YulangClosure.Machine (State W) Kont W Value Packet where
  internal := Step md body
  suspended := fun s k => ∃ e q p, s.head = .req (.mk e q p k) ∧ s.stack = []
  current := fun s w => s.world = w
  admissible := fun k _ v => responseOK k.input v = true
  resume := fun k w v s => s = Control.resume k v w
  returned := fun s => (∃ v, s.head = .ret v) ∧ s.stack = []
  requested := fun s => (∃ p, s.head = .req p) ∧ s.stack = []
  failed := fun s => (∃ r, s.head = .fail r) ∧ s.stack = []
  bad := fun s => ∃ r, s.head = .bad r
  exposed := fun s p => s.head = .req p ∧ s.stack = []

/-- Body progress is needed only at registered run heads. All control cases
are discharged by the concrete rules above. -/
theorem progress {sig : Signature} {md : Metadata W}
    {body : W → Nat → List Value → Option Kont → W → Head → Prop}
    (bl : BodyLaws sig body) (ht : StateTyped sig s a) :
    (machine md body).returned s ∨ (machine md body).requested s ∨
    (machine md body).failed s ∨ ∃ t, Step md body s t := by
  cases s with | mk w head stack =>
    obtain ⟨hole, hh, hs⟩ := ht
    cases hh with
    | ret hv =>
      cases hs with
      | nil => exact .inl ⟨⟨_, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      | cons hf tail =>
        obtain ⟨t, hx⟩ := ret_progress hv hf w _
        exact .inr (.inr (.inr ⟨t, .control hx⟩))
    | req hp =>
      cases hs with
      | nil => exact .inr (.inl ⟨⟨_, rfl⟩, rfl⟩)
      | cons hf tail =>
        obtain ⟨t, hx⟩ := request_progress hf _ w _
        exact .inr (.inr (.inr ⟨t, .control hx⟩))
    | fail =>
      cases hs with
      | nil => exact .inr (.inr (.inl ⟨⟨_, rfl⟩, rfl⟩))
      | cons hf tail =>
        obtain ⟨t, hx⟩ := fail_progress hf _ w _
        exact .inr (.inr (.inr ⟨t, .control hx⟩))
    | run ha hk hc =>
      obtain ⟨w', head', hb⟩ := bl.progress w _ _ _ _ (.run ha hk hc)
      exact .inr (.inr (.inr ⟨_, .body hb⟩))
    | search handler search =>
      obtain ⟨t, hx⟩ := search_progress (md := md) search w _
      exact .inr (.inr (.inr ⟨t, .control hx⟩))

theorem admissible_resume_typed {sig : Signature} {k : Kont}
    (hk : KontTyped sig k q a) (hr : responseOK k.input v = true) (w : W) :
    StateTyped sig (resume k v w) a := by
  cases hk with | mk hs =>
    cases v with
    | atom tag data =>
      simp only [responseOK, Kont.input, beq_iff_eq] at hr
      subst tag
      exact resume_atom_typed (.mk hs) w
    | no => cases hr
    | yes v => cases hr
    | originalValue value => cases hr

/-- This fills the actual root resume-formation field, retaining the current
world and the suspended packet's paired response type. -/
theorem resume_formation {sig : Signature} {md : Metadata W}
    {body : W → Nat → List Value → Option Kont → W → Head → Prop}
    (ht : StateTyped sig s a) (hsp : (machine md body).suspended s k)
    (_hc : (machine md body).current s w) (ha : (machine md body).admissible k w v)
    (hr : (machine md body).resume k w v t) : StateTyped sig t a := by
  obtain ⟨e, q, p, he, hs⟩ := hsp
  obtain ⟨hole, hh, hfs⟩ := ht
  rw [hs] at hfs
  cases hfs
  rw [he] at hh
  cases hh with | req hp =>
    cases hp with | mk hv hk =>
      rw [hr]
      exact admissible_resume_typed hk ha w

theorem machine_preservation {sig : Signature} {md : Metadata W}
    {body : W → Nat → List Value → Option Kont → W → Head → Prop}
    (bl : BodyLaws sig body) (ht : StateTyped sig s a)
    (hx : YulangClosure.Step (machine md body) s t) : StateTyped sig t a := by
  cases hx with
  | internal hi => exact internal_preservation bl ht hi
  | resume hsp hc ha hr => exact resume_formation ht hsp hc ha hr

/-- All finite machine traces include arbitrary legal responses at every
terminal request, without a bound on the number of resumptions. -/
theorem finite_trace_safety {sig : Signature} {md : Metadata W}
    {body : W → Nat → List Value → Option Kont → W → Head → Prop}
    (bl : BodyLaws sig body) (ht : StateTyped sig s a)
    (trace : Prefix (YulangClosure.Step (machine md body)) n s t) :
    StateTyped sig t a ∧ ¬ (machine md body).bad t ∧
      ((machine md body).returned t ∨ (machine md body).requested t ∨
       (machine md body).failed t ∨ ∃ u, (machine md body).internal t u) := by
  have typed : StateTyped sig t a := by
    induction trace with
    | refl => exact ht
    | snoc hp hx ih => exact machine_preservation bl (ih ht) hx
  exact ⟨typed, fun ⟨r, hr⟩ => typed_not_bad typed r hr, progress bl typed⟩

/-- Remaining effect-analysis obligations. These contain no control typing,
preservation, progress, or Bad-exclusion assumptions. They must be supplied by
the actual finite-cell construction; no singleton/all-output instance is made. -/
structure AnalysisLaws (sig : Signature) (md : Metadata W)
    (body : W → Nat → List Value → Option Kont → W → Head → Prop)
    (analysis : Analysis (State W) Cell Packet) (result : Ty)
    (initial : State W → Prop) : Prop where
  initial_seed : ∀ s, initial s → ∃ b, analysis.seed s b ∧ analysis.represents s b
  internal_simulation : ∀ s t b, StateTyped sig s result → analysis.represents s b →
    Step md body s t → ∃ b', analysis.edge b b' ∧ analysis.represents t b'
  resume_simulation : ∀ s t b k w v, StateTyped sig s result → analysis.represents s b →
    (machine md body).suspended s k → (machine md body).current s w →
    (machine md body).admissible k w v → (machine md body).resume k w v t →
    ∃ b', analysis.edge b b' ∧ analysis.represents t b'
  observation : ∀ s b p, StateTyped sig s result → analysis.represents s b →
    (machine md body).exposed s p → analysis.observes b p

/-- The four actual safety fields are proved above, not passed by the caller.
Only registered bodies, initial formation and actual analysis remain parameters. -/
def localLaws (sig : Signature) (md : Metadata W)
    (body : W → Nat → List Value → Option Kont → W → Head → Prop)
    (bl : BodyLaws sig body) (analysis : Analysis (State W) Cell Packet)
    (result : Ty) (initial : State W → Prop)
    (hinit : ∀ s, initial s → StateTyped sig s result)
    (al : AnalysisLaws sig md body analysis result initial) :
    LocalLaws (machine md body) analysis where
  Result := Ty
  result := result
  typing := fun a s => StateTyped sig s a
  initial := initial
  initial_typing := hinit
  initial_seed := al.initial_seed
  internal_preservation := fun _ _ ht hs => internal_preservation bl ht hs
  resume_formation := fun _ _ _ _ _ ht hsp hc ha hr => resume_formation ht hsp hc ha hr
  internal_simulation := al.internal_simulation
  resume_simulation := al.resume_simulation
  observation := al.observation
  no_bad := fun _ ht ⟨r, hr⟩ => typed_not_bad ht r hr
  progress := fun _ ht => progress bl ht

/-- Application to the unchanged root composition theorem with concrete
seven-frame safety, retaining the explicit, uninstantiated analysis boundary. -/
theorem finite_prefix_control (sig : Signature) (md : Metadata W)
    (body : W → Nat → List Value → Option Kont → W → Head → Prop)
    (bl : BodyLaws sig body) (analysis : Analysis (State W) Cell Packet)
    (result : Ty) (initial : State W → Prop)
    (hinit : ∀ s, initial s → StateTyped sig s result)
    (al : AnalysisLaws sig md body analysis result initial)
    (cert : Certificate analysis) (hs : initial s)
    (trace : Prefix (YulangClosure.Step (machine md body)) n s t) :
    Conclusion (machine md body) analysis
      (localLaws sig md body bl analysis result initial hinit al) cert t := by
  exact finite_prefix_composition _ _ _ cert hs trace

/-!
LEAN-CONTROL-20261024/r1, coauthored primary integration after actual producer STOP.

Concrete raw seven-frame rules and independent typing now have exhaustive
control preservation/progress, stack capture, reusable response plugging,
finite raw failure absorption and all-finite-machine-trace safety, including
external responses. Value and operation candidate lists have explicit search
rules. Four safety fields of the unchanged root LocalLaws are constructed;
finite_prefix_control actually applies the existing root composition theorem.

Concrete boundaries (not removed by kernel checking):
* Base value/response tags stand for the declared instance payload/response
  slots. Full recursive/nominal/evidence values and typed graph extension remain.
* Each candidate body is registered Head.run. Pattern/body compilation, direct
  result adapters before Yes, substitution and all principal redexes remain
  BodyLaws obligations. BodyLaws has no frame/search source state.
* Scope/view/release metadata preserve value constructors in this abstraction.
  Actual immutable evidence/current-world laws, release Ret result-route
  transport, L-Enter borrowed/fresh activation and CM/H simulation remain.
* Metadata.failWorld represents unobserved post-Fail cleanup, not a restored
  snapshot. Release.Fail is world identity; failure never becomes No.
* Mapper adapters use ordinary Head.run and bind outside the mapper; their
  effects/failures are not swallowed. The paired target retains event identity.
* Machine.current uses the source state's world. Independently evolved host
  worlds require lawful host-state formation. Kont stores no world and is not
  consumed; resume_reusable allows the same K at arbitrary two current worlds.
* Exposed outputs are terminal requests only. Actual Ret/latent/reentry/event
  output families and AnalysisLaws/certificates have no concrete instance yet.
* Source initial formation, original inference A/B, source/native correspondence,
  principality and inference termination remain open, with the original scope.

Frozen Contracts/CoreComposition definitions are unchanged. Producer was not
kernel-checked; primary owns checking and records exact receipts separately.
No project axioms, sorry/admit, compiler changes, tests or descendants.
-/
end YulangClosure.Control

import YulangClosure.CoreComposition

namespace YulangClosure.Control

/-- Every raw control rule preserves the independent frame judgment. -/
theorem control_preservation {sig : Signature} {md : Metadata W}
    (ht : StateTyped sig s result) (step : ControlStep md s t) :
    StateTyped sig t result := by
  obtain ⟨hole, hh, hs⟩ := ht
  cases step with
  | bindCode =>
    cases hh with | ret hv =>
      cases hs with | cons hf tail =>
        cases hf with | bind hc =>
          exact ⟨_, .run (.cons hv .nil) .none hc, tail⟩
  | scopeRet =>
    cases hs with | cons hf tail =>
      cases hf
      exact ⟨_, hh, tail⟩
  | viewRet =>
    cases hs with | cons hf tail =>
      cases hf
      exact ⟨_, hh, tail⟩
  | releaseRet =>
    cases hs with | cons hf tail =>
      cases hf
      exact ⟨_, hh, tail⟩
  | mapRet =>
    cases hs with | cons hf tail =>
      cases hf
      exact ⟨_, hh, tail⟩
  | handleRet =>
    cases hs with | cons hf tail =>
      cases hf with | handle handler =>
        cases hh with | ret hv =>
          cases handler with | mk values arms =>
            exact ⟨_, .search (.mk values arms) (.value hv values), tail⟩
  | waitYes =>
    cases hs with | cons hf tail =>
      cases hf with | wait handler search =>
        cases hh with | ret hv =>
          cases hv with | yes hv => exact ⟨_, .ret hv, tail⟩
  | waitNo =>
    cases hs with | cons hf tail =>
      cases hf with | wait handler search =>
        exact ⟨_, .search handler search, tail⟩
  | waitBad =>
    cases hs with | cons hf tail =>
      cases hf with | wait handler search =>
        cases hh with | ret hv => cases hv
  | bindReq =>
    cases hh with | req hp =>
      cases hs with | cons hf tail =>
        exact ⟨_, .req (packet_capture_typed hp hf), tail⟩
  | scopeReq =>
    cases hh with | req hp =>
      cases hs with | cons hf tail =>
        exact ⟨_, .req (packet_capture_typed hp hf), tail⟩
  | viewReq =>
    cases hh with | req hp =>
      cases hs with | cons hf tail =>
        exact ⟨_, .req (packet_capture_typed hp hf), tail⟩
  | waitReq =>
    cases hh with | req hp =>
      cases hs with | cons hf tail =>
        exact ⟨_, .req (packet_capture_typed hp hf), tail⟩
  | releaseReq =>
    cases hh with | req hp =>
      cases hs with | cons hf tail =>
        exact ⟨_, .req (packet_capture_typed hp hf), tail⟩
  | handleReq =>
    cases hs with | cons hf tail =>
      cases hf with | handle handler =>
        cases hh with | req hp =>
          cases handler with | mk hc arms =>
            exact ⟨_, .search (.mk hc arms) (.request hp arms), tail⟩
  | mapMiss =>
    cases hh with | req hp =>
      cases hs with | cons hf tail =>
        exact ⟨_, .req (packet_capture_typed hp hf), tail⟩
  | mapHit =>
    cases hs with | cons hf tail =>
      cases hf with | mapper mapper =>
        cases hh with | req hp =>
          cases hp with | mk hv hk =>
            cases mapper with | mk family payload response =>
              exact ⟨_, .run (.cons hv .nil) .none payload,
                .cons (.mapped (.mk family payload response) (.mk hv hk)) tail⟩
  | mappedRet =>
    cases hs with | cons hf tail =>
      cases hf with | mapped mapper hp =>
        cases hh with | ret hv =>
          cases hp with | mk old hk =>
            exact ⟨_, .req (.mk hv (.mk (.cons (.response mapper hk) .nil))), tail⟩
  | responseRet =>
    cases hs with | cons hf tail =>
      cases hf with | response mapper hk =>
        cases hh with | ret hv =>
          cases mapper with | mk family payload response =>
            exact ⟨_, .run (.cons hv .nil) .none response,
              .cons (.enterSaved (.mk family payload response) hk) tail⟩
  | enterSavedRet =>
    cases hs with | cons hf tail =>
      cases hf with | enterSaved mapper hk =>
        cases hk with | mk saved =>
          exact ⟨_, hh, frames_append saved (.cons (.mapper mapper) tail)⟩
  | searchValueTry =>
    cases hh with | search handler search =>
      cases search with | value hv values =>
        cases values with | cons code rest =>
          exact ⟨_, .run (.cons hv .nil) .none code,
            .cons (.wait handler (.value hv rest)) hs⟩
  | searchValueEnd =>
    exact ⟨_, .fail, hs⟩
  | searchRequestEnd =>
    cases hh with | search handler search =>
      cases search with | request hp arms =>
        exact ⟨_, .req (packet_capture_typed hp (.handle handler)), hs⟩
  | skip test =>
    cases hh with | search handler search =>
      cases search with | request hp arms =>
        cases arms with | cons hc rest =>
          exact ⟨_, .search handler (.request hp rest), hs⟩
  | select eq yes =>
    cases hh with | search handler search =>
      cases search with | request hp arms =>
        cases arms with | cons hc rest =>
          cases hp with | mk hv hk =>
            rw [eq] at hc
            exact ⟨_, .run (.cons hv .nil) (.some hk) hc,
              .cons (.wait handler (.request (.mk hv hk) rest)) hs⟩
  | failRelease =>
    cases hs with | cons hf tail => exact ⟨_, .fail, tail⟩
  | failFrame =>
    cases hs with | cons hf tail => exact ⟨_, .fail, tail⟩
  | badFrame => cases hh
  | originalEnter => cases hh
  | originalReturnBind => cases hh
  | originalPrincipal => cases hh
  | originalExit => cases hh


/-- Raw states admit bad responses; typing of the saved stack excludes them
only when the supplied response has its paired declared base tag. -/
theorem resume_atom_typed {sig : Signature} {k : Kont} {q data : Nat}
    (hk : KontTyped sig k (.base q) a) (w : W) :
    StateTyped sig (resume k (.atom q data) w) a := by
  cases hk with
  | mk hs =>
    simpa [resume, responseOK, Kont.input, Kont.frames] using
      (show StateTyped sig ⟨w, .ret (.atom q data), _⟩ a from
        ⟨.base q, .ret .atom, hs⟩)

/-- No equality between the two CURRENT worlds is required. -/
theorem resume_reusable {sig : Signature} {k : Kont} {q n₁ n₂ : Nat}
    (hk : KontTyped sig k (.base q) a) (w₁ w₂ : W) :
    StateTyped sig (resume k (.atom q n₁) w₁) a ∧
    StateTyped sig (resume k (.atom q n₂) w₂) a := by
  exact ⟨resume_atom_typed hk w₁, resume_atom_typed hk w₂⟩

/-- Failure propagation never enters search or manufactures No/Ret. -/
theorem control_fail_absorbing {md : Metadata W} {s t : State W}
    (h : ControlStep md s t) (hf : s.head = .fail reason) :
    t.head = .fail reason := by
  cases h <;> simp_all

theorem step_fail_absorbing {md : Metadata W}
    {body : W → Nat → List Value → Option Kont → W → Head → Prop}
    {s t : State W} (h : Step md body s t) (hf : s.head = .fail reason) :
    t.head = .fail reason := by
  cases h with
  | control hc => exact control_fail_absorbing hc hf
  | body hb => cases hf

/-- All finite raw traces, with no typing assumption, preserve a failure tag. -/
theorem prefix_fail_absorbing {md : Metadata W}
    {body : W → Nat → List Value → Option Kont → W → Head → Prop}
    {s t : State W} (h : Prefix (Step md body) n s t)
    (hf : s.head = .fail reason) : t.head = .fail reason := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact hf
  | snoc hp hs ih => exact step_fail_absorbing hs (ih hf)

/-- Body execution preservation composes with an EXTRINSIC typed stack.
The body law covers only Head.run, never seven-frame dispatch. -/
theorem body_step_typed {sig : Signature}
    {body : W → Nat → List Value → Option Kont → W → Head → Prop}
    (bl : BodyLaws sig body)
    (ht : StateTyped sig ⟨w,.run code args saved,fs⟩ a)
    (hb : body w code args saved w' head) :
    StateTyped sig ⟨w',head,fs⟩ a := by
  obtain ⟨hole, hh, hs⟩ := ht
  exact ⟨hole, bl.preservation _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hh hb, hs⟩

theorem internal_preservation {sig : Signature} {md : Metadata W}
    {body : W → Nat → List Value → Option Kont → W → Head → Prop}
    (bl : BodyLaws sig body) (ht : StateTyped sig s a) (step : Step md body s t) :
    StateTyped sig t a := by
  cases step with
  | control hc => exact control_preservation ht hc
  | body hb => exact body_step_typed bl ht hb

theorem ret_progress {sig : Signature} {md : Metadata W}
    (hv : ValueTyped v a) (hf : FrameTyped sig f a b) (w : W) (fs : List Frame) :
    ∃ t, ControlStep md ⟨w,.ret v,f::fs⟩ t := by
  cases hf with
  | bind => exact ⟨_, .bindCode⟩
  | scope => exact ⟨_, .scopeRet⟩
  | view => exact ⟨_, .viewRet⟩
  | release => exact ⟨_, .releaseRet⟩
  | handle => exact ⟨_, .handleRet⟩
  | mapper => exact ⟨_, .mapRet⟩
  | wait =>
    cases hv with
    | no => exact ⟨_, .waitNo⟩
    | yes hv => exact ⟨_, .waitYes⟩
  | mapped => exact ⟨_, .mappedRet⟩
  | response => exact ⟨_, .responseRet⟩
  | enterSaved => exact ⟨_, .enterSavedRet⟩

theorem request_progress {sig : Signature} {md : Metadata W} {f : Frame}
    (hf : FrameTyped sig f a b) (p : Packet) (w : W) (fs : List Frame) :
    ∃ t, ControlStep md ⟨w,.req p,f::fs⟩ t := by
  cases f with
  | bind _ =>
    cases hf with
    | bind => exact ⟨_, .bindReq⟩
    | mapped => exact ⟨_, .bindReq⟩
    | response => exact ⟨_, .bindReq⟩
    | enterSaved => exact ⟨_, .bindReq⟩
  | scope _ => cases hf with | scope => exact ⟨_, .scopeReq⟩
  | view _ => cases hf with | view => exact ⟨_, .viewReq⟩
  | release _ => cases hf with | release => exact ⟨_, .releaseReq⟩
  | handle _ => cases hf with | handle => exact ⟨_, .handleReq⟩
  | wait _ _ _ => cases hf with | wait => exact ⟨_, .waitReq⟩
  | mapop mapper =>
    cases hf with
    | mapper _ =>
      cases p with | mk e q p k =>
        by_cases he : q = mapper.source
        · subst q; exact ⟨_, .mapHit⟩
        · exact ⟨_, .mapMiss he⟩
  | originalBind _ => cases hf
  | typedCallBind _ => cases hf
  | typedCallAdapter _ _ _ => cases hf
  | originalBoundary => cases hf

theorem fail_progress {sig : Signature} {md : Metadata W} {f : Frame}
    (hf : FrameTyped sig f a b) (r : Nat) (w : W) (fs : List Frame) :
    ∃ t, ControlStep md ⟨w,.fail r,f::fs⟩ t := by
  have other (g : Frame) (hne : ∀ target, g ≠ .release target) :
      ∃ t, ControlStep md ⟨w,.fail r,g::fs⟩ t := by
    obtain ⟨w', hw⟩ := md.failWorld_total w g
    exact ⟨_, .failFrame hne hw⟩
  cases hf with
  | release => exact ⟨_, .failRelease⟩
  | bind => exact other _ (by intro target he; cases he)
  | scope => exact other _ (by intro target he; cases he)
  | view => exact other _ (by intro target he; cases he)
  | handle => exact other _ (by intro target he; cases he)
  | mapper => exact other _ (by intro target he; cases he)
  | wait => exact other _ (by intro target he; cases he)
  | mapped => exact other _ (by intro target he; cases he)
  | response => exact other _ (by intro target he; cases he)
  | enterSaved => exact other _ (by intro target he; cases he)

theorem search_progress {sig : Signature} {md : Metadata W}
    (search : SearchTyped sig h p arms) (w : W) (fs : List Frame) :
    ∃ t, ControlStep md ⟨w,.search h p arms,fs⟩ t := by
  cases search with
  | value hv values =>
    cases values with
    | nil => exact ⟨_, .searchValueEnd⟩
    | cons => exact ⟨_, .searchValueTry⟩
  | request hp ha =>
    rename_i packet
    cases arms with
    | nil => exact ⟨_, .searchRequestEnd⟩
    | cons arm rest =>
      cases packet with | mk e q p k =>
        by_cases he : arm.operation = q
        · cases ht : md.eligible w h arm (.mk e q p k) with
          | false => exact ⟨_, .skip (.inr ht)⟩
          | true => exact ⟨_, .select he ht⟩
        · exact ⟨_, .skip (.inl he)⟩

/-- A delimited syntax-bearing segment progresses by the original fragment's
actual progress proof; only a source return at the boundary uses originalExit. -/
theorem segment_progress {sig : Signature} {md : Metadata W}
    (hs : SegmentTyped sig s result) : ∃ t, ControlStep md s t := by
  obtain ⟨sourceResult, source, suffix, hhead, hstack, hsource, hsuffix⟩ := hs
  cases s with | mk world head stack =>
    change head = .original source.current at hhead
    change stack = sourceStackEmbedding source.stack suffix at hstack
    cases hhead
    cases hstack
    cases Original.progress hsource with
    | inl terminal =>
      obtain ⟨value, hstate, hvalue⟩ := terminal
      cases source with
      | mk current frames =>
        cases hstate
        simp [sourceStackEmbedding, sourceFramesControl, sourceFrameControl]
        exact ⟨_, .originalExit⟩
    | inr sourceStep =>
      obtain ⟨next, hstep⟩ := sourceStep
      cases hstep with
      | enter =>
        simp [sourceStackEmbedding, sourceFramesControl, sourceFrameControl]
        exact ⟨_, .originalEnter⟩
      | returnBind =>
        simp [sourceStackEmbedding, sourceFramesControl, sourceFrameControl]
        exact ⟨_, .originalReturnBind⟩
      | principal hp =>
        simp [sourceStackEmbedding, sourceFramesControl, sourceFrameControl]
        exact ⟨_, .originalPrincipal hp⟩

/-- Concrete root adapter. No Analysis or permissive dummy certificate is supplied. -/
def machine (md : Metadata W)
    (body : W → Nat → List Value → Option Kont → W → Head → Prop) :
    YulangClosure.Machine (State W) Kont W Value Packet where
  internal := Step md body
  suspended := fun s k => ∃ e q p, s.head = .req (.mk e q p k) ∧ s.stack = []
  current := fun s w => s.world = w
  admissible := fun k _ v => responseOK k.input v = true
  resume := fun k w v s => s = Control.resume k v w
  returned := fun s => (∃ v, s.head = .ret v) ∧ s.stack = []
  requested := fun s => (∃ p, s.head = .req p) ∧ s.stack = []
  failed := fun s => (∃ r, s.head = .fail r) ∧ s.stack = []
  bad := fun s => ∃ r, s.head = .bad r
  exposed := fun s p => s.head = .req p ∧ s.stack = []

/-- Body progress is needed only at registered run heads. All control cases
are discharged by the concrete rules above. -/
theorem progress {sig : Signature} {md : Metadata W}
    {body : W → Nat → List Value → Option Kont → W → Head → Prop}
    (bl : BodyLaws sig body) (ht : StateTyped sig s a) :
    (machine md body).returned s ∨ (machine md body).requested s ∨
    (machine md body).failed s ∨ ∃ t, Step md body s t := by
  cases s with | mk w head stack =>
    obtain ⟨hole, hh, hs⟩ := ht
    cases hh with
    | ret hv =>
      cases hs with
      | nil => exact .inl ⟨⟨_, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      | cons hf tail =>
        obtain ⟨t, hx⟩ := ret_progress hv hf w _
        exact .inr (.inr (.inr ⟨t, .control hx⟩))
    | req hp =>
      cases hs with
      | nil => exact .inr (.inl ⟨⟨_, rfl⟩, rfl⟩)
      | cons hf tail =>
        obtain ⟨t, hx⟩ := request_progress hf _ w _
        exact .inr (.inr (.inr ⟨t, .control hx⟩))
    | fail =>
      cases hs with
      | nil => exact .inr (.inr (.inl ⟨⟨_, rfl⟩, rfl⟩))
      | cons hf tail =>
        obtain ⟨t, hx⟩ := fail_progress hf _ w _
        exact .inr (.inr (.inr ⟨t, .control hx⟩))
    | run ha hk hc =>
      obtain ⟨w', head', hb⟩ := bl.progress w _ _ _ _ (.run ha hk hc)
      exact .inr (.inr (.inr ⟨_, .body hb⟩))
    | search handler search =>
      obtain ⟨t, hx⟩ := search_progress (md := md) search w _
      exact .inr (.inr (.inr ⟨t, .control hx⟩))

theorem admissible_resume_typed {sig : Signature} {k : Kont}
    (hk : KontTyped sig k q a) (hr : responseOK k.input v = true) (w : W) :
    StateTyped sig (resume k v w) a := by
  cases hk with | mk hs =>
    cases v with
    | atom tag data =>
      simp only [responseOK, Kont.input, beq_iff_eq] at hr
      subst tag
      exact resume_atom_typed (.mk hs) w
    | no => cases hr
    | yes v => cases hr
    | originalValue value => cases hr

/-- This fills the actual root resume-formation field, retaining the current
world and the suspended packet's paired response type. -/
theorem resume_formation {sig : Signature} {md : Metadata W}
    {body : W → Nat → List Value → Option Kont → W → Head → Prop}
    (ht : StateTyped sig s a) (hsp : (machine md body).suspended s k)
    (_hc : (machine md body).current s w) (ha : (machine md body).admissible k w v)
    (hr : (machine md body).resume k w v t) : StateTyped sig t a := by
  obtain ⟨e, q, p, he, hs⟩ := hsp
  obtain ⟨hole, hh, hfs⟩ := ht
  rw [hs] at hfs
  cases hfs
  rw [he] at hh
  cases hh with | req hp =>
    cases hp with | mk hv hk =>
      rw [hr]
      exact admissible_resume_typed hk ha w

theorem machine_preservation {sig : Signature} {md : Metadata W}
    {body : W → Nat → List Value → Option Kont → W → Head → Prop}
    (bl : BodyLaws sig body) (ht : StateTyped sig s a)
    (hx : YulangClosure.Step (machine md body) s t) : StateTyped sig t a := by
  cases hx with
  | internal hi => exact internal_preservation bl ht hi
  | resume hsp hc ha hr => exact resume_formation ht hsp hc ha hr

/-- All finite machine traces include arbitrary legal responses at every
terminal request, without a bound on the number of resumptions. -/
theorem finite_trace_safety {sig : Signature} {md : Metadata W}
    {body : W → Nat → List Value → Option Kont → W → Head → Prop}
    (bl : BodyLaws sig body) (ht : StateTyped sig s a)
    (trace : Prefix (YulangClosure.Step (machine md body)) n s t) :
    StateTyped sig t a ∧ ¬ (machine md body).bad t ∧
      ((machine md body).returned t ∨ (machine md body).requested t ∨
       (machine md body).failed t ∨ ∃ u, (machine md body).internal t u) := by
  have typed : StateTyped sig t a := by
    induction trace with
    | refl => exact ht
    | snoc hp hx ih => exact machine_preservation bl (ih ht) hx
  exact ⟨typed, fun ⟨r, hr⟩ => typed_not_bad typed r hr, progress bl typed⟩

/-- Remaining effect-analysis obligations. These contain no control typing,
preservation, progress, or Bad-exclusion assumptions. They must be supplied by
the actual finite-cell construction; no singleton/all-output instance is made. -/
structure AnalysisLaws (sig : Signature) (md : Metadata W)
    (body : W → Nat → List Value → Option Kont → W → Head → Prop)
    (analysis : Analysis (State W) Cell Packet) (result : Ty)
    (initial : State W → Prop) : Prop where
  initial_seed : ∀ s, initial s → ∃ b, analysis.seed s b ∧ analysis.represents s b
  internal_simulation : ∀ s t b, StateTyped sig s result → analysis.represents s b →
    Step md body s t → ∃ b', analysis.edge b b' ∧ analysis.represents t b'
  resume_simulation : ∀ s t b k w v, StateTyped sig s result → analysis.represents s b →
    (machine md body).suspended s k → (machine md body).current s w →
    (machine md body).admissible k w v → (machine md body).resume k w v t →
    ∃ b', analysis.edge b b' ∧ analysis.represents t b'
  observation : ∀ s b p, StateTyped sig s result → analysis.represents s b →
    (machine md body).exposed s p → analysis.observes b p

/-- The four actual safety fields are proved above, not passed by the caller.
Only registered bodies, initial formation and actual analysis remain parameters. -/
def localLaws (sig : Signature) (md : Metadata W)
    (body : W → Nat → List Value → Option Kont → W → Head → Prop)
    (bl : BodyLaws sig body) (analysis : Analysis (State W) Cell Packet)
    (result : Ty) (initial : State W → Prop)
    (hinit : ∀ s, initial s → StateTyped sig s result)
    (al : AnalysisLaws sig md body analysis result initial) :
    LocalLaws (machine md body) analysis where
  Result := Ty
  result := result
  typing := fun a s => StateTyped sig s a
  initial := initial
  initial_typing := hinit
  initial_seed := al.initial_seed
  internal_preservation := fun _ _ ht hs => internal_preservation bl ht hs
  resume_formation := fun _ _ _ _ _ ht hsp hc ha hr => resume_formation ht hsp hc ha hr
  internal_simulation := al.internal_simulation
  resume_simulation := al.resume_simulation
  observation := al.observation
  no_bad := fun _ ht ⟨r, hr⟩ => typed_not_bad ht r hr
  progress := fun _ ht => progress bl ht

/-- Application to the unchanged root composition theorem with concrete
seven-frame safety, retaining the explicit, uninstantiated analysis boundary. -/
theorem finite_prefix_control (sig : Signature) (md : Metadata W)
    (body : W → Nat → List Value → Option Kont → W → Head → Prop)
    (bl : BodyLaws sig body) (analysis : Analysis (State W) Cell Packet)
    (result : Ty) (initial : State W → Prop)
    (hinit : ∀ s, initial s → StateTyped sig s result)
    (al : AnalysisLaws sig md body analysis result initial)
    (cert : Certificate analysis) (hs : initial s)
    (trace : Prefix (YulangClosure.Step (machine md body)) n s t) :
    Conclusion (machine md body) analysis
      (localLaws sig md body bl analysis result initial hinit al) cert t := by
  exact finite_prefix_composition _ _ _ cert hs trace
