import YulangClosure.ControlComposition

/-! Concrete Original-to-Control bridge for LEAN-CORE-CONTROL-BRIDGE-20261024/r3.
The boundary delimits one source segment from an arbitrary existing Control
suffix. Source execution and the explicit boundary exit are distinguished.
No registered-body safety premise occurs in these theorems. -/
namespace YulangClosure.CoreControlBridge

def frame : Original.Frame → Control.Frame
  | .bind body => .originalBind body

def frames (fs : List Original.Frame) : List Control.Frame := fs.map frame

def embed (world : W) (source : Original.State) (suffix : List Control.Frame) :
    Control.State W :=
  ⟨world, .original source.current, frames source.stack ++ [.originalBoundary] ++ suffix⟩

def exit (world : W) (value : Original.Val) (suffix : List Control.Frame) :
    Control.State W := ⟨world, .ret (.originalValue value), suffix⟩

theorem value_typed (h : Original.ValTyped Original.emptyContext v a) :
    Control.ValueTyped (.originalValue v) (.original a) := .original h

theorem embed_typed {sig : Control.Signature}
    (h : Original.StateTyped Original.emptyContext a source)
    (hs : Control.FramesTyped sig suffix (.original a) result) (world : W) :
    Control.SegmentTyped sig (embed world source suffix) result :=
  ⟨a, source, suffix, rfl, rfl, h, hs⟩

theorem exit_typed {sig : Control.Signature}
    (h : Original.ValTyped Original.emptyContext v a)
    (hs : Control.FramesTyped sig suffix (.original a) result) (world : W) :
    Control.StateTyped sig (exit world v suffix) result :=
  ⟨.original a, .ret (value_typed h), hs⟩

/-- Entry adds the actual syntax-bearing frame before the literal old suffix. -/
theorem entry {md : Control.Metadata W} (world : W) (m n : Original.Comp)
    (fs : List Original.Frame) (suffix : List Control.Frame) :
    Control.ControlStep md (embed world ⟨.bind m n, fs⟩ suffix)
      (embed world ⟨m, .bind n :: fs⟩ suffix) := .originalEnter

/-- Return uses the actual existing substitution, not an assumed body law. -/
theorem return_bind {md : Control.Metadata W} (world : W) (v : Original.Val)
    (n : Original.Comp) (fs : List Original.Frame) (suffix : List Control.Frame) :
    Control.ControlStep md (embed world ⟨.ret v, .bind n :: fs⟩ suffix)
      (embed world ⟨Original.substComp (Original.single v) n, fs⟩ suffix) :=
  .originalReturnBind

theorem principal {md : Control.Metadata W} (world : W)
    (h : Original.Principal m n) (fs : List Original.Frame)
    (suffix : List Control.Frame) :
    Control.ControlStep md (embed world ⟨m, fs⟩ suffix)
      (embed world ⟨n, fs⟩ suffix) := .originalPrincipal h

theorem step {md : Control.Metadata W}
    {body : W → Nat → List Control.Value → Option Control.Kont → W → Control.Head → Prop}
    (h : Original.Step s t) (world : W) (suffix : List Control.Frame) :
    Control.Step md body (embed world s suffix) (embed world t suffix) := by
  cases h with
  | enter => exact .control (entry world _ _ _ suffix)
  | returnBind => exact .control (return_bind world _ _ _ suffix)
  | principal hp => exact .control (principal world hp _ suffix)

theorem boundary_exit {md : Control.Metadata W}
    {body : W → Nat → List Control.Value → Option Control.Kont → W → Control.Head → Prop}
    (world : W) (v : Original.Val) (suffix : List Control.Frame) :
    Control.Step md body (embed world ⟨.ret v, []⟩ suffix) (exit world v suffix) :=
  .control .originalExit

/-- Every successor of the delimited family is a source step or its one
explicit terminal handoff. This quantifies all metadata and registered bodies. -/
theorem successor_coverage {md : Control.Metadata W}
    {body : W → Nat → List Control.Value → Option Control.Kont → W → Control.Head → Prop}
    {source : Original.State} {target : Control.State W} {world : W}
    {suffix : List Control.Frame}
    (h : Control.Step md body (embed world source suffix) target) :
    (∃ next, target = embed world next suffix ∧ Original.Step source next) ∨
      (∃ value, source = ⟨.ret value, []⟩ ∧ target = exit world value suffix) := by
  cases source with | mk current stack =>
    cases stack with
    | nil =>
      change Control.Step md body
        ⟨world, .original current, .originalBoundary :: suffix⟩ target at h
      cases h with
      | control hc =>
        cases hc with
        | originalEnter => exact .inl ⟨_, rfl, .enter⟩
        | originalPrincipal hp => exact .inl ⟨_, rfl, .principal hp⟩
        | originalExit => exact .inr ⟨_, rfl, rfl⟩
    | cons f fs =>
      cases f with | bind n =>
        change Control.Step md body
          ⟨world, .original current,
            .originalBind n :: ((frames fs ++ [.originalBoundary]) ++ suffix)⟩ target at h
        cases h with
        | control hc =>
          cases hc with
          | originalEnter => exact .inl ⟨_, rfl, .enter⟩
          | originalReturnBind => exact .inl ⟨_, rfl, .returnBind⟩
          | originalPrincipal hp => exact .inl ⟨_, rfl, .principal hp⟩

theorem segment_representation {sig : Control.Signature} {s : Control.State W}
    (h : Control.SegmentTyped sig s result) :
    ∃ a source suffix, s = embed s.world source suffix ∧
      Original.StateTyped Original.emptyContext a source ∧
      Control.FramesTyped sig suffix (.original a) result := by
  obtain ⟨a, source, suffix, hh, hs, ht, hf⟩ := h
  cases s with | mk world head stack =>
    cases hh
    cases hs
    exact ⟨a, source, suffix, rfl, ht, hf⟩

/-- Preservation changes typing domains only at the explicit boundary exit.
The source preservation premise is the already proved actual substitution
theorem, not a newly assumed relation on the same syntax. -/
theorem segment_preservation {sig : Control.Signature} {md : Control.Metadata W}
    {body : W → Nat → List Control.Value → Option Control.Kont → W → Control.Head → Prop}
    (ht : Control.SegmentTyped sig s result) (hx : Control.Step md body s t) :
    Control.SegmentTyped sig t result ∨ Control.StateTyped sig t result := by
  obtain ⟨a, source, suffix, he, hsource, hsuffix⟩ := segment_representation ht
  rw [he] at hx
  cases successor_coverage hx with
  | inl hi =>
    obtain ⟨next, hn, hp⟩ := hi
    rw [hn]
    exact .inl (embed_typed (Original.step_preservation hp hsource) hsuffix s.world)
  | inr hi =>
    obtain ⟨value, hs, hn⟩ := hi
    rw [hs] at hsource
    obtain ⟨hole, hm, hf⟩ := hsource
    cases hf
    cases hm with | ret hv =>
      rw [hn]
      exact .inr (exit_typed hv hsuffix s.world)

/-- All source prefixes transfer with their exact length, world and old suffix. -/
theorem finite_transfer {md : Control.Metadata W}
    {body : W → Nat → List Control.Value → Option Control.Kont → W → Control.Head → Prop}
    (h : Prefix Original.Step n s t) (world : W) (suffix : List Control.Frame) :
    Prefix (Control.Step md body) n (embed world s suffix) (embed world t suffix) := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact .refl _
  | snoc hp hx ih => exact .snoc ih (step hx world suffix)

/-- Keep the dependent start index variable during prefix induction. The
embedding equality is introduced only after the induction hypothesis exists. -/
private theorem finite_coverage_from {md : Control.Metadata W}
    {body : W → Nat → List Control.Value → Option Control.Kont → W → Control.Head → Prop}
    {source : Original.State} {start target : Control.State W} {world : W}
    {suffix : List Control.Frame}
    (h : Prefix (Control.Step md body) n start target) :
    start = embed world source suffix →
    (∃ next, target = embed world next suffix ∧ Prefix Original.Step n source next) ∨
      (∃ k l value, n = k + 1 + l ∧
        Prefix Original.Step k source ⟨.ret value, []⟩ ∧
        Prefix (Control.Step md body) l (exit world value suffix) target) := by
  induction h with
  | refl =>
    intro initial
    exact .inl ⟨source, initial, .refl _⟩
  | snoc hp hx ih =>
    intro initial
    cases ih initial with
    | inl hi =>
      obtain ⟨next, he, hs⟩ := hi
      rw [he] at hx
      cases successor_coverage hx with
      | inl hi =>
        obtain ⟨last, he, hl⟩ := hi
        exact .inl ⟨last, he, .snoc hs hl⟩
      | inr hi =>
        obtain ⟨value, he, ht⟩ := hi
        rw [he] at hs
        exact .inr ⟨_, 0, value, rfl, hs, by rw [ht]; exact .refl _⟩
    | inr hi =>
      obtain ⟨k, l, value, hn, hs, ht⟩ := hi
      exact .inr ⟨k, l+1, value, by rw [hn]; rfl, hs, .snoc ht hx⟩

/-- Exhaustive classification of arbitrary finite Control traces. Before the
exit, all steps are Original steps. After exit, the suffix executes under the
ordinary Control relation; no foreign execution is relabeled Original. -/
theorem finite_coverage {md : Control.Metadata W}
    {body : W → Nat → List Control.Value → Option Control.Kont → W → Control.Head → Prop}
    {source : Original.State} {target : Control.State W} {world : W}
    {suffix : List Control.Frame}
    (h : Prefix (Control.Step md body) n (embed world source suffix) target) :
    (∃ next, target = embed world next suffix ∧ Prefix Original.Step n source next) ∨
      (∃ k l value, n = k + 1 + l ∧
        Prefix Original.Step k source ⟨.ret value, []⟩ ∧
        Prefix (Control.Step md body) l (exit world value suffix) target) := by
  exact finite_coverage_from h rfl

/-- A legal external resumption cannot occur at an Original head. This checks
the actual suspended predicate instead of assuming foreign responses away. -/
theorem machine_successor_coverage {md : Control.Metadata W}
    {body : W → Nat → List Control.Value → Option Control.Kont → W → Control.Head → Prop}
    {source : Original.State} {target : Control.State W} {world : W}
    {suffix : List Control.Frame}
    (h : YulangClosure.Step (Control.machine md body)
      (embed world source suffix) target) :
    (∃ next, target = embed world next suffix ∧ Original.Step source next) ∨
      (∃ value, source = ⟨.ret value, []⟩ ∧ target = exit world value suffix) := by
  cases h with
  | internal hi => exact successor_coverage hi
  | resume hsp hc ha hr =>
    obtain ⟨event, operation, payload, he, hs⟩ := hsp
    cases he

theorem machine_finite_transfer {md : Control.Metadata W}
    {body : W → Nat → List Control.Value → Option Control.Kont → W → Control.Head → Prop}
    (h : Prefix Original.Step n s t) (world : W) (suffix : List Control.Frame) :
    Prefix (YulangClosure.Step (Control.machine md body)) n
      (embed world s suffix) (embed world t suffix) := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact .refl _
  | snoc hp hx ih => exact .snoc ih (.internal (step hx world suffix))

/-- The root-machine variant retains arbitrary legal foreign responses after
exit, with the same variable-index induction as internal coverage. -/
private theorem machine_finite_coverage_from {md : Control.Metadata W}
    {body : W → Nat → List Control.Value → Option Control.Kont → W → Control.Head → Prop}
    {source : Original.State} {start target : Control.State W} {world : W}
    {suffix : List Control.Frame}
    (h : Prefix (YulangClosure.Step (Control.machine md body)) n start target) :
    start = embed world source suffix →
    (∃ next, target = embed world next suffix ∧ Prefix Original.Step n source next) ∨
      (∃ k l value, n = k + 1 + l ∧
        Prefix Original.Step k source ⟨.ret value, []⟩ ∧
        Prefix (YulangClosure.Step (Control.machine md body)) l
          (exit world value suffix) target) := by
  induction h with
  | refl =>
    intro initial
    exact .inl ⟨source, initial, .refl _⟩
  | snoc hp hx ih =>
    intro initial
    cases ih initial with
    | inl hi =>
      obtain ⟨next, he, hs⟩ := hi
      rw [he] at hx
      cases machine_successor_coverage hx with
      | inl hi =>
        obtain ⟨last, he, hl⟩ := hi
        exact .inl ⟨last, he, .snoc hs hl⟩
      | inr hi =>
        obtain ⟨value, he, ht⟩ := hi
        rw [he] at hs
        exact .inr ⟨_, 0, value, rfl, hs, by rw [ht]; exact .refl _⟩
    | inr hi =>
      obtain ⟨k, l, value, hn, hs, ht⟩ := hi
      exact .inr ⟨k, l+1, value, by rw [hn]; rfl, hs, .snoc ht hx⟩

/-- Full root-machine prefixes retain all independent legal external responses
in the post-exit foreign trace, without treating that trace as source execution. -/
theorem machine_finite_coverage {md : Control.Metadata W}
    {body : W → Nat → List Control.Value → Option Control.Kont → W → Control.Head → Prop}
    {source : Original.State} {target : Control.State W} {world : W}
    {suffix : List Control.Frame}
    (h : Prefix (YulangClosure.Step (Control.machine md body)) n
      (embed world source suffix) target) :
    (∃ next, target = embed world next suffix ∧ Prefix Original.Step n source next) ∨
      (∃ k l value, n = k + 1 + l ∧
        Prefix Original.Step k source ⟨.ret value, []⟩ ∧
        Prefix (YulangClosure.Step (Control.machine md body)) l
          (exit world value suffix) target) := by
  exact machine_finite_coverage_from h rfl

/-- Original preservation for the shared length-indexed prefix relation.
The initial typing premise is part of the induction motive. -/
private theorem original_prefix_preservation
    (h : Prefix Original.Step n s t) :
    Original.StateTyped env a s → Original.StateTyped env a t := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact fun ht => ht
  | snoc hp hx ih =>
    intro ht
    exact Original.step_preservation hx (ih ht)

/-- Applying the bridge to the original typed parent: every transferred prefix
has segment typing from Original preservation and independent suffix typing. -/
theorem finite_typed_transfer {sig : Control.Signature} {md : Control.Metadata W}
    {body : W → Nat → List Control.Value → Option Control.Kont → W → Control.Head → Prop}
    (ht : Original.StateTyped Original.emptyContext a s)
    (hs : Control.FramesTyped sig suffix (.original a) result)
    (h : Prefix Original.Step n s t) (world : W) :
    Prefix (Control.Step md body) n (embed world s suffix) (embed world t suffix) ∧
      Control.SegmentTyped sig (embed world t suffix) result := by
  have typed := original_prefix_preservation h ht
  exact ⟨finite_transfer h world suffix, embed_typed typed hs world⟩

theorem exit_empty_no_step {md : Control.Metadata W}
    {body : W → Nat → List Control.Value → Option Control.Kont → W → Control.Head → Prop}
    {world : W} {value : Original.Val} {target : Control.State W}
    (h : Control.Step md body (exit world value []) target) : False := by
  cases h with
  | control hc => cases hc

/-- A finite prefix from a state with no successors is stationary. -/
private theorem prefix_eq_of_no_step {C : Type} {relation : C → C → Prop}
    {start target : C} (h : Prefix relation n start target) :
    (∀ next, ¬ relation start next) → target = start := by
  induction h with
  | refl => intro _; rfl
  | snoc hp hx ih =>
    intro noStep
    have he := ih noStep
    rw [he] at hx
    exact (noStep _ hx).elim

theorem exit_empty_prefix {md : Control.Metadata W}
    {body : W → Nat → List Control.Value → Option Control.Kont → W → Control.Head → Prop}
    {world : W} {value : Original.Val} {target : Control.State W}
    (h : Prefix (Control.Step md body) n (exit world value []) target) :
    target = exit world value [] := by
  exact prefix_eq_of_no_step h (fun _ hx => exit_empty_no_step hx)

/-- Actual all-successor finite safety for a closed embedded source program.
With an empty foreign suffix, the explicit exit is an ordinary terminal return;
registered-code BodyLaws are unnecessary throughout the entire trace. -/
theorem finite_closed_safety {sig : Control.Signature} {md : Control.Metadata W}
    {body : W → Nat → List Control.Value → Option Control.Kont → W → Control.Head → Prop}
    {world : W} {target : Control.State W}
    (ht : Original.StateTyped Original.emptyContext a source)
    (h : Prefix (Control.Step md body) n (embed world source []) target) :
    (Control.SegmentTyped sig target (.original a) ∨
      Control.StateTyped sig target (.original a)) ∧
      (∀ reason, target.head ≠ .bad reason) ∧
      ((∃ value, target = exit world value [] ∧
          Original.ValTyped Original.emptyContext value a) ∨
        ∃ next, Control.Step md body target next) := by
  cases finite_coverage h with
  | inl hi =>
    obtain ⟨next, he, hp⟩ := hi
    have typed := original_prefix_preservation hp ht
    have ct : Control.SegmentTyped sig target (.original a) := by
      rw [he]
      exact embed_typed typed .nil world
    refine ⟨.inl ct, ?_, .inr ?_⟩
    · rw [he]
      intro reason hbad
      cases hbad
    · cases Original.progress typed with
      | inl hr =>
        obtain ⟨value, hn, hv⟩ := hr
        rw [he, hn]
        exact ⟨_, boundary_exit world value []⟩
      | inr hr =>
        obtain ⟨last, hx⟩ := hr
        rw [he]
        exact ⟨_, step hx world []⟩
  | inr hi =>
    obtain ⟨k, l, value, hn, hp, tail⟩ := hi
    have typed := original_prefix_preservation hp ht
    obtain ⟨hole, hm, hf⟩ := typed
    cases hf
    cases hm with | ret hv =>
      have he := exit_empty_prefix tail
      have ct : Control.StateTyped sig target (.original a) := by
        rw [he]
        exact exit_typed hv .nil world
      exact ⟨.inr ct, Control.typed_not_bad ct, .inl ⟨value, he, hv⟩⟩

/-! This bridge does not establish full source initialization, Call/wrap/Resume,
all raw constructors, metadata observations, native correspondence, source-scoped
coverage, principality, termination, or the original inference A/B obligations.
Its fixed-context typing is exactly the existing closed Original fragment. -/
end YulangClosure.CoreControlBridge

import YulangClosure.ControlSyntax

namespace YulangClosure.Control

/-- Supply the response at index zero and remove that binder. -/
abbrev responseSubstitution (v : TypedCall.Value) : Nat → TypedCall.Value :=
  fun i => if i = 0 then v else .var (i - 1)

abbrev plugResponse (k : TypedCall.Comp) (v : TypedCall.Value) :
    TypedCall.Comp := TypedCall.substituteCallComp (responseSubstitution v) k

/-- A pointwise inverse remains an inverse under one actual Call binder. -/
private theorem lift_inverse
    (s : Nat → TypedCall.Value) (r : Nat → Nat)
    (hinv : ∀ i, s (r i) = .var i) :
    ∀ i, TypedCall.liftCallSubstitution s (TypedCall.upCall r i) = .var i := by
  intro i
  cases i with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ i =>
      change TypedCall.renameCallValue Nat.succ (s (r i)) = .var (i + 1)
      exact congrArg (TypedCall.renameCallValue Nat.succ) (hinv i)

mutual
  /-- This inverse law concerns Call syntax, including open delayed bodies.
  Embedded Original syntax is retained by both actual traversals. -/
  private theorem substitute_rename_value_cancel
      (value : TypedCall.Value) (s : Nat → TypedCall.Value) (r : Nat → Nat)
      (hinv : ∀ i, s (r i) = .var i) :
      TypedCall.substituteCallValue s (TypedCall.renameCallValue r value) =
        value := by
    cases value with
    | var i => exact hinv i
    | original value => rfl
    | delay body =>
        exact congrArg TypedCall.Value.delay
          (substitute_rename_comp_cancel body s r hinv)
    | view value occurrence =>
        exact congrArg (fun value => TypedCall.Value.view value occurrence)
          (substitute_rename_value_cancel value s r hinv)

  private theorem substitute_rename_comp_cancel
      (body : TypedCall.Comp) (s : Nat → TypedCall.Value) (r : Nat → Nat)
      (hinv : ∀ i, s (r i) = .var i) :
      TypedCall.substituteCallComp s (TypedCall.renameCallComp r body) =
        body := by
    cases body with
    | original body => rfl
    | ret value =>
        exact congrArg TypedCall.Comp.ret
          (substitute_rename_value_cancel value s r hinv)
    | bind first body =>
        have hfirst := substitute_rename_comp_cancel first s r hinv
        have hbody := substitute_rename_comp_cancel body
            (TypedCall.liftCallSubstitution s) (TypedCall.upCall r)
            (lift_inverse s r hinv)
        simp only [TypedCall.renameCallComp, TypedCall.substituteCallComp,
          hfirst, hbody]
    | force value =>
        exact congrArg TypedCall.Comp.force
          (substitute_rename_value_cancel value s r hinv)
    | scope owner body =>
        exact congrArg (TypedCall.Comp.scope owner)
          (substitute_rename_comp_cancel body s r hinv)
    | expose effectView resultView body =>
        exact congrArg (TypedCall.Comp.expose effectView resultView)
          (substitute_rename_comp_cancel body s r hinv)
    | request opInstance payload continuation =>
        have hpayload := substitute_rename_value_cancel payload s r hinv
        have hcontinuation := substitute_rename_comp_cancel continuation
            (TypedCall.liftCallSubstitution s) (TypedCall.upCall r)
            (lift_inverse s r hinv)
        simp only [TypedCall.renameCallComp, TypedCall.substituteCallComp,
          hpayload, hcontinuation]
    | fail reason => rfl
end

/-- Supplying a response cancels the response binder inserted outside the
bind body's own binder. No typing or closedness premise is needed. -/
theorem captureBind_response_cancellation
    (k body : TypedCall.Comp) (v : TypedCall.Value) :
    plugResponse (CallState.captureBind k body) v =
      .bind (plugResponse k v) body := by
  change TypedCall.Comp.bind (plugResponse k v)
      (TypedCall.substituteCallComp
        (TypedCall.liftCallSubstitution (responseSubstitution v))
        (TypedCall.renameCallComp (TypedCall.upCall Nat.succ) body)) =
    TypedCall.Comp.bind (plugResponse k v) body
  apply congrArg (TypedCall.Comp.bind (plugResponse k v))
  apply substitute_rename_comp_cancel
  intro i
  cases i <;> rfl

end YulangClosure.Control

import YulangClosure.ControlSyntax

namespace YulangClosure.Control

/-- Capture the innermost remaining Call frame before capturing its tail.
Bind and adapter frames use the actual response-binder lifting operation. -/
def CallState.captureFrames :
    List TypedCall.ContextFrame → TypedCall.Comp → TypedCall.Comp
  | [], continuation => continuation
  | .bind body :: frames, continuation =>
      captureFrames frames (CallState.captureBind continuation body)
  | .adapter _ _ body :: frames, continuation =>
      captureFrames frames (CallState.captureBind continuation body)
  | .scope owner :: frames, continuation =>
      captureFrames frames (.scope owner continuation)
  | .expose effectView resultView :: frames, continuation =>
      captureFrames frames (.expose effectView resultView continuation)

/-- Prepend one actual step to a snoc-oriented finite prefix. -/
private theorem prefix_prepend
    {C : Type} {step : C → C → Prop} {n : Nat} {b c : C}
    (hp : YulangClosure.Prefix step n b c) :
    ∀ {a : C}, step a b → YulangClosure.Prefix step (n + 1) a c := by
  induction hp with
  | refl b =>
      intro a hfirst
      exact .snoc (.refl a) hfirst
  | snoc hp hlast ih =>
      intro a hfirst
      exact .snoc (ih hfirst) hlast

/-- Every represented requesting state can propagate through its actual Call
frames and finish the request in exactly one step per frame plus one final
step. The final world and scope context are existential witnesses. -/
theorem call_request_unwind_exists
    {W : Type} (md : Metadata W)
    (world : W)
    (op : TypedCall.OperationInstance)
    (payload : TypedCall.Value)
    (continuation : TypedCall.Comp)
    (observed : List TypedCall.ViewOccurrence)
    (frames : List TypedCall.ContextFrame)
    (view : TypedCall.CallView)
    (result : Original.Ty)
    (scopes : List Nat)
    (views : List TypedCall.ViewOccurrence)
    (receipts : List TypedCall.ReceiptSlot)
    (suffix : List Frame) :
    ∃ (world' : W) (scopes' : List Nat),
      YulangClosure.Prefix (CallControlStep md) (frames.length + 1)
        ⟨world, .requesting op payload continuation observed,
          frames, view, result, scopes, views, receipts, suffix⟩
        ⟨world', .requested op payload
            (CallState.captureFrames frames continuation),
          [], view, result, scopes', observed, receipts, suffix⟩ := by
  induction frames generalizing world continuation scopes with
  | nil =>
      refine ⟨world, scopes, ?_⟩
      exact .snoc (.refl _)
        (.finishRequest world op payload continuation observed view result scopes
          views receipts suffix)
  | cons frame frames ih =>
      cases frame with
      | bind body =>
          obtain ⟨world', scopes', htail⟩ :=
            ih world (CallState.captureBind continuation body) scopes
          refine ⟨world', scopes', ?_⟩
          simpa only [List.length_cons, CallState.captureFrames] using
            (prefix_prepend htail
              (.requestBind world op payload continuation body observed frames
                view result scopes views receipts suffix))
      | adapter input output body =>
          obtain ⟨world', scopes', htail⟩ :=
            ih world (CallState.captureBind continuation body) scopes
          refine ⟨world', scopes', ?_⟩
          simpa only [List.length_cons, CallState.captureFrames] using
            (prefix_prepend htail
              (.requestAdapter world op payload continuation observed input output
                body frames view result scopes views receipts suffix))
      | scope owner =>
          obtain ⟨world', scopes', htail⟩ :=
            ih (md.suspendScope world owner) (.scope owner continuation)
              (owner :: scopes)
          refine ⟨world', scopes', ?_⟩
          simpa only [List.length_cons, CallState.captureFrames] using
            (prefix_prepend htail
              (.requestScope world owner op payload continuation observed frames
                view result scopes views receipts suffix))
      | expose effectView resultView =>
          obtain ⟨world', scopes', htail⟩ :=
            ih (md.suspendView world effectView.identity)
              (.expose effectView resultView continuation) scopes
          refine ⟨world', scopes', ?_⟩
          simpa only [List.length_cons, CallState.captureFrames] using
            (prefix_prepend htail
              (.requestExpose world effectView resultView op payload continuation
                observed frames view result scopes views receipts suffix))

end YulangClosure.Control

import YulangClosure.CallRequestUnwind

namespace YulangClosure.Control

/-- Insert the response binder outside the bind body's own value binder.
The body's bound value stays at index zero; its ambient indices move past
the response binder. -/
private theorem captureBind_response_typed
    {env : Original.Context} {response a b : Original.Ty}
    {continuation body : TypedCall.Comp}
    (hk : TypedCall.CompTyped
      (Original.extend env response) continuation a)
    (hb : TypedCall.CompTyped (Original.extend env a) body b) :
    TypedCall.CompTyped (Original.extend env response)
      (CallState.captureBind continuation body) b := by
  apply TypedCall.CompTyped.bind hk
  apply TypedCall.renameCallComp_typed hb
  intro index
  cases index <;> rfl

/-- Capture a typed frame list under one additional response binder, following
the actual innermost-frame-first order of `CallState.captureFrames`. -/
private theorem captureFrames_typed_env
    {env : Original.Context} {frames : List TypedCall.ContextFrame}
    {response a b : Original.Ty}
    (hframes : TypedCall.ContextTyping env frames a b)
    (k : TypedCall.Comp)
    (hk : TypedCall.CompTyped (Original.extend env response) k a) :
    TypedCall.CompTyped (Original.extend env response)
      (CallState.captureFrames frames k) b := by
  induction hframes generalizing k with
  | nil =>
      simpa only [CallState.captureFrames] using hk
  | bind hbody _ ih =>
      simpa only [CallState.captureFrames] using
        (ih _ (captureBind_response_typed hk hbody))
  | adapter hbody _ ih =>
      simpa only [CallState.captureFrames] using
        (ih _ (captureBind_response_typed hk hbody))
  | scope _ ih =>
      simpa only [CallState.captureFrames] using
        (ih _ (TypedCall.CompTyped.scope hk))
  | expose effectView resultView _ ih =>
      simpa only [CallState.captureFrames] using
        (ih _ (TypedCall.CompTyped.expose effectView resultView hk))

/-- Existing typed Call frames preserve continuation typing when captured
under the response binder. This is a syntax typing judgment, with no claim
that a source/native resumption supplies a response. -/
theorem captureFrames_typed
    {frames : List TypedCall.ContextFrame}
    {response a b : Original.Ty}
    {k : TypedCall.Comp}
    (hframes :
      TypedCall.ContextTyping Original.emptyContext frames a b)
    (hk : TypedCall.CompTyped
      (Original.extend Original.emptyContext response) k a) :
    TypedCall.CompTyped
      (Original.extend Original.emptyContext response)
      (CallState.captureFrames frames k) b := by
  exact captureFrames_typed_env hframes k hk

end YulangClosure.Control

import YulangClosure.CallResponseCancellation
import YulangClosure.CallCaptureTyping

namespace YulangClosure.Control

/-- Supplying the response cancels the response binder across every captured
Call frame, in the existing innermost-frame-first order. -/
theorem plugResponse_captureFrames
    (frames : List TypedCall.ContextFrame)
    (k : TypedCall.Comp) (v : TypedCall.Value) :
    plugResponse (CallState.captureFrames frames k) v =
      TypedCall.plugFrames frames (plugResponse k v) := by
  induction frames generalizing k with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons frame frames ih =>
      cases frame with
      | bind body =>
          calc
            plugResponse (CallState.captureFrames
                (.bind body :: frames) k) v =
                plugResponse (CallState.captureFrames frames
                  (CallState.captureBind k body)) v := rfl
            _ = TypedCall.plugFrames frames
                (plugResponse (CallState.captureBind k body) v) := ih _
            _ = TypedCall.plugFrames frames
                (.bind (plugResponse k v) body) := by
                  rw [captureBind_response_cancellation]
            _ = TypedCall.plugFrames (.bind body :: frames)
                (plugResponse k v) := rfl
      | adapter input output body =>
          calc
            plugResponse (CallState.captureFrames
                (.adapter input output body :: frames) k) v =
                plugResponse (CallState.captureFrames frames
                  (CallState.captureBind k body)) v := rfl
            _ = TypedCall.plugFrames frames
                (plugResponse (CallState.captureBind k body) v) := ih _
            _ = TypedCall.plugFrames frames
                (.bind (plugResponse k v) body) := by
                  rw [captureBind_response_cancellation]
            _ = TypedCall.plugFrames (.adapter input output body :: frames)
                (plugResponse k v) := rfl
      | scope owner =>
          exact ih (TypedCall.Comp.scope owner k)
      | expose effectView resultView =>
          exact ih (TypedCall.Comp.expose effectView resultView k)

private theorem responseSubstitution_typed
    {response : Original.Ty} {v : TypedCall.Value}
    (hv : TypedCall.ValueTyped Original.emptyContext v response) :
    ∀ i ty,
      Original.extend Original.emptyContext response i = some ty →
      TypedCall.ValueTyped Original.emptyContext (responseSubstitution v i) ty := by
  intro i ty hi
  cases i with
  | zero =>
      have hty : ty = response := Option.some.inj hi.symm
      subst ty
      simpa [responseSubstitution] using hv
  | succ i =>
      simp [Original.extend, Original.emptyContext] at hi

/-- A typed response turns the captured continuation into a closed, typed
plugging of the original frame list. This is syntax typing only. -/
theorem plugResponse_captureFrames_typed
    {frames : List TypedCall.ContextFrame}
    {response a b : Original.Ty}
    {k : TypedCall.Comp} {v : TypedCall.Value}
    (hframes :
      TypedCall.ContextTyping Original.emptyContext frames a b)
    (hk : TypedCall.CompTyped
      (Original.extend Original.emptyContext response) k a)
    (hv : TypedCall.ValueTyped Original.emptyContext v response) :
    TypedCall.CompTyped Original.emptyContext
      (TypedCall.plugFrames frames (plugResponse k v)) b := by
  rw [← plugResponse_captureFrames]
  apply TypedCall.substituteCallComp_typed
    (captureFrames_typed hframes hk)
  exact responseSubstitution_typed hv

end YulangClosure.Control

import YulangClosure.CoreExecution

namespace YulangClosure.TypedCall

/-- A typed frame list types its actual hole-to-outer-frame plugging order. -/
theorem contextTyping_plugFrames
    {env : Original.Context} {frames : List ContextFrame}
    {a b : Original.Ty}
    (hframes : ContextTyping env frames a b)
    (hole : Comp) (hhole : CompTyped env hole a) :
    CompTyped env (plugFrames frames hole) b := by
  induction hframes generalizing hole with
  | nil =>
      simpa [plugFrames] using hhole
  | bind hbody _ ih =>
      simpa [plugFrames, plugFrame] using
        (ih _ (CompTyped.bind hhole hbody))
  | scope _ ih =>
      simpa [plugFrames, plugFrame] using
        (ih _ (CompTyped.scope hhole))
  | expose effectView resultView _ ih =>
      simpa [plugFrames, plugFrame] using
        (ih _ (CompTyped.expose effectView resultView hhole))
  | adapter hbody _ ih =>
      simpa [plugFrames, plugFrame] using
        (ih _ (CompTyped.bind hhole hbody))

/-- A typed adapter list types its actual inner-to-outer plugging order. -/
theorem adaptersTyped_plugResultAdapters
    {adapters : List Adapter} {a b : Original.Ty}
    (hadapters : AdaptersTyped adapters a b)
    (body : Comp)
    (hbody : CompTyped Original.emptyContext body a) :
    CompTyped Original.emptyContext
      (plugResultAdapters adapters body) b := by
  induction hadapters generalizing body with
  | nil _ =>
      simpa [plugResultAdapters] using hbody
  | cons adapter _ _ _ middle hInput hOutput _ ih =>
      have hinput : CompTyped Original.emptyContext body adapter.input := by
        simpa only [hInput] using hbody
      have hstep : CompTyped Original.emptyContext
          (.bind body adapter.body) adapter.output :=
        CompTyped.bind hinput adapter.typed
      have hmiddle : CompTyped Original.emptyContext
          (.bind body adapter.body) middle := by
        simpa only [hOutput] using hstep
      simpa [plugResultAdapters] using (ih _ hmiddle)

/-- The stored context derivation, consumer derivation, and pending adapter
derivation type the computation assembled by `plugEvaluationContext`. -/
theorem plugEvaluationContext_typed
    {Suffix : Type}
    (context : EvaluationContext Suffix)
    (hole : Comp)
    (hhole : CompTyped Original.emptyContext hole context.holeType) :
    CompTyped Original.emptyContext
      (plugEvaluationContext context hole) context.resultType := by
  have hframes : CompTyped Original.emptyContext
      (plugFrames context.frames hole) context.contextResultType :=
    contextTyping_plugFrames context.contextTyped hole hhole
  have hconsumerInput : CompTyped Original.emptyContext
      (plugFrames context.frames hole) context.bodyResultConsumer.input := by
    simpa only [context.bodyConsumerInputTyped, ← context.bodyResultTyped] using hframes
  have hconsumerOutput : CompTyped Original.emptyContext
      (.bind (plugFrames context.frames hole) context.bodyResultConsumer.body)
      context.resultAdapterInput := by
    simpa only [context.bodyResultOutputTyped] using
      (CompTyped.bind hconsumerInput context.bodyResultConsumer.typed)
  have hpending : CompTyped Original.emptyContext
      (plugResultAdapters context.pendingResultAdapters
        (.bind (plugFrames context.frames hole) context.bodyResultConsumer.body))
      context.pendingResultOutput :=
    adaptersTyped_plugResultAdapters context.pendingResultsTyped _ hconsumerOutput
  simpa only [plugEvaluationContext, context.finalResultTyped] using hpending

end YulangClosure.TypedCall

import YulangClosure.CallContextTyping

namespace YulangClosure.TypedCall

/-- Entry, the declared consumer, and the pending adapter suffix are typed
within each entry-mode branch. -/
theorem callEntryBody_typed
    (mode : Original.Mode)
    {carrier : Value} {body : Comp}
    {argument bodyResult finalResult : Original.Ty}
    (consumer : Adapter) (pending : List Adapter)
    (hcarrier :
      ValueTyped Original.emptyContext carrier (.thunk argument))
    (hbody :
      CompTyped
        (Original.extend Original.emptyContext
          (match mode with
           | .value => argument
           | .computation => .thunk argument))
        body bodyResult)
    (hconsumer : consumer.input = bodyResult)
    (hpending : AdaptersTyped pending consumer.output finalResult) :
    CompTyped Original.emptyContext
      (callEntryBody mode carrier body consumer pending) finalResult := by
  cases mode with
  | value =>
      have hentered : CompTyped Original.emptyContext
          (valueEntryBody carrier body) bodyResult :=
        CompTyped.bind (CompTyped.force hcarrier) hbody
      have hinput : CompTyped Original.emptyContext
          (valueEntryBody carrier body) consumer.input := by
        simpa only [hconsumer] using hentered
      have hconsumed : CompTyped Original.emptyContext
          (.bind (valueEntryBody carrier body) consumer.body)
          consumer.output :=
        CompTyped.bind hinput consumer.typed
      simpa only [callEntryBody, consumeCallResult] using
        (adaptersTyped_plugResultAdapters hpending _ hconsumed)
  | computation =>
      have hentered : CompTyped Original.emptyContext
          (computationEntryBody body carrier) bodyResult :=
        computationEntryBody_typed hbody hcarrier
      have hinput : CompTyped Original.emptyContext
          (computationEntryBody body carrier) consumer.input := by
        simpa only [hconsumer] using hentered
      have hconsumed : CompTyped Original.emptyContext
          (.bind (computationEntryBody body carrier) consumer.body)
          consumer.output :=
        CompTyped.bind hinput consumer.typed
      simpa only [callEntryBody, consumeCallResult] using
        (adaptersTyped_plugResultAdapters hpending _ hconsumed)

end YulangClosure.TypedCall

namespace YulangClosure.TypedCall

/-- Finite syntactic wrap decomposition. This records the existing argument
thunk construction and pending-result order; it asserts no execution step. -/
inductive PeelFunction :
    Function → Value → List Adapter →
    Function → Value → List Adapter → Prop where
  | lambda
      (mode : Original.Mode) (receipt : ReceiptTemplate)
      (argument bodyResult result : Original.Ty)
      (body : Comp) (consumer : Adapter)
      (carrier : Value) (pending : List Adapter) :
      PeelFunction
        (.lambda mode receipt argument bodyResult result body consumer)
        carrier pending
        (.lambda mode receipt argument bodyResult result body consumer)
        carrier pending
  | wrap
      {inner leaf : Function}
      {argumentAdapter resultAdapter : Adapter}
      {carrier finalCarrier : Value}
      {pending finalPending : List Adapter}
      (rest :
        PeelFunction inner
          (delayArgument carrier argumentAdapter)
          (resultAdapter :: pending)
          leaf finalCarrier finalPending) :
      PeelFunction (.wrap inner argumentAdapter resultAdapter)
        carrier pending leaf finalCarrier finalPending

/-- Every finite function spine has a syntactically constructed lambda leaf,
independently of any typing hypothesis or endpoint equality. -/
theorem peelFunction_exists
    (f : Function) (carrier : Value) (pending : List Adapter) :
    ∃ (mode : Original.Mode) (receipt : ReceiptTemplate)
      (leafArgument bodyResult leafResult : Original.Ty)
      (body : Comp) (consumer : Adapter)
      (finalCarrier : Value) (finalPending : List Adapter),
      PeelFunction f carrier pending
        (.lambda mode receipt leafArgument bodyResult leafResult body consumer)
        finalCarrier finalPending := by
  induction f generalizing carrier pending with
  | lambda mode receipt argument bodyResult result body consumer =>
      exact ⟨mode, receipt, argument, bodyResult, result, body, consumer,
        carrier, pending,
        PeelFunction.lambda mode receipt argument bodyResult result body consumer
          carrier pending⟩
  | wrap inner argumentAdapter resultAdapter ih =>
      obtain ⟨mode, receipt, argument, bodyResult, result, body, consumer,
        finalCarrier, finalPending, rest⟩ :=
        ih (delayArgument carrier argumentAdapter) (resultAdapter :: pending)
      exact ⟨mode, receipt, argument, bodyResult, result, body, consumer,
        finalCarrier, finalPending, PeelFunction.wrap rest⟩

/-- The inert argument thunk has the adapter's output type. Its body remains
under delay; this derivation does not evaluate the adapter. -/
theorem delayArgument_typed
    {carrier : Value} {argument innerArgument : Original.Ty}
    (adapter : Adapter)
    (hcarrier :
      ValueTyped Original.emptyContext carrier (.thunk argument))
    (hinput : adapter.input = argument)
    (houtput : adapter.output = innerArgument) :
    ValueTyped Original.emptyContext
      (delayArgument carrier adapter) (.thunk innerArgument) := by
  have hforce : CompTyped Original.emptyContext (.force carrier) adapter.input := by
    simpa only [hinput] using (CompTyped.force hcarrier)
  have hbind : CompTyped Original.emptyContext
      (.bind (.force carrier) adapter.body) adapter.output :=
    CompTyped.bind hforce adapter.typed
  simpa only [delayArgument, houtput] using (ValueTyped.delay hbind)

/-- Peeling preserves the typed carrier and the entire pending-result suffix.
Each outer wrap is prepended before recursion, so a deeper wrap's result
adapter precedes it in the final inner-to-outer list. -/
theorem peelFunction_typed
    {f leaf : Function} {carrier finalCarrier : Value}
    {pending finalPending : List Adapter}
    {argument result finalResult : Original.Ty}
    (hpeel : PeelFunction f carrier pending leaf finalCarrier finalPending)
    (hf : FunctionTyped f argument result)
    (hcarrier :
      ValueTyped Original.emptyContext carrier (.thunk argument))
    (hpending : AdaptersTyped pending result finalResult) :
    ∃ leafArgument leafResult,
      FunctionTyped leaf leafArgument leafResult ∧
      ValueTyped Original.emptyContext
        finalCarrier (.thunk leafArgument) ∧
      AdaptersTyped finalPending leafResult finalResult := by
  induction hpeel generalizing argument result finalResult with
  | lambda =>
      exact ⟨argument, result, hf, hcarrier, hpending⟩
  | wrap rest ih =>
      cases hf with
      | wrap hinner hinput houtput hrinput hroutput =>
          exact ih hinner
            (delayArgument_typed _ hcarrier hinput houtput)
            (AdaptersTyped.cons _ _ _ _ _ hrinput hroutput hpending)

end YulangClosure.TypedCall

/-- A typed finite function spine decomposes to its actual lambda leaf, and
the existing Call entry computation at that leaf has the original result
type. This assembles syntax typing only; it proves no execution step. -/
theorem completeCallEntry_typed
    {f : Function} {carrier : Value} {pending : List Adapter}
    {argument result finalResult : Original.Ty}
    (hf : FunctionTyped f argument result)
    (hcarrier :
      ValueTyped Original.emptyContext carrier (.thunk argument))
    (hpending : AdaptersTyped pending result finalResult) :
    ∃ (mode : Original.Mode) (receipt : ReceiptTemplate)
      (leafArgument bodyResult leafResult : Original.Ty)
      (body : Comp) (consumer : Adapter)
      (leafCarrier : Value) (finalPending : List Adapter),
      PeelFunction f carrier pending
        (.lambda mode receipt leafArgument bodyResult leafResult body consumer)
        leafCarrier finalPending ∧
      CompTyped Original.emptyContext
        (callEntryBody mode leafCarrier body consumer finalPending)
        finalResult := by
  obtain ⟨mode, receipt, leafArgument, bodyResult, leafResult,
      body, consumer, leafCarrier, finalPending, hpeel⟩ :=
    peelFunction_exists f carrier pending
  obtain ⟨typedLeafArgument, typedLeafResult, hleaf, hleafCarrier,
      hleafPending⟩ := peelFunction_typed hpeel hf hcarrier hpending
  have hbody : CompTyped Original.emptyContext
      (callEntryBody mode leafCarrier body consumer finalPending) finalResult := by
    cases hleaf with
    | lambdaValue receipt' argument' bodyResult' leafResult' body'
        resultConsumer htypedBody hconsumer hresult =>
      have hpendingLeaf :
          AdaptersTyped finalPending consumer.output finalResult := by
        rw [hresult]
        exact hleafPending
      exact callEntryBody_typed .value consumer finalPending
        hleafCarrier htypedBody hconsumer hpendingLeaf
    | lambdaComputation receipt' argument' bodyResult' leafResult' body'
        resultConsumer htypedBody hconsumer hresult =>
      have hpendingLeaf :
          AdaptersTyped finalPending consumer.output finalResult := by
        rw [hresult]
        exact hleafPending
      exact callEntryBody_typed .computation consumer finalPending
        hleafCarrier htypedBody hconsumer hpendingLeaf
  exact ⟨mode, receipt, leafArgument, bodyResult, leafResult, body,
    consumer, leafCarrier, finalPending, hpeel, hbody⟩

end YulangClosure.TypedCall

import YulangClosure.ControlSyntax

namespace YulangClosure.Control

/-- Prepending one existing transition adds exactly one prefix step. -/
private theorem prependFailureUnwindStep
    {C : Type} {step : C → C → Prop}
    {n : Nat} {first middle last : C}
    (hstep : step first middle)
    (hp : YulangClosure.Prefix step n middle last) :
    YulangClosure.Prefix step (n + 1) first last := by
  revert hstep
  induction hp with
  | refl =>
      intro hstep
      exact .snoc (.refl _) hstep
  | snoc hp hlast ih =>
      intro hstep
      exact .snoc (ih hstep) hlast

/-- Every represented failure can consume its Call frames using the existing
total cleanup witnesses, then finalize in one additional transition. -/
theorem call_failure_unwind_exists
    {World : Type} (md : Metadata World)
    (world : World) (reason : Original.Failure)
    (frames : List TypedCall.ContextFrame)
    (view : TypedCall.CallView) (result : Original.Ty)
    (scopes : List Nat)
    (views : List TypedCall.ViewOccurrence)
    (receipts : List TypedCall.ReceiptSlot)
    (suffix : List Frame) :
    ∃ nextWorld : World,
      YulangClosure.Prefix (CallControlStep md) (frames.length + 1)
        ⟨world, .active (.fail reason), frames,
          view, result, scopes, views, receipts, suffix⟩
        ⟨nextWorld, .failed reason, [],
          view, result, scopes, views, receipts, suffix⟩ := by
  induction frames generalizing world with
  | nil =>
      refine ⟨world, ?_⟩
      exact .snoc (.refl _)
        (.finishFailure world reason view result scopes views receipts suffix)
  | cons frame frames ih =>
      obtain ⟨middleWorld, hcleanup⟩ :=
        md.failWorld_total world (CallState.contextControlFrame frame)
      have hstep : CallControlStep md
          ⟨world, .active (.fail reason), frame :: frames,
            view, result, scopes, views, receipts, suffix⟩
          ⟨middleWorld, .active (.fail reason), frames,
            view, result, scopes, views, receipts, suffix⟩ := by
        cases frame with
        | bind body =>
            exact .failBind world reason body middleWorld hcleanup
              frames view result scopes views receipts suffix
        | scope owner =>
            exact .failScope world reason owner middleWorld hcleanup
              frames view result scopes views receipts suffix
        | expose effectView resultView =>
            exact .failExpose world reason effectView resultView middleWorld
              hcleanup frames view result scopes views receipts suffix
        | adapter input output body =>
            exact .failAdapter world reason input output body middleWorld
              hcleanup frames view result scopes views receipts suffix
      obtain ⟨nextWorld, hrest⟩ := ih middleWorld
      refine ⟨nextWorld, ?_⟩
      simpa only [List.length_cons] using
        (prependFailureUnwindStep hstep hrest)

end YulangClosure.Control

import YulangClosure.ControlTyping
import YulangClosure.CallEntryTypingRepair
import YulangClosure.CallPeelingTyping

namespace YulangClosure.Control

/-- Insert the response binder outside the bind body's own value binder.
The response remains at index zero in the captured continuation. -/
private theorem captureBind_typed
    {response a b : Original.Ty} {continuation body : TypedCall.Comp}
    (hk : TypedCall.CompTyped
      (Original.extend Original.emptyContext response) continuation a)
    (hb : TypedCall.CompTyped
      (Original.extend Original.emptyContext a) body b) :
    TypedCall.CompTyped (Original.extend Original.emptyContext response)
      (CallState.captureBind continuation body) b := by
  apply TypedCall.CompTyped.bind hk
  apply TypedCall.renameCallComp_typed hb
  intro index
  cases index <;> rfl

/-- The actual return transition substitutes its value for the frame binder. -/
private theorem returnBody_typed
    {a b : Original.Ty} {value : TypedCall.Value} {body : TypedCall.Comp}
    (hb : TypedCall.CompTyped
      (Original.extend Original.emptyContext a) body b)
    (hv : TypedCall.ValueTyped Original.emptyContext value a) :
    TypedCall.CompTyped Original.emptyContext
      (TypedCall.substituteCallComp
        (fun index => if index = 0 then value else .var (index - 1)) body) b := by
  apply TypedCall.substituteCallComp_typed hb
  intro index ty hi
  cases index with
  | zero =>
      simp only [Original.extend, Option.some.injEq] at hi
      subst ty
      exact hv
  | succ index => exact .var hi

/-- Initial interface frames and the one receiver scope are type preserving. -/
private theorem initialFrames_typed
    (interfaces : List TypedCall.InterfacePlan) (owner : Nat) (a : Original.Ty) :
    TypedCall.ContextTyping Original.emptyContext
      ((interfaces.map fun interface =>
        TypedCall.ContextFrame.expose interface.ports.callEffectView
          interface.ports.resultView) ++ [.scope owner]) a a := by
  induction interfaces with
  | nil => exact .scope .nil
  | cons interface interfaces ih => exact .expose _ _ ih

/-- Typing of each existing transition, with an independently typed suffix.
This proves neither progress nor coverage of all typed Call computations. -/
private theorem call_step_typed
    {W : Type} {sig : Signature} {md : Metadata W}
    {s t : CallState W} {result : Ty}
    (ht : CallStateTyped sig s result)
    (hstep : CallControlStep md s t) : CallStateTyped sig t result := by
  rcases ht with ⟨a, hh, hframes, hsuffix⟩
  cases hstep with
  | start term world suffix =>
      cases hh
      have hcarrier : TypedCall.ValueTyped Original.emptyContext
          term.argument.underlying (.thunk term.inputType) := by
        rw [← term.argumentIsThunk]
        exact term.argument.typed
      exact ⟨_, .enter term.functionTyped hcarrier (.nil _),
        initialFrames_typed term.callView.interfaces.reverse
          term.callView.receiverOwner term.resultType, hsuffix⟩
  | peelWrap =>
      cases hh with
      | enter hfunction hcarrier hpending =>
          cases hfunction with
          | wrap hinner hinput houtput hrinput hroutput =>
              exact ⟨_, .enter hinner
                (TypedCall.delayArgument_typed _ hcarrier hinput houtput)
                (TypedCall.AdaptersTyped.cons _ _ _ _ _ hrinput hroutput hpending),
                hframes, hsuffix⟩
  | attachReceipt =>
      cases hh with
      | enter hfunction hcarrier hpending =>
          exact ⟨_, .received hfunction hcarrier hpending, hframes, hsuffix⟩
  | enterLambda world mode receipt argument bodyResult leafResult body entryConsumer
      functionTyped carrier pending frames view resultType scopes views receipts suffix =>
      cases hh with
      | received hfunction hcarrier hpending =>
          cases hfunction with
          | lambdaValue receipt argument bodyResult leafResult body consumer
              hbody hconsumer hresult =>
              rw [← hresult] at hpending
              exact ⟨_, .active (TypedCall.callEntryBody_typed .value entryConsumer _
                hcarrier hbody hconsumer hpending), hframes, hsuffix⟩
          | lambdaComputation receipt argument bodyResult leafResult body consumer
              hbody hconsumer hresult =>
              rw [← hresult] at hpending
              exact ⟨_, .active (TypedCall.callEntryBody_typed .computation entryConsumer _
                hcarrier hbody hconsumer hpending), hframes, hsuffix⟩
  | enterBind =>
      cases hh with
      | active hcomp =>
          cases hcomp with
          | bind hfirst hbody =>
              exact ⟨_, .active hfirst, .bind hbody hframes, hsuffix⟩
  | enterOriginal =>
      cases hh with
      | active hcomp =>
          cases hcomp with
          | original hbody =>
              exact ⟨_, .originalState ⟨_, hbody, .nil⟩, hframes, hsuffix⟩
  | originalStep world source target step frames view resultType scopes views receipts suffix =>
      cases hh with
      | originalState hsource =>
          exact ⟨_, .originalState (Original.step_preservation step hsource),
            hframes, hsuffix⟩
  | originalExit =>
      cases hh with
      | originalState hsource =>
          rcases hsource with ⟨b, hcomp, hsourceFrames⟩
          cases hsourceFrames
          cases hcomp with
          | ret hvalue =>
              exact ⟨_, .active (.ret (.original hvalue)), hframes, hsuffix⟩
  | enterScope =>
      cases hh with
      | active hcomp =>
          cases hcomp with
          | scope hbody => exact ⟨_, .active hbody, .scope hframes, hsuffix⟩
  | enterExpose world enteredEffect enteredResult body frames view resultType
      scopes views receipts suffix =>
      cases hh with
      | active hcomp =>
          cases hcomp with
          | expose effectView resultView hbody =>
              exact ⟨_, .active hbody, .expose enteredEffect enteredResult hframes, hsuffix⟩
  | emitRequest =>
      cases hh with
      | active hcomp =>
          cases hcomp with
          | request hpayload hcontinuation =>
              exact ⟨_, .requesting hpayload hcontinuation, hframes, hsuffix⟩
  | forceDelay =>
      cases hh with
      | active hcomp =>
          cases hcomp with
          | force hvalue =>
              cases hvalue with
              | delay hbody => exact ⟨_, .active hbody, hframes, hsuffix⟩
  | forceEmbeddedOriginalDelay =>
      cases hh with
      | active hcomp =>
          cases hcomp with
          | force hvalue =>
              cases hvalue with
              | original hvalue =>
                  cases hvalue with
                  | delay hbody =>
                      exact ⟨_, .originalState ⟨_, hbody, .nil⟩, hframes, hsuffix⟩
  | returnBind =>
      cases hh with
      | active hcomp =>
          cases hcomp with
          | ret hvalue =>
              cases hframes with
              | bind hbody htail =>
                  exact ⟨_, .active (returnBody_typed hbody hvalue), htail, hsuffix⟩
  | returnAdapter =>
      cases hh with
      | active hcomp =>
          cases hcomp with
          | ret hvalue =>
              cases hframes with
              | adapter hbody htail =>
                  exact ⟨_, .active (returnBody_typed hbody hvalue), htail, hsuffix⟩
  | returnScope =>
      cases hframes with
      | scope htail => exact ⟨_, hh, htail, hsuffix⟩
  | returnExpose =>
      cases hh with
      | active hcomp =>
          cases hcomp with
          | ret hvalue =>
              cases hframes with
              | expose effectView resultView htail =>
                  exact ⟨_, .active (.ret (.view hvalue)), htail, hsuffix⟩
  | requestBind =>
      cases hh with
      | requesting hpayload hcontinuation =>
          cases hframes with
          | bind hbody htail =>
              exact ⟨_, .requesting hpayload (captureBind_typed hcontinuation hbody),
                htail, hsuffix⟩
  | requestAdapter =>
      cases hh with
      | requesting hpayload hcontinuation =>
          cases hframes with
          | adapter hbody htail =>
              exact ⟨_, .requesting hpayload (captureBind_typed hcontinuation hbody),
                htail, hsuffix⟩
  | requestScope =>
      cases hh with
      | requesting hpayload hcontinuation =>
          cases hframes with
          | scope htail =>
              exact ⟨_, .requesting hpayload (.scope hcontinuation), htail, hsuffix⟩
  | requestExpose world capturedEffect capturedResult opInstance payload
      continuation observed frames view resultType scopes views receipts suffix =>
      cases hh with
      | requesting hpayload hcontinuation =>
          cases hframes with
          | expose effectView resultView htail =>
              exact ⟨_, .requesting hpayload
                (.expose capturedEffect capturedResult hcontinuation), htail, hsuffix⟩
  | failBind =>
      cases hframes with
      | bind hbody htail => exact ⟨_, .active .fail, htail, hsuffix⟩
  | failAdapter =>
      cases hframes with
      | adapter hbody htail => exact ⟨_, .active .fail, htail, hsuffix⟩
  | failScope =>
      cases hframes with
      | scope htail => exact ⟨_, .active .fail, htail, hsuffix⟩
  | failExpose =>
      cases hframes with
      | expose effectView resultView htail => exact ⟨_, .active .fail, htail, hsuffix⟩
  | finishReturn =>
      cases hh with
      | active hcomp =>
          cases hcomp with
          | ret hvalue => exact ⟨_, .returned hvalue, hframes, hsuffix⟩
  | finishRequest =>
      cases hh with
      | requesting hpayload hcontinuation =>
          exact ⟨_, .requested hpayload hcontinuation, hframes, hsuffix⟩
  | finishFailure =>
      exact ⟨_, .failed _ _, hframes, hsuffix⟩

/-- Every already represented Call step preserves the Call typing judgment,
the result type, and the literal independently typed Control suffix.
No progress, world, source/native, or complete-Call adequacy claim is made. -/
theorem call_state_typed_step_preservation
    {W : Type} {sig : Signature} {md : Metadata W}
    {s t : CallState W} {result : Ty}
    (ht : CallStateTyped sig s result)
    (hstep : CallControlStep md s t) :
    CallStateTyped sig t result ∧
      t.resultType = s.resultType ∧
      t.literalSuffix = s.literalSuffix := by
  refine ⟨call_step_typed ht hstep, ?_⟩
  cases hstep <;> exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩

end YulangClosure.Control

import YulangClosure.CallStepTypingRepair

namespace YulangClosure.Control

/-- A supplied finite prefix of the existing Call relation preserves typing,
the result type, and the literal independently typed suffix, including at
length zero. No progress or terminal reachability is asserted. -/
theorem call_state_typed_prefix_preservation
    {W : Type} {sig : Signature} {md : Metadata W}
    {n : Nat} {s t : CallState W} {result : Ty}
    (ht : CallStateTyped sig s result)
    (hp : YulangClosure.Prefix (CallControlStep md) n s t) :
    CallStateTyped sig t result ∧
      t.resultType = s.resultType ∧
      t.literalSuffix = s.literalSuffix := by
  revert ht
  induction hp with
  | refl =>
      intro ht
      exact ⟨ht, rfl, rfl⟩
  | snoc hp hstep ih =>
      intro ht
      rcases ih ht with ⟨hmiddle, hresult, hsuffix⟩
      rcases call_state_typed_step_preservation hmiddle hstep with
        ⟨htarget, hstepResult, hstepSuffix⟩
      exact ⟨htarget, hstepResult.trans hresult, hstepSuffix.trans hsuffix⟩

end YulangClosure.Control

import YulangClosure.ControlTyping

namespace YulangClosure.Control

/-- With no Call frames, a returned head has the Call's Original result type. -/
theorem returned_call_state_typed
    {W : Type} {sig : Signature} {s : CallState W}
    {result : Ty} {v : TypedCall.Value}
    (ht : CallStateTyped sig s result)
    (hempty : s.frames = []) (hhead : s.head = .returned v) :
    TypedCall.ValueTyped Original.emptyContext v s.resultType := by
  rcases ht with ⟨activeType, htypedHead, hframes, _⟩
  rw [hempty] at hframes
  cases hframes
  rw [hhead] at htypedHead
  cases htypedHead with
  | returned hvalue => exact hvalue

/-- An empty Call stack exposes the payload type and the continuation's
response binder without identifying the independent suffix's result type. -/
theorem requested_call_state_typed
    {W : Type} {sig : Signature} {s : CallState W}
    {result : Ty} {op : TypedCall.OperationInstance}
    {payload : TypedCall.Value} {continuation : TypedCall.Comp}
    (ht : CallStateTyped sig s result)
    (hempty : s.frames = []) (hhead : s.head = .requested op payload continuation) :
    TypedCall.ValueTyped Original.emptyContext payload op.payloadType ∧
    TypedCall.CompTyped
      (Original.extend Original.emptyContext op.responseType)
      continuation s.resultType := by
  rcases ht with ⟨activeType, htypedHead, hframes, _⟩
  rw [hempty] at hframes
  cases hframes
  rw [hhead] at htypedHead
  cases htypedHead with
  | requested hpayload hcontinuation => exact ⟨hpayload, hcontinuation⟩

end YulangClosure.Control

import YulangClosure.CallPrefixTyping
import YulangClosure.CallTerminalTyping

namespace YulangClosure.Control

theorem call_state_typed_start
    {W : Type} {sig : Signature}
    (term : TypedCall.CallTerm) (world : W)
    (suffix : List Frame) {result : Ty}
    (hsuffix : FramesTyped sig suffix (.original term.resultType) result) :
    CallStateTyped sig (CallState.initial term world suffix) result := by
  exact ⟨term.resultType, .call term, .nil, hsuffix⟩

theorem initial_call_prefix_terminal_typing
    {W : Type} {sig : Signature} {md : Metadata W}
    {term : TypedCall.CallTerm} {world : W} {suffix : List Frame}
    {result : Ty} {n : Nat} {target : CallState W}
    (hsuffix : FramesTyped sig suffix (.original term.resultType) result)
    (hp : YulangClosure.Prefix (CallControlStep md) n
      (CallState.initial term world suffix) target) :
    CallStateTyped sig target result ∧
      target.resultType = term.resultType ∧ target.literalSuffix = suffix ∧
      (∀ v, target.frames = [] → target.head = .returned v →
        TypedCall.ValueTyped Original.emptyContext v target.resultType) ∧
      (∀ op payload continuation, target.frames = [] →
        target.head = .requested op payload continuation →
        TypedCall.ValueTyped Original.emptyContext payload op.payloadType ∧
        TypedCall.CompTyped
          (Original.extend Original.emptyContext op.responseType)
          continuation target.resultType) := by
  have hstart :
      CallStateTyped sig (CallState.initial term world suffix) result :=
    call_state_typed_start term world suffix hsuffix
  rcases call_state_typed_prefix_preservation hstart hp with
    ⟨htarget, hresult, hliteralSuffix⟩
  refine ⟨htarget, hresult, hliteralSuffix, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro v hempty hhead
    exact returned_call_state_typed htarget hempty hhead
  · intro op payload continuation hempty hhead
    exact requested_call_state_typed htarget hempty hhead

end YulangClosure.Control

import YulangClosure.ControlTyping
import YulangClosure.Contracts

/-! A concrete five-step prefix of the frozen Call relation. This construction
does not assert that any frontend or native producer emits this Call. -/
namespace YulangClosure.Control

private abbrev viewedForceUnit : Original.Ty := .base .unit

private def viewedForceIdentityBody : TypedCall.Comp := .ret (.var 0)

private def viewedForceReceipt : TypedCall.ReceiptTemplate := ⟨[], []⟩

private def viewedForceConsumer : TypedCall.Adapter where
  input := viewedForceUnit
  output := viewedForceUnit
  body := viewedForceIdentityBody
  typed := .ret (.var rfl)
  pathCorrespondences := []
  capturedViews := []

private def viewedForceFunction : TypedCall.Function :=
  .lambda .value viewedForceReceipt viewedForceUnit viewedForceUnit
    viewedForceUnit viewedForceIdentityBody viewedForceConsumer

private theorem viewedForceFunctionTyped :
    TypedCall.FunctionTyped viewedForceFunction viewedForceUnit viewedForceUnit :=
  .lambdaValue viewedForceReceipt viewedForceUnit viewedForceUnit viewedForceUnit
    viewedForceIdentityBody viewedForceConsumer (.ret (.var rfl)) rfl rfl

private def viewedForceCarrierValue (occurrence : TypedCall.ViewOccurrence) :
    TypedCall.Value :=
  .view (.delay (.ret (.original .unit))) occurrence

private def viewedForceCarrier (occurrence : TypedCall.ViewOccurrence) :
    TypedCall.Carrier where
  underlying := viewedForceCarrierValue occurrence
  carrierType := .thunk viewedForceUnit
  typed := .view (.delay (.ret (.original .unit)))
  occurrences := [occurrence]
  receipts := []

private def viewedForceView (occurrence : TypedCall.ViewOccurrence) :
    TypedCall.CallView where
  receiverOwner := 0
  sourceReceipt := viewedForceReceipt
  carrierOccurrences := [occurrence]
  interfaces := []
  adapterPaths := []
  capturedViews := []

/-- All CallTerm fields are supplied; its result is definitionally unit. -/
def viewedForceCallTerm (occurrence : TypedCall.ViewOccurrence) :
    TypedCall.CallTerm where
  function := viewedForceFunction
  argument := viewedForceCarrier occurrence
  inputType := viewedForceUnit
  resultType := viewedForceUnit
  functionTyped := viewedForceFunctionTyped
  argumentIsThunk := rfl
  callView := viewedForceView occurrence
  sourceReceiptMatches := rfl
  wrapPlanMatches := rfl
  activeOwners := []
  receiverFresh := by intro h; cases h

/-- Both identity bind frames, the receiver scope and the literal suffix remain. -/
def viewedForceTarget {W : Type} (world : W)
    (occurrence : TypedCall.ViewOccurrence) (suffix : List Frame) : CallState W :=
  ⟨world, .active (.force (viewedForceCarrierValue occurrence)),
    [.bind viewedForceIdentityBody, .bind viewedForceIdentityBody, .scope 0],
    viewedForceView occurrence, viewedForceUnit, [], [occurrence], [], suffix⟩

/-- The specific witness is exposed so finite typing can use its unit result
without extracting an unrecorded result-type equality from an existential. -/
theorem viewed_force_prefix {W : Type} (md : Metadata W) (world : W)
    (occurrence : TypedCall.ViewOccurrence) (suffix : List Frame) :
    Prefix (CallControlStep md) 5
      (CallState.initial (viewedForceCallTerm occurrence) world suffix)
      (viewedForceTarget world occurrence suffix) := by
  have h0 := Prefix.refl (step := CallControlStep md)
    (CallState.initial (viewedForceCallTerm occurrence) world suffix)
  have h1 := Prefix.snoc h0
    (CallControlStep.start (md := md) (viewedForceCallTerm occurrence) world suffix)
  have h2 := Prefix.snoc h1
    (CallControlStep.attachReceipt world .value viewedForceReceipt
      viewedForceUnit viewedForceUnit viewedForceUnit viewedForceIdentityBody
      viewedForceConsumer viewedForceFunctionTyped
      (viewedForceCarrierValue occurrence) [] [.scope 0]
      (viewedForceView occurrence) viewedForceUnit [] [occurrence] [] suffix)
  have h3 := Prefix.snoc h2
    (CallControlStep.enterLambda world .value viewedForceReceipt
      viewedForceUnit viewedForceUnit viewedForceUnit viewedForceIdentityBody
      viewedForceConsumer viewedForceFunctionTyped
      (viewedForceCarrierValue occurrence) [] [.scope 0]
      (viewedForceView occurrence) viewedForceUnit [] [occurrence] [] suffix)
  have h4 := Prefix.snoc h3
    (CallControlStep.enterBind world
      (.bind (.force (viewedForceCarrierValue occurrence)) viewedForceIdentityBody)
      viewedForceIdentityBody [.scope 0] (viewedForceView occurrence)
      viewedForceUnit [] [occurrence] [] suffix)
  exact Prefix.snoc h4
    (CallControlStep.enterBind world (.force (viewedForceCarrierValue occurrence))
      viewedForceIdentityBody [.bind viewedForceIdentityBody, .scope 0]
      (viewedForceView occurrence) viewedForceUnit [] [occurrence] [] suffix)

/-- For every independently typed suffix, an actual initial Call reaches the
View-wrapped Force head in exactly five existing transitions. -/
theorem viewed_force_reachable {W : Type} (md : Metadata W) (sig : Signature)
    (world : W) (occurrence : TypedCall.ViewOccurrence) (suffix : List Frame)
    {result : Ty}
    (hsuffix : FramesTyped sig suffix (.original (.base .unit)) result) :
    ∃ (term : TypedCall.CallTerm) (target : CallState W),
      Prefix (CallControlStep md) 5 (CallState.initial term world suffix) target ∧
      target.head = .active
        (.force (.view (.delay (.ret (.original .unit))) occurrence)) := by
  clear hsuffix
  exact ⟨viewedForceCallTerm occurrence, viewedForceTarget world occurrence suffix,
    viewed_force_prefix md world occurrence suffix, rfl⟩

end YulangClosure.Control
