import YulangClosure.ControlSyntax

namespace YulangClosure.Control

/-- A Force whose operand retains a View has no successor in the current
Call control relation, independently of typing, frames, or metadata laws. -/
theorem viewed_force_no_successor
    {W : Type} {md : Metadata W} {s : CallState W}
    {value : TypedCall.Value} {occurrence : TypedCall.ViewOccurrence}
    (hhead : s.head = .active (.force (.view value occurrence))) :
    ¬ ∃ t, CallControlStep md s t := by
  rintro ⟨t, hstep⟩
  cases hstep <;> simp [CallState.initial] at hhead

end YulangClosure.Control

import YulangClosure.CallFiniteTyping
import YulangClosure.CallViewedForceReachability
import YulangClosure.CallViewedForceStuck

namespace YulangClosure.Control

/-- A typed, actually reachable Call state whose View-wrapped Force head has
no successor in the present Call relation. The independent literal suffix is
retained and typed at the Call's unit result. This is a formal-relation
obstruction only; it does not establish source/frontend reachability. -/
theorem reachable_typed_viewed_force_stuck
    {W : Type} {sig : Signature} {md : Metadata W}
    (world : W) (occurrence : TypedCall.ViewOccurrence)
    (suffix : List Frame) {result : Ty}
    (hsuffix : FramesTyped sig suffix (.original (.base .unit)) result) :
    let target := viewedForceTarget world occurrence suffix
    CallStateTyped sig target result ∧
      target.head = .active
        (.force (.view (.delay (.ret (.original .unit))) occurrence)) ∧
      ¬ ∃ next, CallControlStep md target next := by
  let target := viewedForceTarget world occurrence suffix
  have hprefix :
      Prefix (CallControlStep md) 5
        (CallState.initial (viewedForceCallTerm occurrence) world suffix) target := by
    simpa [target] using viewed_force_prefix md world occurrence suffix
  have htyped := initial_call_prefix_terminal_typing
    (term := viewedForceCallTerm occurrence) (world := world)
    (suffix := suffix) (result := result) hsuffix hprefix
  have hhead : target.head = .active
      (.force (.view (.delay (.ret (.original .unit))) occurrence)) := by
    rfl
  exact ⟨htyped.1, hhead, viewed_force_no_successor hhead⟩

end YulangClosure.Control

import YulangClosure.CallRequestUnwind

namespace YulangClosure.Control

/-- The actual request transition; totalization outside requests is only notation. -/
def CallState.requestNext {W : Type} (md : Metadata W) (s : CallState W) : CallState W :=
  match s.head, s.frames with
  | .requesting op payload k observed, .bind body :: fs =>
      { s with head := .requesting op payload (captureBind k body) observed, frames := fs }
  | .requesting op payload k observed, .adapter _ _ body :: fs =>
      { s with head := .requesting op payload (captureBind k body) observed, frames := fs }
  | .requesting op payload k observed, .scope owner :: fs =>
      { s with
        world := md.suspendScope s.world owner
        head := .requesting op payload (.scope owner k) observed
        frames := fs
        scopeContext := owner :: s.scopeContext }
  | .requesting op payload k observed, .expose e r :: fs =>
      { s with
        world := md.suspendView s.world e.identity
        head := .requesting op payload (.expose e r k) observed
        frames := fs }
  | .requesting op payload k observed, [] =>
      { s with head := .requested op payload k, viewContext := observed }
  | _, _ => s

def CallState.requestBoundary {W : Type} (md : Metadata W) : Nat → CallState W → CallState W
  | 0, s => s
  | n + 1, s => requestNext md (requestBoundary md n s)

private def RequestRegion {W : Type} (s : CallState W) : Prop :=
  match s.head with
  | .requesting .. => True
  | .requested .. => True
  | _ => False

private theorem request_step_unique {W : Type} {md : Metadata W}
    {s t : CallState W} (hr : RequestRegion s) (h : CallControlStep md s t) :
    t = s.requestNext md ∧ RequestRegion t := by
  cases h <;> simp_all [RequestRegion, CallState.requestNext, CallState.initial]

private theorem boundary_shift {W : Type} (md : Metadata W) (n : Nat) (s : CallState W) :
    s.requestBoundary md (n + 1) = (s.requestNext md).requestBoundary md n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => exact congrArg (CallState.requestNext md) ih

private theorem prefix_prepend {C : Type} {step : C → C → Prop}
    {n : Nat} {b c : C} (h : YulangClosure.Prefix step n b c) :
    ∀ {a}, step a b → YulangClosure.Prefix step (n + 1) a c := by
  induction h with
  | refl => intro a hs; exact .snoc (.refl a) hs
  | snoc h hs ih => intro a hf; exact .snoc (ih hf) hs

private theorem request_prefix_unique {W : Type} {md : Metadata W}
    {n : Nat} {s t : CallState W} (h : YulangClosure.Prefix (CallControlStep md) n s t)
    (hr : RequestRegion s) : t = s.requestBoundary md n ∧ RequestRegion t := by
  revert hr
  induction h with
  | refl => intro hr; exact ⟨rfl, hr⟩
  | snoc h hs ih =>
      intro hr
      obtain ⟨he, hm⟩ := ih hr
      obtain ⟨ht, hrt⟩ := request_step_unique hm hs
      exact ⟨by simpa only [CallState.requestBoundary, ← he] using ht, hrt⟩

private def requestRank {W : Type} (s : CallState W) : Nat :=
  match s.head with
  | .requesting .. => s.frames.length + 1
  | _ => 0

private theorem request_step_rank {W : Type} {md : Metadata W}
    {s t : CallState W} (hr : RequestRegion s) (hs : CallControlStep md s t) :
    requestRank t + 1 = requestRank s := by
  cases hs <;> simp_all [RequestRegion, requestRank, CallState.initial]

private theorem request_prefix_rank {W : Type} {md : Metadata W}
    {n : Nat} {s t : CallState W}
    (hp : YulangClosure.Prefix (CallControlStep md) n s t)
    (hr : RequestRegion s) : n + requestRank t = requestRank s := by
  induction hp with
  | refl => exact Nat.zero_add _
  | @snoc n s mid t hp hs ih =>
      have hmid := (request_prefix_unique hp hr).2
      calc
        n + 1 + requestRank t = n + (requestRank t + 1) := by
          rw [Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm 1]
        _ = n + requestRank mid := congrArg (fun r => n + r) (request_step_rank hmid hs)
        _ = requestRank s := ih hr

section
variable {W : Type} (md : Metadata W)
variable (world : W) (op : TypedCall.OperationInstance) (payload : TypedCall.Value)
variable (k : TypedCall.Comp) (observed : List TypedCall.ViewOccurrence)
variable (frames : List TypedCall.ContextFrame) (view : TypedCall.CallView)
variable (result : Original.Ty) (scopes : List Nat)
variable (views : List TypedCall.ViewOccurrence) (receipts : List TypedCall.ReceiptSlot)
variable (suffix : List Frame)

private theorem request_next_realized :
    CallControlStep md
      ⟨world, .requesting op payload k observed, frames, view, result, scopes, views, receipts, suffix⟩
      (CallState.requestNext md
        ⟨world, .requesting op payload k observed, frames, view, result, scopes, views, receipts, suffix⟩) := by
  cases frames with
  | nil => exact .finishRequest world op payload k observed view result scopes views receipts suffix
  | cons f fs =>
      cases f with
      | bind body => exact .requestBind world op payload k body observed fs view result scopes views receipts suffix
      | adapter a b body => exact .requestAdapter world op payload k observed a b body fs view result scopes views receipts suffix
      | scope owner => exact .requestScope world owner op payload k observed fs view result scopes views receipts suffix
      | expose e r => exact .requestExpose world e r op payload k observed fs view result scopes views receipts suffix

/-- Every prefix up to and including completion is actually realized. -/
theorem call_request_prefix_realized (n : Nat) (hn : n ≤ frames.length + 1) :
    YulangClosure.Prefix (CallControlStep md) n
      ⟨world, .requesting op payload k observed, frames, view, result, scopes, views, receipts, suffix⟩
      (CallState.requestBoundary md n
        ⟨world, .requesting op payload k observed, frames, view, result, scopes, views, receipts, suffix⟩) := by
  induction frames generalizing world k scopes n with
  | nil =>
      cases n with
      | zero => exact .refl _
      | succ n =>
          have hz : n = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero (Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ hn)
          subst n
          exact .snoc (.refl _) (request_next_realized md world op payload k observed [] view result scopes views receipts suffix)
  | cons f fs ih =>
      cases n with
      | zero => exact .refl _
      | succ n =>
          rw [boundary_shift]
          have hn' : n ≤ fs.length + 1 := Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ hn
          cases f with
          | bind body =>
              exact prefix_prepend (ih world (CallState.captureBind k body) scopes n hn')
                (.requestBind world op payload k body observed fs view result scopes views receipts suffix)
          | adapter a b body =>
              exact prefix_prepend (ih world (CallState.captureBind k body) scopes n hn')
                (.requestAdapter world op payload k observed a b body fs view result scopes views receipts suffix)
          | scope owner =>
              exact prefix_prepend (ih (md.suspendScope world owner) (.scope owner k)
                (owner :: scopes) n hn') (.requestScope world owner op payload k observed fs view result scopes views receipts suffix)
          | expose e r =>
              exact prefix_prepend (ih (md.suspendView world e.identity) (.expose e r k)
                scopes n hn') (.requestExpose world e r op payload k observed fs view result scopes views receipts suffix)

/-- Exact endpoint inversion, with unrestricted metadata and world. -/
theorem call_request_prefix_exact (n : Nat) (hn : n ≤ frames.length + 1)
    (t : CallState W) :
    YulangClosure.Prefix (CallControlStep md) n
      ⟨world, .requesting op payload k observed, frames, view, result, scopes, views, receipts, suffix⟩ t ↔
    t = CallState.requestBoundary md n
      ⟨world, .requesting op payload k observed, frames, view, result, scopes, views, receipts, suffix⟩ := by
  constructor
  · intro hp; exact (request_prefix_unique hp True.intro).1
  · intro he; subst t
    exact call_request_prefix_realized md world op payload k observed frames view result scopes views receipts suffix n hn

/-- All actual finite prefixes satisfy the bound; it is not a premise. -/
theorem call_request_prefix_iff (n : Nat) (t : CallState W) :
    YulangClosure.Prefix (CallControlStep md) n
      ⟨world, .requesting op payload k observed, frames, view, result, scopes, views, receipts, suffix⟩ t ↔
    n ≤ frames.length + 1 ∧
      t = CallState.requestBoundary md n
        ⟨world, .requesting op payload k observed, frames, view, result, scopes, views, receipts, suffix⟩ := by
  constructor
  · intro hp
    have hr := request_prefix_rank hp True.intro
    refine ⟨?_, (request_prefix_unique hp True.intro).1⟩
    calc
      n ≤ n + requestRank t := Nat.le_add_right _ _
      _ = frames.length + 1 := hr
  · rintro ⟨hn, ht⟩
    exact (call_request_prefix_exact md world op payload k observed frames view result
      scopes views receipts suffix n hn t).2 ht

end

/-- World/scope actions are folded in the same innermost-first order as capture. -/
def CallState.requestWorldScopes {W : Type} (md : Metadata W) :
    List TypedCall.ContextFrame → W → List Nat → W × List Nat
  | [], w, ss => (w, ss)
  | .bind _ :: fs, w, ss => requestWorldScopes md fs w ss
  | .adapter _ _ _ :: fs, w, ss => requestWorldScopes md fs w ss
  | .scope owner :: fs, w, ss => requestWorldScopes md fs (md.suspendScope w owner) (owner :: ss)
  | .expose e _ :: fs, w, ss => requestWorldScopes md fs (md.suspendView w e.identity) ss

/-- An arbitrary consumed innermost segment leaves its literal residual frames.
The head still carries the original observed list; completion has not occurred. -/
theorem call_request_boundary_partial {W : Type} (md : Metadata W)
    (world : W) (op : TypedCall.OperationInstance) (payload : TypedCall.Value)
    (k : TypedCall.Comp) (observed : List TypedCall.ViewOccurrence)
    (consumed remaining : List TypedCall.ContextFrame) (view : TypedCall.CallView)
    (result : Original.Ty) (scopes : List Nat)
    (views : List TypedCall.ViewOccurrence) (receipts : List TypedCall.ReceiptSlot)
    (suffix : List Frame) :
    CallState.requestBoundary md consumed.length
      ⟨world, .requesting op payload k observed, consumed ++ remaining,
        view, result, scopes, views, receipts, suffix⟩ =
    ⟨(CallState.requestWorldScopes md consumed world scopes).1,
      .requesting op payload (CallState.captureFrames consumed k) observed,
      remaining, view, result, (CallState.requestWorldScopes md consumed world scopes).2,
      views, receipts, suffix⟩ := by
  induction consumed generalizing world k scopes with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons f fs ih =>
      rw [List.length_cons, boundary_shift]
      cases f <;> simpa only [List.cons_append, CallState.requestNext,
        CallState.captureFrames, CallState.requestWorldScopes] using ih _ _ _

/-- Processing exactly the frame count has not yet performed finishRequest. -/
theorem call_request_boundary_frames {W : Type} (md : Metadata W)
    (world : W) (op : TypedCall.OperationInstance) (payload : TypedCall.Value)
    (k : TypedCall.Comp) (observed : List TypedCall.ViewOccurrence)
    (frames : List TypedCall.ContextFrame) (view : TypedCall.CallView)
    (result : Original.Ty) (scopes : List Nat)
    (views : List TypedCall.ViewOccurrence) (receipts : List TypedCall.ReceiptSlot)
    (suffix : List Frame) :
    CallState.requestBoundary md frames.length
      ⟨world, .requesting op payload k observed, frames, view, result, scopes, views, receipts, suffix⟩ =
    ⟨(CallState.requestWorldScopes md frames world scopes).1,
      .requesting op payload (CallState.captureFrames frames k) observed,
      [], view, result, (CallState.requestWorldScopes md frames world scopes).2,
      views, receipts, suffix⟩ := by
  induction frames generalizing world k scopes with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons f fs ih =>
      rw [List.length_cons, boundary_shift]
      cases f <;> simpa only [CallState.requestNext, CallState.captureFrames,
        CallState.requestWorldScopes] using ih _ _ _

/-- Completion is precisely the one additional finishRequest transition. -/
theorem call_request_boundary_complete {W : Type} (md : Metadata W)
    (world : W) (op : TypedCall.OperationInstance) (payload : TypedCall.Value)
    (k : TypedCall.Comp) (observed : List TypedCall.ViewOccurrence)
    (frames : List TypedCall.ContextFrame) (view : TypedCall.CallView)
    (result : Original.Ty) (scopes : List Nat)
    (views : List TypedCall.ViewOccurrence) (receipts : List TypedCall.ReceiptSlot)
    (suffix : List Frame) :
    CallState.requestBoundary md (frames.length + 1)
      ⟨world, .requesting op payload k observed, frames, view, result, scopes, views, receipts, suffix⟩ =
    ⟨(CallState.requestWorldScopes md frames world scopes).1,
      .requested op payload (CallState.captureFrames frames k),
      [], view, result, (CallState.requestWorldScopes md frames world scopes).2,
      observed, receipts, suffix⟩ := by
  rw [CallState.requestBoundary, call_request_boundary_frames]
  rfl

/-- The complete finite-prefix classification in terms of the actual state. -/
theorem call_request_state_prefix_iff
    {W : Type} (md : Metadata W) {s : CallState W}
    {op : TypedCall.OperationInstance} {payload : TypedCall.Value}
    {k : TypedCall.Comp} {observed : List TypedCall.ViewOccurrence}
    (hhead : s.head = .requesting op payload k observed)
    (n : Nat) (t : CallState W) :
    YulangClosure.Prefix (CallControlStep md) n s t ↔
      n ≤ s.frames.length + 1 ∧ t = s.requestBoundary md n := by
  rcases s with ⟨world, head, frames, view, result, scopes, views, receipts, suffix⟩
  cases hhead
  exact call_request_prefix_iff md world op payload k observed frames view result
    scopes views receipts suffix n t

/-- The terminal state retains every field not changed by the actual request
constructors. In particular, metadata acts in the captured frame order. -/
theorem call_request_state_boundary_complete
    {W : Type} (md : Metadata W) {s : CallState W}
    {op : TypedCall.OperationInstance} {payload : TypedCall.Value}
    {k : TypedCall.Comp} {observed : List TypedCall.ViewOccurrence}
    (hhead : s.head = .requesting op payload k observed) :
    s.requestBoundary md (s.frames.length + 1) =
      { s with
        world := (CallState.requestWorldScopes md s.frames s.world s.scopeContext).1
        head := .requested op payload (CallState.captureFrames s.frames k)
        frames := []
        scopeContext := (CallState.requestWorldScopes md s.frames s.world s.scopeContext).2
        viewContext := observed } := by
  rcases s with ⟨world, head, frames, view, result, scopes, views, receipts, suffix⟩
  cases hhead
  exact call_request_boundary_complete md world op payload k observed frames view result
    scopes views receipts suffix

/-- No step leaves a requested boundary in the represented Call relation. -/
theorem call_requested_no_step
    {W : Type} {md : Metadata W} {s t : CallState W}
    {op : TypedCall.OperationInstance} {payload : TypedCall.Value} {k : TypedCall.Comp}
    (hhead : s.head = .requested op payload k) : ¬ CallControlStep md s t := by
  intro hs
  cases hs <;> simp_all [CallState.initial]

/-- Among all actual prefixes, requested completion occurs exactly after one
step per original frame and the final finishRequest step. -/
theorem call_request_completion_iff
    {W : Type} {md : Metadata W} {s t : CallState W} {n : Nat}
    {op : TypedCall.OperationInstance} {payload : TypedCall.Value}
    {k : TypedCall.Comp} {observed : List TypedCall.ViewOccurrence}
    (hhead : s.head = .requesting op payload k observed)
    (hp : YulangClosure.Prefix (CallControlStep md) n s t) :
    (∃ op' payload' k', t.head = .requested op' payload' k') ↔
      n = s.frames.length + 1 := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨op', payload', k', ht⟩
    have hr : RequestRegion s := by simp only [RequestRegion, hhead]
    have hcount := request_prefix_rank hp hr
    simpa only [requestRank, hhead, ht, Nat.add_zero] using hcount
  · intro hn
    have ht := ((call_request_state_prefix_iff md hhead n t).1 hp).2
    rw [hn] at ht
    rw [ht, call_request_state_boundary_complete md hhead]
    exact ⟨op, payload, CallState.captureFrames s.frames k, rfl⟩

end YulangClosure.Control

import YulangClosure.CallFiniteTyping
import YulangClosure.CallRequestUnwind
import YulangClosure.CallFailureUnwind

namespace YulangClosure.Control

/-- Concatenate two actual finite prefixes of the same transition relation. -/
theorem call_prefix_append
    {C : Type} {step : C → C → Prop}
    {n m : Nat} {a b c : C}
    (hfirst : YulangClosure.Prefix step n a b)
    (hsecond : YulangClosure.Prefix step m b c) :
    YulangClosure.Prefix step (n + m) a c := by
  induction hsecond with
  | refl => simpa using hfirst
  | @snoc m b middle c hprefix hstep ih =>
      exact .snoc (ih hfirst) hstep

/-- A supplied finite prefix to a requesting state can be extended through
all actual Call frames while preserving the existing typing invariant. -/
theorem call_request_unwind_initial_typed
    {W : Type} {sig : Signature} {md : Metadata W}
    {term : TypedCall.CallTerm} {world : W} {suffix : List Frame}
    {result : Ty} {n : Nat} {s : CallState W}
    {op : TypedCall.OperationInstance} {payload : TypedCall.Value}
    {continuation : TypedCall.Comp}
    {observed : List TypedCall.ViewOccurrence}
    (hsuffix : FramesTyped sig suffix (.original term.resultType) result)
    (hp : YulangClosure.Prefix (CallControlStep md) n
      (CallState.initial term world suffix) s)
    (hhead : s.head = .requesting op payload continuation observed) :
    ∃ t : CallState W,
      YulangClosure.Prefix (CallControlStep md)
        (n + (s.frames.length + 1))
        (CallState.initial term world suffix) t ∧
      t.head = .requested op payload
        (CallState.captureFrames s.frames continuation) ∧
      t.frames = [] ∧
      CallStateTyped sig t result ∧
      t.resultType = term.resultType ∧
      t.literalSuffix = suffix ∧
      t.callView = s.callView ∧
      t.receiptSlots = s.receiptSlots ∧
      t.viewContext = observed ∧
      TypedCall.ValueTyped Original.emptyContext payload op.payloadType ∧
      TypedCall.CompTyped
        (Original.extend Original.emptyContext op.responseType)
        (CallState.captureFrames s.frames continuation) t.resultType := by
  have hinitial : CallStateTyped sig (CallState.initial term world suffix) result :=
    call_state_typed_start term world suffix hsuffix
  rcases call_state_typed_prefix_preservation hinitial hp with
    ⟨hs, hresult, hliteral⟩
  have hresult0 : s.resultType = term.resultType :=
    hresult.trans (by rfl)
  have hliteral0 : s.literalSuffix = suffix :=
    hliteral.trans (by rfl)
  rcases s with ⟨worldS, headS, framesS, callViewS, resultTypeS,
    scopeContextS, viewContextS, receiptSlotsS, literalSuffixS⟩
  cases hhead
  obtain ⟨worldT, scopesT, hunwind⟩ :=
    call_request_unwind_exists md worldS op payload continuation observed
      framesS callViewS resultTypeS scopeContextS viewContextS receiptSlotsS
      literalSuffixS
  let t : CallState W :=
    ⟨worldT, .requested op payload (CallState.captureFrames framesS continuation),
      [], callViewS, resultTypeS, scopesT, observed, receiptSlotsS, literalSuffixS⟩
  have htrace := call_prefix_append hp hunwind
  have htypedT : CallStateTyped sig t result := by
    exact (call_state_typed_prefix_preservation hinitial htrace).1
  have hterminal := requested_call_state_typed htypedT rfl rfl
  refine ⟨t, ?_, rfl, rfl, htypedT, ?_, ?_, rfl, rfl, rfl, hterminal.1, ?_⟩
  · simpa [t, Nat.add_assoc] using htrace
  · simpa only [t] using hresult0
  · simpa only [t] using hliteral0
  · simpa [t] using hterminal.2

/-- A supplied finite prefix to an active failure can be extended through
all actual Call frames while preserving the existing typing invariant. -/
theorem call_failure_unwind_initial_typed
    {W : Type} {sig : Signature} {md : Metadata W}
    {term : TypedCall.CallTerm} {world : W} {suffix : List Frame}
    {result : Ty} {n : Nat} {s : CallState W}
    {reason : Original.Failure}
    (hsuffix : FramesTyped sig suffix (.original term.resultType) result)
    (hp : YulangClosure.Prefix (CallControlStep md) n
      (CallState.initial term world suffix) s)
    (hhead : s.head = .active (.fail reason)) :
    ∃ t : CallState W,
      YulangClosure.Prefix (CallControlStep md)
        (n + (s.frames.length + 1))
        (CallState.initial term world suffix) t ∧
      t.head = .failed reason ∧
      t.frames = [] ∧
      CallStateTyped sig t result ∧
      t.resultType = term.resultType ∧
      t.literalSuffix = suffix ∧
      t.callView = s.callView ∧
      t.scopeContext = s.scopeContext ∧
      t.viewContext = s.viewContext ∧
      t.receiptSlots = s.receiptSlots := by
  have hinitial : CallStateTyped sig (CallState.initial term world suffix) result :=
    call_state_typed_start term world suffix hsuffix
  rcases call_state_typed_prefix_preservation hinitial hp with
    ⟨hs, hresult, hliteral⟩
  have hresult0 : s.resultType = term.resultType :=
    hresult.trans (by rfl)
  have hliteral0 : s.literalSuffix = suffix :=
    hliteral.trans (by rfl)
  rcases s with ⟨worldS, headS, framesS, callViewS, resultTypeS,
    scopeContextS, viewContextS, receiptSlotsS, literalSuffixS⟩
  cases hhead
  obtain ⟨worldT, hunwind⟩ :=
    call_failure_unwind_exists md worldS reason framesS callViewS resultTypeS
      scopeContextS viewContextS receiptSlotsS literalSuffixS
  let t : CallState W :=
    ⟨worldT, .failed reason, [], callViewS, resultTypeS, scopeContextS,
      viewContextS, receiptSlotsS, literalSuffixS⟩
  have htrace := call_prefix_append hp hunwind
  have htypedT : CallStateTyped sig t result := by
    exact (call_state_typed_prefix_preservation hinitial htrace).1
  refine ⟨t, ?_, rfl, rfl, htypedT, ?_, ?_, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
  · simpa [t, Nat.add_assoc] using htrace
  · simpa only [t] using hresult0
  · simpa only [t] using hliteral0

end YulangClosure.Control

import YulangClosure.CallRequestBoundary
import YulangClosure.CallUnwindTypingRepair
import YulangClosure.CallCaptureResponse

namespace YulangClosure.Control

/-- A request reached by an actual typed Call prefix has a realized, exact
boundary. An explicitly supplied typed response produces the typed plugging
of the captured frames. This does not assert source/native response existence. -/
theorem initial_call_request_boundary_response
    {W : Type} {sig : Signature} {md : Metadata W}
    {term : TypedCall.CallTerm} {world : W} {suffix : List Frame}
    {result : Ty} {n : Nat} {s : CallState W}
    {op : TypedCall.OperationInstance} {payload response : TypedCall.Value}
    {k : TypedCall.Comp} {observed : List TypedCall.ViewOccurrence}
    (hsuffix : FramesTyped sig suffix (.original term.resultType) result)
    (hp : YulangClosure.Prefix (CallControlStep md) n
      (CallState.initial term world suffix) s)
    (hhead : s.head = .requesting op payload k observed)
    (hv : TypedCall.ValueTyped Original.emptyContext response op.responseType) :
    let t := s.requestBoundary md (s.frames.length + 1)
    YulangClosure.Prefix (CallControlStep md) (n + (s.frames.length + 1))
      (CallState.initial term world suffix) t ∧
    CallStateTyped sig t result ∧
    t.head = .requested op payload (CallState.captureFrames s.frames k) ∧
    t.frames = [] ∧
    t.resultType = term.resultType ∧
    t.literalSuffix = suffix ∧
    TypedCall.ValueTyped Original.emptyContext payload op.payloadType ∧
    TypedCall.CompTyped (Original.extend Original.emptyContext op.responseType)
      (CallState.captureFrames s.frames k) term.resultType ∧
    TypedCall.CompTyped Original.emptyContext
      (plugResponse (CallState.captureFrames s.frames k) response) term.resultType ∧
    plugResponse (CallState.captureFrames s.frames k) response =
      TypedCall.plugFrames s.frames (plugResponse k response) ∧
    TypedCall.CompTyped Original.emptyContext
      (TypedCall.plugFrames s.frames (plugResponse k response)) term.resultType := by
  let t := s.requestBoundary md (s.frames.length + 1)
  have hsegment : YulangClosure.Prefix (CallControlStep md) (s.frames.length + 1) s t :=
    (call_request_state_prefix_iff md hhead _ t).2 ⟨Nat.le_refl _, rfl⟩
  have hfull := call_prefix_append hp hsegment
  have hstart := call_state_typed_start term world suffix hsuffix
  obtain ⟨ht, hresult, hliteral⟩ := call_state_typed_prefix_preservation hstart hfull
  have heq := call_request_state_boundary_complete md hhead
  have hrequested : t.head = .requested op payload (CallState.captureFrames s.frames k) := by
    exact congrArg CallState.head heq
  have hempty : t.frames = [] := congrArg CallState.frames heq
  have hterminal := requested_call_state_typed ht hempty hrequested
  have hcaptured : TypedCall.CompTyped
      (Original.extend Original.emptyContext op.responseType)
      (CallState.captureFrames s.frames k) term.resultType := by
    simpa only [hresult, CallState.initial] using hterminal.2
  have hresponse : TypedCall.CompTyped Original.emptyContext
      (plugResponse (CallState.captureFrames s.frames k) response) term.resultType :=
    plugResponse_captureFrames_typed (frames := []) .nil hcaptured hv
  have hcancellation := plugResponse_captureFrames s.frames k response
  have hplugged : TypedCall.CompTyped Original.emptyContext
      (TypedCall.plugFrames s.frames (plugResponse k response)) term.resultType := by
    rw [← hcancellation]
    exact hresponse
  exact ⟨hfull, ht, hrequested, hempty, hresult, hliteral,
    hterminal.1, hcaptured, hresponse, hcancellation, hplugged⟩

/-- Every actual completed request trace has that same boundary and typed
response result, even when its terminal operation/payload/code are unspecified. -/
theorem actual_call_request_completed_response
    {W : Type} {sig : Signature} {md : Metadata W}
    {term : TypedCall.CallTerm} {world : W} {suffix : List Frame}
    {result : Ty} {n m : Nat} {s t : CallState W}
    {op : TypedCall.OperationInstance} {payload response : TypedCall.Value}
    {k : TypedCall.Comp} {observed : List TypedCall.ViewOccurrence}
    (hsuffix : FramesTyped sig suffix (.original term.resultType) result)
    (hp : YulangClosure.Prefix (CallControlStep md) n
      (CallState.initial term world suffix) s)
    (hhead : s.head = .requesting op payload k observed)
    (hpost : YulangClosure.Prefix (CallControlStep md) m s t)
    (hcomplete : ∃ op' payload' k', t.head = .requested op' payload' k')
    (hv : TypedCall.ValueTyped Original.emptyContext response op.responseType) :
    m = s.frames.length + 1 ∧
    t = s.requestBoundary md (s.frames.length + 1) ∧
    t.head = .requested op payload (CallState.captureFrames s.frames k) ∧
    CallStateTyped sig t result ∧ t.literalSuffix = suffix ∧
    TypedCall.CompTyped Original.emptyContext
      (plugResponse (CallState.captureFrames s.frames k) response) term.resultType ∧
    TypedCall.CompTyped Original.emptyContext
      (TypedCall.plugFrames s.frames (plugResponse k response)) term.resultType := by
  have hlength := (call_request_completion_iff hhead hpost).1 hcomplete
  have hexact := ((call_request_state_prefix_iff md hhead m t).1 hpost).2
  rw [hlength] at hexact
  obtain ⟨_, htyped, hrequested, _, _, hliteral, _, _, hresponse, _, hplugged⟩ :=
    initial_call_request_boundary_response hsuffix hp hhead hv
  exact ⟨hlength, hexact, hexact ▸ hrequested, hexact ▸ htyped,
    hexact ▸ hliteral, hresponse, hplugged⟩

end YulangClosure.Control

/-! Candidate literal representation and application to actual Call requests.
All existing Literal payload domains are retained, including arbitrary char
strings and path bytes. Lexical validity and native encoding remain separate
obligations. No operation-instance or source-host typing is inferred here. -/
namespace YulangClosure.Original

@[simp] theorem Literal.toVal_raw (l : Literal) :
    l.toVal.raw = .atom (.literal l) := by
  cases l <;> rfl

theorem Literal.toVal_typed (l : Literal) (env : Context) :
    ValTyped env l.toVal (.base l.base) := by
  cases l <;> constructor

theorem Literal.toVal_injective {l r : Literal}
    (h : l.toVal = r.toVal) : l = r := by
  cases l <;> cases r <;> cases h <;> rfl

/-- This is uniqueness of all typing, hence also of base typing. -/
theorem Literal.toVal_type_unique {l : Literal} {env : Context} {a : Ty}
    (h : ValTyped env l.toVal a) : a = .base l.base := by
  cases l <;> cases h <;> rfl

theorem Literal.toVal_base_unique {l : Literal} {env : Context} {b : Base}
    (h : ValTyped env l.toVal (.base b)) : b = l.base := by
  exact Ty.base.inj (Literal.toVal_type_unique h)

@[simp] theorem Literal.rename_toVal (l : Literal) (r : Nat → Nat) :
    renameVal r l.toVal = l.toVal := by
  cases l <;> rfl

@[simp] theorem Literal.subst_toVal (l : Literal) (s : Nat → Val) :
    substVal s l.toVal = l.toVal := by
  cases l <;> rfl

@[simp] theorem Literal.rename_raw (l : Literal) (r : Renaming) :
    renameRaw r l.toVal.raw = .atom (.literal l) := by
  rw [Literal.toVal_raw]
  rfl

@[simp] theorem Literal.substitute_raw (l : Literal) (s : Substitution) :
    substituteRaw s l.toVal.raw = .atom (.literal l) := by
  rw [Literal.toVal_raw]
  rfl

end YulangClosure.Original

namespace YulangClosure.TypedCall

open YulangClosure.Original

def literalResponse (l : Literal) : Value := .original l.toVal

theorem literalResponse_typed (l : Literal) (env : Original.Context) :
    ValueTyped env (literalResponse l) (.base l.base) :=
  .original (l.toVal_typed Original.emptyContext)

theorem literalResponse_operation_typed (l : Literal) (op : OperationInstance)
    (hresponse : op.responseType = .base l.base) :
    ValueTyped Original.emptyContext (literalResponse l) op.responseType := by
  rw [hresponse]
  exact literalResponse_typed l _

@[simp] theorem rename_literalResponse (l : Literal) (r : Nat → Nat) :
    renameCallValue r (literalResponse l) = literalResponse l := rfl

@[simp] theorem substitute_literalResponse (l : Literal) (s : Nat → Value) :
    substituteCallValue s (literalResponse l) = literalResponse l := rfl

end YulangClosure.TypedCall

namespace YulangClosure.Control

/-- Construct the closed response typing from its literal datum and apply the
accepted actual-prefix theorem with all original frame/suffix quantifiers. -/
theorem initial_call_request_boundary_literal_response
    {W : Type} {sig : Signature} {md : Metadata W}
    {term : TypedCall.CallTerm} {world : W} {suffix : List Frame}
    {result : Ty} {n : Nat} {s : CallState W}
    {op : TypedCall.OperationInstance} {payload : TypedCall.Value}
    {k : TypedCall.Comp} {observed : List TypedCall.ViewOccurrence}
    (hsuffix : FramesTyped sig suffix (.original term.resultType) result)
    (hp : YulangClosure.Prefix (CallControlStep md) n
      (CallState.initial term world suffix) s)
    (hhead : s.head = .requesting op payload k observed)
    (l : Original.Literal)
    (hresponse : op.responseType = .base l.base) :
    let t := s.requestBoundary md (s.frames.length + 1)
    YulangClosure.Prefix (CallControlStep md) (n + (s.frames.length + 1))
      (CallState.initial term world suffix) t ∧
    CallStateTyped sig t result ∧
    t.head = .requested op payload (CallState.captureFrames s.frames k) ∧
    t.frames = [] ∧
    t.resultType = term.resultType ∧
    t.literalSuffix = suffix ∧
    TypedCall.ValueTyped Original.emptyContext payload op.payloadType ∧
    TypedCall.CompTyped (Original.extend Original.emptyContext op.responseType)
      (CallState.captureFrames s.frames k) term.resultType ∧
    TypedCall.CompTyped Original.emptyContext
      (plugResponse (CallState.captureFrames s.frames k) (TypedCall.literalResponse l)) term.resultType ∧
    plugResponse (CallState.captureFrames s.frames k) (TypedCall.literalResponse l) =
      TypedCall.plugFrames s.frames (plugResponse k (TypedCall.literalResponse l)) ∧
    TypedCall.CompTyped Original.emptyContext
      (TypedCall.plugFrames s.frames (plugResponse k (TypedCall.literalResponse l))) term.resultType := by
  exact initial_call_request_boundary_response hsuffix hp hhead
    (TypedCall.literalResponse_operation_typed l op hresponse)

/-- Construct the closed response typing from its literal datum and apply the
accepted actual-prefix theorem with all original frame/suffix quantifiers. -/
theorem actual_call_request_completed_literal_response
    {W : Type} {sig : Signature} {md : Metadata W}
    {term : TypedCall.CallTerm} {world : W} {suffix : List Frame}
    {result : Ty} {n m : Nat} {s t : CallState W}
    {op : TypedCall.OperationInstance} {payload : TypedCall.Value}
    {k : TypedCall.Comp} {observed : List TypedCall.ViewOccurrence}
    (hsuffix : FramesTyped sig suffix (.original term.resultType) result)
    (hp : YulangClosure.Prefix (CallControlStep md) n
      (CallState.initial term world suffix) s)
    (hhead : s.head = .requesting op payload k observed)
    (hpost : YulangClosure.Prefix (CallControlStep md) m s t)
    (hcomplete : ∃ op' payload' k', t.head = .requested op' payload' k')
    (l : Original.Literal)
    (hresponse : op.responseType = .base l.base) :
    m = s.frames.length + 1 ∧
    t = s.requestBoundary md (s.frames.length + 1) ∧
    t.head = .requested op payload (CallState.captureFrames s.frames k) ∧
    CallStateTyped sig t result ∧ t.literalSuffix = suffix ∧
    TypedCall.CompTyped Original.emptyContext
      (plugResponse (CallState.captureFrames s.frames k) (TypedCall.literalResponse l)) term.resultType ∧
    TypedCall.CompTyped Original.emptyContext
      (TypedCall.plugFrames s.frames (plugResponse k (TypedCall.literalResponse l))) term.resultType := by
  exact actual_call_request_completed_response hsuffix hp hhead hpost hcomplete
    (TypedCall.literalResponse_operation_typed l op hresponse)

/-- Explicit two-frame binder discriminator: the integer response replaces
only the response binder, leaving both saved frame bodies intact. -/
example (k left right : TypedCall.Comp) (a b : Original.Ty) :
    plugResponse (CallState.captureFrames [.bind left, .adapter a b right] k)
        (TypedCall.literalResponse (.int 11)) =
      TypedCall.plugFrames [.bind left, .adapter a b right]
        (plugResponse k (TypedCall.literalResponse (.int 11))) :=
  plugResponse_captureFrames _ _ _

end YulangClosure.Control

namespace YulangClosure.Control.RequestBoundaryChecks

private def unitTy : Original.Ty := .base .unit
private def effectView : TypedCall.ViewOccurrence := ⟨2, ⟨[], .callEffect, unitTy⟩⟩
private def resultView : TypedCall.ViewOccurrence := ⟨9, ⟨[], .result, unitTy⟩⟩
private def md : Metadata (List Nat) where
  scopeReturn w _ := w
  viewReturn w _ := w
  suspendScope w owner := w ++ [2 * owner]
  suspendView w identity := w ++ [2 * identity + 1]
  releaseCross w _ _ := w
  eligible _ _ _ _ := false
  failWorld w _ w' := w' = w
  failWorld_total w _ := ⟨w, rfl⟩
private def frames : List TypedCall.ContextFrame :=
  [.scope 1, .expose effectView resultView, .scope 3]
private def k : TypedCall.Comp := .ret (.var 0)
private def body : TypedCall.Comp := .ret (.var 1)

-- Noncommuting world actions distinguish capture order and the effect/result port.
example : CallState.requestWorldScopes md frames [] [] = ([2, 5, 6], [3, 1]) := rfl
example : CallState.requestWorldScopes md frames.reverse [] [] = ([6, 5, 2], [1, 3]) := rfl
example : CallState.requestWorldScopes md frames [] [] ≠
    CallState.requestWorldScopes md frames.reverse [] [] := by decide
example : CallState.requestWorldScopes md [.expose effectView resultView] [] [] ≠
    CallState.requestWorldScopes md [.expose resultView effectView] [] [] := by decide
example : CallState.captureFrames frames k =
    .scope 3 (.expose effectView resultView (.scope 1 k)) := rfl

-- Open syntax distinguishes mixed-frame order and both response-binder mistakes.
example : CallState.captureFrames [.bind body, .adapter unitTy unitTy k] k =
    .bind (.bind (.ret (.var 0)) (.ret (.var 2))) (.ret (.var 0)) := rfl
example : CallState.captureFrames [.bind body, .adapter unitTy unitTy k] k ≠
    CallState.captureFrames [.adapter unitTy unitTy k, .bind body] k := by
  intro h
  cases h
example : CallState.captureBind k k ≠
    .bind k (TypedCall.renameCallComp Nat.succ k) := by
  intro h
  cases h
example : plugResponse (CallState.captureBind k body) (.var 7) =
    .bind (.ret (.var 7)) body := rfl
example : plugResponse k (.var 7) ≠
    TypedCall.substituteCallComp (fun i => if i = 1 then .var 7 else .var (i - 1)) k := by
  intro h
  cases h

private def op : TypedCall.OperationInstance := ⟨0, [], unitTy, unitTy⟩
private def start (view : TypedCall.CallView) : CallState (List Nat) :=
  ⟨[], .requesting op (.var 0) k [effectView], frames, view, unitTy,
    [], [resultView], [], [.scope 11, .view 12]⟩

example (view : TypedCall.CallView) :
    ((start view).requestBoundary md 3).head =
      .requesting op (.var 0) (CallState.captureFrames frames k) [effectView] := rfl
example (view : TypedCall.CallView) :
    ((start view).requestBoundary md 4).head =
      .requested op (.var 0) (CallState.captureFrames frames k) := rfl
example (view : TypedCall.CallView) :
    ((start view).requestBoundary md 4).viewContext = [effectView] ∧
    ((start view).requestBoundary md 4).literalSuffix = [.scope 11, .view 12] :=
  ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
example (view : TypedCall.CallView) :
    ((start view).requestBoundary md 4).viewContext ≠ [resultView] := by
  intro h
  cases h
example (view : TypedCall.CallView) :
    ¬ ∃ t, YulangClosure.Prefix (CallControlStep md) 5 (start view) t := by
  rintro ⟨t, hp⟩
  have hbound := ((call_request_state_prefix_iff md (s := start view) rfl 5 t).1 hp).1
  contradiction

end YulangClosure.Control.RequestBoundaryChecks
